4017.expl: A slow tour of a loft flat as the day ends. Low sun throws long bars across the herringbone floor and a big round red paper lantern glows beside the window. The kitchen is lit only by a strip under the units, then a warm orange paper lantern hangs over a bed facing the city skyline at dusk, and finally strings of bulbs and candles light a roof terrace at night.

The dog holds completely still and keeps its eyes fixed on the frog as it paddles away between the reflections of the ferns and trees.

4022.expl: A small white propeller plane is airborne over a city, with a river and a distant skyline behind it and rows of houses far below. A woman in a pink shirt sits in the open doorway, then steps out onto the wing and stands upright with her arms spread wide while the plane keeps flying. She crouches back down, holds the wing with both hands and climbs back inside. The plane flies on alone with the pilot visible in the cockpit.

4023.expl: Seen from above, a young man in swim shorts jumps off a bridge into a green river and drops towards a blue inflatable dinghy where two friends are lying. He hits the water beside them with a big splash and disappears under the surface. He comes up, grabs the side of the dinghy and hauls himself on board. All three end up standing and grappling on the wobbling dinghy, laughing and shoving each other while small motorboats sit moored along the wooded bank.

4024.vo: Guys, it's not all sunshine and rainbows. Oh, wait. Hang on. It might actually be.
4024.expl: A man in a white shirt and yellow rubber boots stands at the open door of a red barn on a muddy farmyard. Brown hens stream out of the doorway past him. A goat, a large black and pink pig and a goose come out next and walk after him, and the camera backs away as they come. Finally three white alpacas walk out of the barn and follow the camera closely, the leading one filling the frame with its face.

4025.expl: A fluffy grey kitten stands on a windowsill next to a wooden toy tower made of stacked spiral ramps, with bare winter trees outside the window. A small green ball rolls down the ramps and the kitten swats at it with one paw, then follows it round the tower to the bottom tray. It bats the ball again, rears up on its hind legs to reach the top ramp, and finally leans right over the top bowl and takes the ball in its mouth.

4026.expl: A woman in a yellow top and white flared trousers stands barefoot on a wooden-topped hydrofoil board that is lifted clear of the water on a thin mast. The harbour water is completely flat and mirror-like, reflecting her and the palm trees, and she glides across it leaving only a thin line of ripples. She rides past a breakwater of grey concrete blocks and a marina, then comes back in and steps off onto a floating plastic dock.

4027.expl: A man in a chef's hat carries a big glass bowl of red and green apples through a kitchen, followed by a black and white cow that is also wearing a chef's hat. At the counter he rolls out dough with a rolling pin while the cow watches over his shoulder and licks its nose. He lays overlapping apple slices in a neat circle inside a pastry-lined dish and slides it into the oven. At a wooden table the finished golden pie sits whole beside a glass of milk, and in the last shot the plate holds only crumbs while the man laughs and the cow leans in over the table.

4029.expl: Three young men with white blindfolds sit in a row on concrete blocks in a red dirt yard, with a fourth man watching from a chair beside them. A big blue water bottle hangs from a rope above them and is pulled back and released, swinging down the line like a pendulum. It sweeps past the first two and slams into the third man, who is knocked backwards off his block with his legs in the air. He picks himself up and sits back down, and all four laugh.

4030.expl: In a large public park with mown lawns, bare trees, benches and a gravel path, a man in a dark jacket walks along the narrow stone rim of a round ornamental pond. Orange and white koi swim just under the surface below him. He wobbles, throws one arm up to keep his balance and topples in with a huge splash. He sits up soaked in the waist-deep water while people walk past on the path behind, then hauls himself back over the stone rim.

4031.expl: Three young men stand behind a blue ping-pong table in a games room, staring at a plastic bottle in front of them with two tennis balls balanced one on top of the other on its neck. One of them throws a third tennis ball, which arcs up over the table. It comes down and lands on the very top of the stack without knocking it over, so that three balls now sit in a column on the bottle. All three throw their arms up and shout in celebration.

4032.expl: Three young men sit at a white table wearing pink sleep masks over their eyes, with a big clear plastic box in front of them. The one on the left lifts a smaller tub and tips a thick stream of bright green slime over the head of the man in the middle. The slime coats his hair and face and hangs down in long strings into the box below. He gropes about, lifts a whole stretched sheet of slime up over his head, and the box, the table and all three of them end up smeared with green goo while the other two shake with laughter.

4033.expl: A strip of green artificial putting turf is laid across the carpet of a living room. In the foreground a pink golf ball sits on a wooden tee stuck into a red toy brick. At the far end a man in a purple t-shirt lines up with a golf club, swings it and hits a ball down the strip. He immediately throws both arms straight up, jumps and runs off to the side while a friend sitting on the floor cheers with him.

4034.expl: The tiled floor of a shop stacked with boxed toys is covered with dozens of black mousetraps, all set and laid out in rows. A man in a white shirt and shorts, blindfolded and holding a red foam bat, swings it around trying to hit a second man who is creeping between the traps in bare feet. The second man dodges away and steps carefully over the traps, but ends up sprawled on the floor among them while the blindfolded man swings again.

4035.expl: A first-person view looks down at the filmer's own feet in black sandals on an outdoor water obstacle course, above a pool of green water. He steps from one floating blue and white block to the next along a line of them, arms out to keep his balance. He crosses a narrow beam, then reaches a tall red tower covered in scale-shaped panels and takes hold of a thick white rope with both hands to pull himself up. At the top he stands behind a red railing looking down over the whole course.

4036.expl: By a resort swimming pool at sunset, a woman in a short gold dress poses with one hand in her hair while a man in a white vest crouches down to photograph her with his phone. The camera closes in on her face and she smiles broadly at the lens, showing her teeth, with gold hoop earrings and palm trees behind her. The two of them then lean together over the phone to look at the photos, laughing, and she gives a thumbs up. In the last shot she walks back towards the pool and he lifts the phone to take another picture.

4037.expl: A sausage that has been cut into strips at one end so that it splays out like an octopus stands in the oil of a hot black frying pan. Beaten egg is poured from a white bowl all around it and spreads across the pan, and a thin stream of oil is drizzled over the top. The egg sets into a round yellow omelette with the sausage in the middle. The finished omelette is slid out of the pan onto a white plate and chopped green spring onion is sprinkled over it.

4038.expl: A convertible car drives at night along a resort road lined with lit palm trees and low houses. Inside, a young man drives with one hand on the wheel and a young woman in a pale yellow cardigan sits beside him; they glance at each other and smile. She reaches across and lays her hand palm up on his knee, he takes it, and they hold hands over the centre console. The last shot is a close-up of their two hands raised together with the fingers interlocked.

4039.expl: In a gym lit with purple and green neon, a man and a woman are down on their hands and toes at the start of a marked running track, joined by a long red resistance band. They crawl forwards along the track side by side with their hips low, the band stretching tighter behind them. The band pulls the woman back and she is dragged flat onto her stomach, then ends up sitting on the track laughing while the man stands over her holding the band.

4040.expl: A couple sit at a square table with a white cloth on a beach at dusk, palm trees and the sea behind them and a lantern with a lit candle in the middle of the table. A waiter in a white jacket sets down their food and steps back. In front of the woman is a plate of green salad; in front of the man a burger with a pile of chips. He picks the burger up in both hands and takes a big bite, then grins at the camera. The two of them talk and laugh over their plates with wine glasses beside them.

4041.expl: A couple walk hand in hand down the bright marble concourse of a shopping mall, she in a short gold dress and he in a white t-shirt and shorts. She stops in front of a lit shop window full of long evening gowns on mannequins and pulls him back towards it. Her face fills the frame with a hopeful, pleading look; his face follows, tight-lipped and reluctant. 4042.expl: At dusk a young couple stands on the pavement outside a brightly lit convenience store, its glass front and stocked shelves glowing behind them. The woman, in a pale yellow wrap dress with a white frangipani in her hair, sips from a whole green coconut through a red-and-white striped straw; a close-up shows her drinking with the store's shelves of packets and bottles filling the background. She looks up at the tall man in a white t-shirt beside her; he looks down at her and says no. She keeps holding the coconut between them and smiles up at him as scooters and other shoppers pass behind.

4043.expl: A woman in a black leather jacket and beige trousers walks along a sunlit street of honey-coloured stone buildings, tucking her hair behind her ear. She turns and sees a man getting out of a black car parked at the kerb, carrying an enormous bouquet of pale pink peonies. He walks up to her and holds the flowers out; she takes them, and in the final shot she is behind the huge bouquet with her hand over her mouth, laughing and crying at once.

4044.expl: At a floodlit driving range at night, a woman in a red hoodie, grey leggings, white trainers and a white cap stands on a green mat with a club, a ball teed up in front of her. She settles into her stance, swings the club back over her shoulder and hits the ball out into the dark field, then follows through and watches it fly. A man in a beige hoodie stands on the next bay watching her.

4045.expl: In the living room of a stone-and-wood villa a man in a dark blue shirt and white shorts is looking for something: he turns on the spot, pats himself down, leans over the sofa and checks around the cushions while a woman in a cream robe sits on the sofa watching him. The camera cuts to a sunlit stone ledge by the window where two magazines, a bunch of car keys and a black phone are lying. Back inside, the man walks past the sofa holding the phone up, smiling, and the woman looks up at him.

4047.expl: A couple lies together on a wide cushioned daybed under a wooden pavilion at a beach resort, with an infinity pool, palm trees and the sea behind them and the sky orange and pink at sunset. The man in a white sleeveless top and sunglasses holds a phone; the woman beside him in a green bikini and a white shirt talks and gestures, then pulls her sunglasses down onto her face. She settles against his chest and he puts his arm around her while they watch the sunset.

4048.expl: A time-lapse of two men converting an empty cargo van into a home. First the van stands open and bare in a car park and one man climbs in through the back doors. Inside, the two of them press timber studs and purple insulation panels into place along the walls under a new wooden roof frame, standing on a fresh plywood floor. On the roof under a blue sky they lower two large black solar panels into position and fix them down. The finished interior is lined with pale wood and has a white-tiled shower, a kitchen with a sink, and a skylight; four men stand inside cheering and dancing.

4049.expl: On a wide white-sand beach under a clear blue sky, a man in red shorts crouches between two tall stacks of turquoise sun loungers. He lifts both stacks at once onto his shoulders and walks across the sand carrying them, the loungers towering far above his head so only his legs and red shorts are visible beneath. He crosses the empty beach past parasols and the sea, then sets the whole load down and lines the loungers up in a row with the others.

4050.vo: Hey kids, it's your dad here. Been on the road for four years now, living out my childhood dreams. Home isn't a place, it's the people you're with.
4050.expl: Two young men stand barefoot on the open tailgate of a van in the desert at sunrise with their fists raised, cheering. The white van drives along a coast road above the ocean. Inside, the van is lined with pale wood and fairy lights, and a black dog in a red bandana lies on a wooden bunk while a hand reaches in to stroke it. At night four friends and the dog sit in camping chairs in a circle around a small fire pit in the sand beside the lit van. Finally the four of them and the dog sit in a row on the tailgate, backs to the camera, watching an orange sunset over the sea.

4051.vo: Yo, what is this? It's an electric motorcycle I charge off my truck. No, the truck. Oh, that's my house. Induction cooktop, full bed, even a skylight.
4051.expl: In a car park a man in a black t-shirt and cap stands beside a huge grey six-wheeled expedition truck with a living box built onto the back. He bends down at a rack on the truck's flank and pulls a black electric motorcycle out on its carrier, then stands holding it by the handlebars in front of the truck's giant wheels while he talks to the camera. He then walks through the wood-lined interior of the truck, past a black oven and microwave, a bed and a sink under a skylight, with two long-haired grey cats sitting on the counter and the bed.

4052.expl: On a white-sand beach with palm trees and shallow turquoise water, a couple in white pose for a phone that stands on a small tripod in the sand in the foreground; the phone's screen shows the shot it is taking of them. They stand arm in arm making peace signs at the lens. The woman then walks straight up to the phone, frowns and reaches down to adjust it, then goes back and they pose again. At the end they both laugh and give a thumbs-up as a small dog runs into the frame behind them.

4053.expl: On a white marble worktop two ribbed mugs of black coffee stand side by side, one teal and one orange, with a large knife lying behind them. The knife slices straight down through the orange mug, and the two halves fall open to show layers of sponge and chocolate inside: it is a cake. The shot changes to three pale ears of corn lying in a row on the marble, their husks still attached. The knife comes down through the middle ear and cuts it lengthways, opening it to reveal that it too is a cake, with a yellow sponge inside and rounded yellow dots along the cut face.

4054.expl: A dark apartment block at night against a deep blue sky, with one window lit orange among all the black ones. The camera zooms in on that window: inside, a golden retriever is sitting upright on a black office chair at a desk, facing a screen, with its front paws resting on a keyboard. Wearing small glasses, it looks at the screen and moves its paws over the keys, tapping away as if working late.

4055.expl: A husky with blue eyes sits on a teal leaf-patterned bed in front of a brown buttoned headboard. Two large plastic toy dinosaurs, a red-brown one and a dark grey one, are held up in front of it by hands out of shot, their jaws open and teeth bared, and they snap towards the dog from both sides. The husky opens its mouth, tips its head back and howls at them, then paws at the grey one. At the end the dinosaurs are set down on the bed and the husky sits between them panting with its tongue out.

4056.expl: At night on a city pavement in front of a brick wall, a woman in a black dress and black high heels holds a bottle of champagne with both hands, laughing. She works the cork loose and the bottle erupts: a thick white jet of foam shoots several metres into the air and rains back down over the pavement. She screams, crouches down and holds the gushing bottle out in front of her at arm's length while the foam keeps fountaining up and spreads in a wide white pool across the paving stones.

4057.expl: In a white kitchen a man in a blue zip sweater and sunglasses holds a large bottle of cola in both hands and shakes it hard, looking at the camera. Filmed from inside the house through a patio door, he goes out into the garden, sets the bottle down carefully on a low brick wall beside a garden shed and walks away. A woman in a turquoise sweatshirt and lilac leggings comes and sits on the wall next to the bottle, picks it up and twists the cap. The cola erupts in a tall brown jet straight up into her face and over her clothes; she jumps up, soaked, and throws her hands in the air.

4058.expl: A man in a red cap and white t-shirt lifts a single small brown suitcase onto a white bed in a bedroom and closes it. He carries it out to a blue SUV standing on a sunny driveway with its boot open. He then turns and sees a woman in a black dress wheeling out a tower of about ten stacked suitcases in pink, green, teal, blue and black, balanced far above her head. He stands in front of it with his mouth open and his hands raised, staring up at the tower while she waits beside it.

4059.expl: Filmed from the driver's seat through the windscreen of a safari vehicle on a dirt track in the bush, with the steering wheel and dashboard in the foreground. A single yellow banana has been stood upright on the bonnet. A large baboon walks along the bonnet towards it and sits down beside it; a second and then a third baboon climb up and sit in a row, all staring at the banana with more of the troop on the track behind. One of them finally reaches out, takes the banana and starts to eat it while the others crowd in around it.

4060.expl: A first-person view from a yellow kayak racing down a narrow jungle river, the paddler's blue sleeve and black paddle swinging in and out of shot. White water rushes past the nose of the boat between mossy rock walls and dense green foliage, with a rainbow hanging in the mist ahead. The kayak is carried straight over the lip of a waterfall and drops into the spray, the screen filling with white water; it comes out below in the mist and carries on downstream, where another paddler in a red kayak is running the same rapid ahead.

4061.expl: An underwater shot in clear blue-green water with sunlight streaming down from the surface. A large great white shark swims straight towards the camera, head-on and filling the frame, its pale underside and pointed pectoral fins spread wide. As it comes closer the camera looks up into its face and its mouth opens slightly, showing the wide jaw lined with rows of triangular white teeth. At the last moment the shark turns and passes overhead, and the screen fills with churning white bubbles below the bright surface.

4062.expl: A head-mounted point-of-view shot from a kitesurfer riding on a shallow lagoon at sunset. Two bare forearms reach forward into the frame and both hands close around the horizontal control bar of a kite, the lines running up out of shot. The orange sun sits low over a line of palm trees on the far shore and other kites are visible as small shapes in the purple sky. The rider leans back, the board carves and white spray sheets up across the lens, and the shot ends with the red kite canopy overhead as he skims across the water.

4063.expl: A man in a dark jacket and jeans hangs from two red webbing straps clipped to a harness across his chest, suspended in the air high above an unbroken sea of golden clouds at sunrise. He looks down between his boots. The straps let him go and he drops straight away from the camera, shrinking to a small dark speck against the cloud layer. The camera keeps looking down as he disappears into the clouds, and at the end a pale ledge slides into the bottom of the frame.

4064.expl: Two hands hold a small green parakeet that is wearing a tiny camera on its chest, sitting on someone's knee beside a road. Behind it a tall wooden pole carries power lines across a green field, and a huge untidy nest of sticks is balanced on top of the pole. The bird is let go and flies straight at the pole, the nest growing larger and larger until the bird slips in through a gap in the twigs. Inside the dark nest the camera passes through a tunnel of straw and comes out in a lit chamber where four young green parakeets sit around a small wooden table set with three little bowls of seed.

4065.expl: A shot from the back of an open-topped sports car parked on a forest road. A big white Samoyed dog in a turquoise harness sits upright in the driver's seat with its front paws resting by the steering wheel, staring straight ahead through the windscreen. A beagle sits in the passenger seat with its tongue out, a grey cat perches on the centre console between them, and a raccoon looks over from the narrow rear seat. Tall pine trees and mist fill the view ahead; nobody moves and the car does not start.

4066.expl: A green parrot stands on bare red earth while a hand lowers a tiny motocross helmet onto its head. The parrot hops onto a miniature dirt bike and rides off down a track of deep red-brown dirt that runs through open eucalyptus woodland. A low close-up shows the rear tyre spinning on the loose dirt as the bike speeds along, then the camera looks up from ground level as the parrot launches the bike off a mound of red dirt and lands, riding away over the ridge.

4067.expl: A wide shot of a lake at dusk under a clear blue and yellow sky. The water is completely flat and mirrors the dark line of fir trees on the far shore and the pale glow of the sky, so the treeline appears twice, once above the waterline and once below it. On the right a large rock juts out over the water and a person crouches in silhouette on its edge. They spring off, hit the water, and the smooth mirrored surface breaks into wide rings that travel outward. The swimmer's head appears in the middle of the rings and moves slowly across the lake as the water settles again.

4068.expl: An underwater shot in clear blue water just above a white sandy seabed. A large tiger shark, its grey back marked with dark vertical bars, cruises slowly from left to right across the frame. A freediver in a bikini, mask and long fins swims down beside it, matching its speed, and reaches out with one hand. She lays her palm on the shark's back near the dorsal fin and runs it slowly along the animal's flank as the two glide side by side over the sand. She keeps her hand on it for several seconds before the shark turns away.

4069.expl: An animated scene on a wooden dock under a grey sky. A tall white pigeon with long eyelashes stands beside a small scruffy grey and green chick, and the chick holds a thin fishing rod with the line dropping down into the dark water. The camera looks down at the water, where rings spread from the float. A mermaid with long black hair rises out of the sea, a city skyline behind her, smiling with her eyes shut. She lifts the chick in her cupped hands and sets it gently back on the planks. The big white pigeon glares, spreads a wing over the chick and stares the mermaid down.

4070.expl: Inside the cramped white cabin of a small aeroplane, several people in swimwear and parachute rigs shuffle barefoot towards the open door. The shot cuts outside: two of them are hanging from the wing strut under the plane's long wing, high above a coastline, with the landing wheel beside them. They hold the strut with both hands, dangling in the wind, then let go one after the other and drop away. The camera stays with the plane, and the frame is filled by the underside of the wing with the blue sea, the white surf line and the flat coastal city far below.

4071.expl: A rusted shipwreck stands tilted out of bright turquoise shallows under a sky of white clouds. A woman in a bikini runs along the wreck's raised bow, bends her knees and leaps off the end, stretching out flat as she flies over the water. She hits the surface and the shot follows her down in a stream of white bubbles. Underwater she levels off above a sandy bottom dotted with coral heads, where several large tiger sharks are cruising. She swims in among them and glides right alongside one, her arms wrapped loosely around its back, as a second shark passes behind.

4072.expl: A drone shot that starts close on three women in bright swimsuits standing together on a small strip of white sand, then climbs and pulls back. As it rises, two enormous grey limestone walls come into the frame on the left and right, rising sheer out of the sea and closing in on the little beach so that it sits at the bottom of a narrow slot. Palms and thick green jungle spill over the top of the beach behind them. In front, a shallow turquoise lagoon with dark patches of reef stretches out between the two rock walls towards the open sea.

In front, a shallow turquoise lagoon with dark patches of reef stretches out between the two rock walls towards the open sea.

4073.expl: An animated autumn park with orange trees and benches. A plump teal and purple pigeon stands with its eyes closed and a soft smile. A large angry white hen with a red comb stands over three yellow chicks and swings a wooden stick at the pigeon; the next shot shows the pigeon wide-eyed with the stick pressed across its beak. A yellow chick has fallen asleep tucked into the pigeon's blue chest feathers with the stick lying across it. The hen lowers the stick and walks off with her chicks, and the teal pigeon turns to a white and pink pigeon beside it, their wings touching.

4074.expl: A short sequence shot at the end of the day. A laughing woman in a red swimsuit sits chest-deep in a calm lagoon with the low sun blazing behind her and lighting up her wet hair. The camera drops to water level, where the sun sits just above a sand dune and lays a long band of light across the ripples, with a wooden boat moored to one side. Two red kites hang against the orange sky, then a kitesurfer skims across the shallow water in the sunlight, followed by a point-of-view shot of hands on the control bar. The last shot is a huge orange moon behind a row of wind turbines.

4075.expl: A drone looks straight down at turquoise open sea. In the middle of the frame one woman in a dark swimsuit floats face down on the surface with her arms stretched out to the sides and her legs together, completely still. All around her, filling the whole picture, dozens of large sharks swim in every direction, some passing directly under her body, others crossing within a metre of her hands and feet. The camera holds and slowly drifts; the sharks keep circling and criss-crossing around her and she never moves.

4076.expl: A camera fixed under a helicopter looks back at its wide open side door. Three skydivers sit inside the cabin with their backs to the camera, framed by the doorway, with blue sky and a coastline visible through the opening. One by one they swing out through the open door onto the landing skid, stand on it barefoot holding the frame, and then push off. They drop away in a spread position over a coastal town with a winding river and a long white beach. The helicopter climbs and shrinks to a small shape in the empty blue sky.

4077.vo: It's here. Probably just a mosquito. Go back to sleep.
4077.expl: An animated night scene on a rooftop ledge, with a full moon and the blurred lights of a city behind. Two plump pigeons are asleep side by side in a big twig nest, a teal one and a white and pink one, both with their eyes closed and their heads tipped together. The teal pigeon suddenly jerks awake, beats its wings and lifts out of the nest, hovering for a moment while the other stays fast asleep with its eyes still shut. He drops back down beside her and settles, but stays sitting bolt upright with his eyes wide open, staring into the dark while she sleeps on.

4078.expl: A plain bedroom with a woven wall hanging above an enormous bed made up in white. A row of seven identical white pillows is lined up along the head of the bed against the wall. A woman in a black top and grey joggers climbs onto the end of the bed and crawls slowly up the middle of it on her hands and knees, dragging the white duvet into long folds behind her. When she reaches the top she turns, drops back against the row of pillows and flings her arms out wide, lying flat with the pillows behind her head.

4079.expl: A point-of-view shot from the front of a yellow kayak dropping into a white-water river in a steep pine gorge. The pale green water rushes past on both sides, piling into standing waves and white foam between dark rocks, and the boat is carried down fast. A hand works a black paddle across the bow, spray bursts over the lens and blurs it, and the walls of fir trees rush by. The river then widens and slows, and the kayak arrives at a calm stretch where four paddlers in red kayaks and helmets are waiting on a grey gravel bank.

4080.expl: An animated scene in a home. A mother in a purple jumper stands behind her small daughter, who sits scowling in a pink hoodie with her arms folded. The mother gathers a handful of the girl's long brown hair in one fist and holds it up, looking around with a worried face for something to tie it with. She leans over and rummages through an open wooden drawer, then searches a dressing table lit by round bulbs around a mirror, pushing aside bottles and tubes. She presses a hand to her forehead in despair. Then she notices three grey hair ties looped around her own wrist, and a close-up shows her fingers hooking one off her wrist as she smiles.

4081.expl: A chest-mounted point-of-view shot from a skydiver sitting in the open door of a helicopter over the Alps. His own legs in a white padded suit and tan boots hang out over a wall of high mountains whose ridges and summits are thickly covered in white snow, with a bare green valley running between them and the sun blazing overhead. He drops away, and the helicopter tips over above him and shrinks into the deep blue sky as the snow-covered peaks and glaciers slide past below. Under canopy he comes down towards a bright green alpine meadow with a large orange landing cross laid out on the grass, his boots pointing at it.

4082.expl: Filmed from inside the open door of a small plane flying high above a turquoise coral reef. A woman in a white and blue jumpsuit and harness hangs from the wing strut outside the plane, laughing, her legs swinging free in the open air. She swings under the wing, hangs upside down, and then lets go and drops away from the plane, shrinking to a tiny figure against the blue water far below.

4083.expl: An animated shot filmed straight down onto a bed at night. A woman and a bearded man sleep on either side, with a small pug lying between them. The pug slowly stretches out and spreads its legs, pushing the two people further and further towards the edges of the bed. By the end the humans have been pushed off completely — only their hands still grip the sides of the mattress — and the pug lies alone, spread out flat in the exact middle of the bed.

4084.expl: An animated bald man in a red robe stands in a gold and green marble bathroom in front of a large mirror, holding up a small gold jar. A hairless sphynx cat sits on the washbasin beside him. A golden drop falls onto the cat's bare head and onto the man's bald head. Both heads sprout enormous hair: the man grows long thick black curls, the cat grows a golden lion's mane. The two admire themselves in the mirror.

4085.expl: An animated short about a man being transformed. He sits slumped on the sofa in a dark living room playing a video game while an angry woman stands behind him with her arms folded. She drags him out of the door. He then appears outside a smart townhouse in a navy suit and tie, standing tall and confident while two women look him over admiringly. A huge eye peers through a gap in the door. Finally the couple walk back into the house together.

4086.expl: A simple cartoon set in a dark blue house at night. A mosquito with an angry face hovers by a door next to a glowing red plug-in insect repeller, then next to a wall socket, unbothered by it. It flies on to a bedroom where a person sleeps under a blue blanket with the crescent moon in the window, and lands on the sleeper's bald head. In close-up the mosquito braces its legs and drives its long proboscis down to bite. The last shot is the little white house from outside.

4087.expl: A series of shots of tabby cats dressed in grey business suits living a full office life. Two of them sit side by side on the blue seats of a commuter train between human passengers. One types at a laptop in an open-plan office, walled in by towering stacks of paper. Two stand chatting with paper cups by the coffee machine and the water cooler. Two sit at a boardroom table watching a bar-chart presentation on a projector screen. In the last shot a cat in striped pyjamas works on a laptop in bed at night, surrounded by scattered documents.

4088.expl: A steady shot taken from the very brink of an enormous waterfall on a bright day. A broad sheet of deep green water slides towards the camera and pours over a long curved edge that stretches far away across the frame. White foam breaks along the top, and a huge white cloud of spray rises from below and fills the right-hand half of the picture. Blue sky and small clouds sit above the far shore.

4089.expl: A night dive on white sand: two black-gloved hands hold out a small action camera and an octopus reaches out and takes it. The picture then becomes the octopus's own point of view — its head and arms in the foreground as it crawls low over the sand, past dark rocks, and down a narrow gully. It arrives in what looks like an underwater nightclub: glowing red jellyfish hang overhead like lamps, blue laser beams sweep the water, and a crowd of octopuses, one wearing white sunglasses, waves its arms and dances under the lights.

4090.expl: A tall silver rocket stands beside its steel launch tower on a concrete pad under a clear blue sky, venting white vapour. The engines light and orange flame and white smoke burst out around its base. The rocket lifts off the pad and rises past the tower, its exhaust turning to a bright pink and white column. It climbs out of frame and a huge cloud of pale smoke and dust rolls across the pad, leaving only the tower and the trail of fire above it.

4091.expl: A woman in a cream fleece jacket, white trousers and a cream beanie walks across the glassy black ice of a frozen lake, her reflection sharp beneath her feet. She opens a steel thermos, unscrews the cup, and pours steaming dark tea onto the ice. The hot liquid spreads across the surface and stains it brown. The camera looks straight down as fine white lines shoot out from the spot in every direction, until the ice is covered by a wide star of cracks under her feet.

4092.expl: A helmet-camera view from a road bike at sunset. The rider's tanned arms grip the drop handlebars, and ahead of them a long, steep flight of worn stone steps drops away down the face of a red cliff towards the sea. The sun sits low on the horizon, laying a golden path across the water. The bike bumps down step after step, the stone blurring beneath the front wheel, until the steps end and the rider rolls out onto a dark dirt path by a low stone wall.

4093.expl: A telescope view of the moon against a black sky scattered with faint stars. At first only a small pale disc shows in the corner of the frame. The camera zooms in steadily until the moon fills most of the picture: a large round grey body with its curved bright edge on one side, the darker flat plains in the middle, and thousands of small craters picked out along the shadow line.

4094.expl: A camera mounted on a horse follows its day on a desert ranch. First a close-up of the horse's muzzle dripping water as it drinks from a concrete trough, red rock cliffs behind it. Then a barn corner where a trolley is stacked high with brightly coloured sacks of animal feed in red, blue, green, yellow and pink, with a green shovel leaning beside it. Then a black horse and a chestnut horse stand nose to nose eating pale green hay from a big round metal feeder at sunrise. Finally the horse walks down a dirt road lined with tall golden poplars.

4095.vo: Not long ago, folks figured a big picture took a big camera. So this little thing shot all that? Big movies, little camera.
4095.expl: A behind-the-scenes clip from a film shoot in a red-rock desert at dusk. First the finished-looking action: a yellow muscle car races down an empty desert highway chased by a police car with flashing lights, then a shot from inside the car looking out through the windscreen at the setting sun. Then the camera pulls back to the reality: a young crew in hoodies and jeans stand in the sand around a monitor on a wheeled cart, watching the same shot play back, some holding tablets and notes. The last shot shows two pickup trucks parked on a dirt track under an orange and pink sunset sky.

4096.expl: Underwater on bright white sand in clear turquoise water. A green sea turtle is tangled in a heavy brown rope net, unable to move. Two snorkellers in fins hold the turtle steady and work at the ropes with their hands, then one cuts the strands away with a black-handled knife. They peel the net back off the shell and flippers. Freed, the turtle glides away over the pale sand, its shadow following beneath it.

4097.expl: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a dry dirt jump park under a blue sky. Ahead of the camera another rider hurtles up a huge sloping ramp of packed orange earth and launches high into the air, hanging above the ridge. The point-of-view rider races after him down the trail, the ground blurring past the front tyre as he drops through bermed corners and along the side of a green and brown hill, chasing the rider ahead across the jumps.

4098.expl: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a narrow dirt track that runs along a steep green alpine ridge, with deep valleys and misty mountains beyond. Two brown cows with bells around their necks are standing right on the track, blocking the only way through. One walks straight at the camera and the rider reaches out a gloved hand and pushes its face gently aside. The cows step off the path, and the rider rolls on down the empty track over the ridge.

4099.expl: Filmed through a car windscreen in slow traffic on a busy city street under a concrete overpass, with shops and signs along the roadside. Ahead, a motorbike carries a tall stack of mattresses with a brown street dog riding on top. The load slides off and lands flat on the tarmac, and the dog jumps down and stands beside it. A man in a red shirt helps the rider heave the mattresses back onto the bike. As soon as they are strapped on, the dog climbs back up on top and the motorbike pulls away through the traffic.

4100.expl: A quiet bedroom with pale green walls, a wooden bed, a rug and a bedside table with a red digital clock. A man lies stretched out on the bed. Suddenly the ceiling bursts open and an enormous steel coil spring shoots down through it, punching a ragged hole in the plasterboard and driving straight through the floorboards into another hole below. Broken laths and clouds of white mattress stuffing rain down over the room. The man is left face-down on the floor in the debris, then picks himself up, stands and brushes the fluff off his clothes.

4101.expl: A circus arena in a spotlight, with rows of the audience in silhouette. A performer in a blue costume stands on a gold pedestal and lifts a huge sheet of white cloth above their head, then opens their arms so the cloth falls into an enormous cone around them, spreading across the ring like a gown. The crowd hold up phones to film. The white cloth is then whipped away and in its place a giant peacock tail opens out in orange, white and green with a blue wheel at its centre, and the audience raise their hands and cheer.

4102.expl: An illustrated clip. A thin man sits on a wooden chair at a small desk in a bare room, typing on a laptop. Through the big window in front of him the outside is bright: a yellow sun in a blue sky, a purple kite flying on a string, and a green ocean wave rolling in. His head tips back toward the sunny sky while his hands stay on the keyboard. His body then stretches further and further out of the chair toward the window until the chair tips over and he is pulled almost horizontal, hands still on the laptop, drawn toward the sunshine outside.

4103.expl: A black Labrador puppy is in a kitchen doorway behind an orange cardboard screen. On a flat sheet of cardboard in front of it stands a single upright sausage, with small dark plastic figures beside it. The puppy peeps around the orange screen at the sausage and holds still for a long time, only watching and edging closer. After several seconds it finally gives in, lunges forward, takes the sausage in its mouth and chews it, then sits back on the cardboard with its mouth open and only a hole left where the sausage stood.

4104.expl: An animated park scene with cartoon pigeons. A small grey pigeon stands beside a much larger dark blue pigeon that leans over it; the small one glares up with narrowed eyes. A white pigeon with pink feathers stands next to it, half-closing her eyes. The camera holds close on the small grey pigeon while its eyebrows lower and its face turns sour. At the end the white pigeon leans in and presses her beak to its cheek in a kiss; the grey pigeon's cheeks turn bright red and it keeps scowling while blushing.

4105.expl: An animated city street at sunset. A young woman with long black hair, a black leather jacket, cream trousers and a small red shoulder bag walks along the pavement, smiling and touching her hair. Ahead of her a young man in a leather jacket leans against a black car holding a huge bouquet of pink and cream peonies. She sees him, stops, and covers her mouth with her hand, eyes wide. He steps forward and holds the flowers out to her; she buries her face in the bouquet, then they stand close together behind the flowers, smiling at each other in the golden light.

4106.expl: A bearded man sits at a wooden dining table in front of a big white plate piled with creamy spaghetti. A brown dachshund is propped up behind him with its head peeping over his shoulder. Each time the man lifts a forkful of spaghetti, the dog stretches its neck around and grabs the strands from the fork before they reach his mouth, so the spaghetti hangs from the dog's jaws. The man pulls faces at the camera, wide-eyed and then laughing, while the dog keeps licking its lips and going back for more.

4107.expl: Filmed from the audience of a circus. An elephant stands alone in the sawdust ring under a spotlight. A huge grey sheet is dropped from above and floats down over the elephant until the whole animal is hidden under the cloth, which spreads out across the ring floor. A performer in a dark red suit stands beside the covered shape with his arm out. The sheet is then pulled away and a white tiger with black stripes walks out where the elephant had been, padding across the ring towards the audience and snarling at the camera.

4108.vo: Do you love your new car? I hate it! It's so embarrassing! But it's so cute!
4108.expl: An animated city street. A tiny round red car covered in printed smiley faces is parked at the kerb. Inside sit two cartoon birds: a blue-green pigeon in the passenger seat, grinning, and a white and pink bird at the wheel wearing white gloves, glaring furiously ahead. The white bird scowls at the car while the pigeon beams. The camera pulls back to show the whole car from the side, with the words 'I'm her husband.' written large along the red door, and the white bird standing outside on the pavement with folded wings while the pigeon waves happily from the driver's window.

4109.expl: A sunny back garden with a mown grass lawn and a tall green hedge along the back. Two fluffy dogs stand on the grass: a small cream Pomeranian and a bigger black and tan Lapphund. Between them on the lawn sits a round blue pet drinking fountain that shoots a thin jet of water straight up into the air. The dogs watch the jet, then the black and tan dog steps up to the fountain and drinks from it while the cream one circles around, jumps up and paws at the water, and the two take turns at the bowl on the grass.

4110.expl: A circus ring filmed from the dark audience seats. An elephant stands on a low round pedestal in a beam of light. Beside it stands a clown in a yellow and purple polka-dot costume with a bright orange wig, huge yellow shoes and a white painted face, next to a man in a dark red suit. A big dark cloth drops over the elephant and hides it completely; the clown throws both arms up in the air towards the audience. When the cloth is pulled away, a white tiger is sitting on the pedestal instead. The clown lies down on the sawdust beside the tiger with its legs in the air while the audience films on their phones.

4111.vo: with spring right around the corner. Ow! Oh my God! I'm sick of these goats. We're definitely having lamb chops tonight. Oh my God.
4111.expl: A man in a black T-shirt, jeans and mirrored sunglasses kneels in the dirt beside a weathered wooden barn, holding a hammer and laying out fresh pale timber boards. A big woolly ram with curled horns walks straight up behind him and shoves its head into his side, pushing him against the barn wall. He shouts, braces one hand on the wall and tries to keep working, but the ram butts him again and again. In the last shot he is sitting slumped on the ground with the hammer still in his hand, head back, while the ram stands over him.

4112.expl: A close shot of an unfinished wall built from large pale building blocks with thin mortar joints between them, under a window that looks out over a foggy green field. A hand in a grey work glove holds a cut-off clear plastic bottle flat against the blocks, directly under the tip of a drill. The drill bores into the block and the grey dust falls straight down into the bottle instead of onto the floor. When the drilling stops, the hand lifts the bottle away to show a neat round hole in the block and a heap of grey dust collected inside the bottle.

4113.vo: You fine. Hey, hey, back off. I'm his wife. I don't see any ring on that finger. You belong to the sky!
4113.expl: An animated city street at sunset with cartoon pigeons on the pavement. A small grey pigeon wears a glowing pink diamond ring that sparkles and casts pink light over its feathers. A white pigeon with pink-tinted feathers leans in beside it, admiring the ring with wide eyes and an open beak, while a huge dark pigeon with heavy eyelids looms over both of them in the background. The white pigeon presses herself against the grey one, then rears up, opens her beak wide and shouts with one wing raised. At the end the two walk off together side by side down the street, the ring still glowing between them.

4114.expl: An animated shopping centre with polished floors, glass shopfronts and bright ceiling lights. A woman in a gold dress walks hand in hand with a very large, heavily built man in a white T-shirt and white shorts. She spots a gold dress on a mannequin in a lit shop window, spins round and pulls him towards it. Her face fills the screen, beaming with excitement; then his face fills the screen, eyebrows raised and mouth open in dismay. In the last shot she strides out of the shop holding a fan of pink and white bags while he trudges behind her with both hands full of shopping bags.

4115.expl: A tiled seaside promenade at night, lit by the lights of souvenir stalls. Racks of sunglasses and rows of straw sun hats stand outside the shops on one side, dark pine trees rise on the other, and the lights of the bay glow further along. A young couple walks away from the camera down the promenade with his arm around her shoulders. He reaches over and ruffles the top of her head; she ducks away, spins round with her blonde hair flying, and laughs. He puts his arm back around her and they walk on together past the stalls.

4116.expl: A car park by the sea. A bearded man in a flat cap and navy jacket pushes a bright red bubble car by hand out of a parking space; the little car is so low that it barely reaches his waist and it is dwarfed on both sides by two enormous black SUVs. He rolls it out, climbs in through the front and drives it along a coastal road, its three wheels and glass bubble roof tiny against the wide blue bay. He parks under a big spreading tree and sits on a bench beside it, with the city skyline across the water, then drives slowly away down the path.

4117.expl: An animated living room with a low round wooden table, a pale sofa and big windows onto a green garden. A man in a dark blue shirt stands looking worried, then starts hunting through the room: he throws the sofa cushions into the air, crouches down to look under the furniture and turns around again and again. A woman in a cream top sits calmly on the sofa watching him with a small knowing smile. The camera drops to the coffee table, where his phone and a bunch of car keys are lying in plain sight; a hand reaches in and points at them. He looks up, sheepish, picks up the phone, and she stands behind the sofa with her arms folded, pointing at the table.

4118.expl: A point of view shot from one end of an orange clay tennis court, high in the mountains. The white lines of the court run away from the camera to the net across the middle, and beyond it a grey rock face with snow on top rises into a deep blue sky under a bright sun. On the far side of the net a player in red hits the ball back; the yellow ball bounces on the clay and crosses the net again and again. The player at the camera end reaches into the frame to play a shot, and the rally goes on across the empty court with the mountain behind it.

4119.expl: A misty beach at dawn, with dark pine trees on the shore and driftwood and seaweed on the wet sand. A figure has been built out of balanced grey and green beach stones: two stone legs, a rounded stone body, outstretched stone arms and a small stone head, standing on the wet sand with its reflection under it. It stands still for several seconds. Then one arm drops away, the head tips off, and the whole stack falls in on itself until nothing is left but a low heap of pebbles lying in the shallow water with the same trees and fog behind.

4120.expl: A close overhead shot outdoors. A pale wooden board with a round hole cut through the middle is laid flat across the top of a big carved wooden bowl, with a crate of whole walnuts behind it. A hand picks a walnut out of the crate and sets it in the hole in the board so it sits held in place. A hammer swings down and cracks the walnut; the pieces of shell and the kernel drop straight through the hole into the bowl underneath. The hand fetches another walnut and does it again, and the bowl below slowly fills up with broken shells and pale nut kernels.

4121.expl: A film shoot in a stone quarry, seen from behind a big cinema camera on a rig in the foreground with its monitor turned towards us. Across the pit stand two tall concrete silos with a metal walkway running from them to the rock face. An orange fireball bursts out at the walkway and black smoke rises; a stuntman hanging on a wire swings away from it across the quarry. The metal walkway tears loose and crashes down the rock face, throwing up a huge cloud of pale dust that fills the pit while the camera keeps rolling and crew in yellow high-visibility vests watch from below.

4122.vo: Nobody move! Give me all your money! Where's the vault? We don't have one. Then what do you keep here? Samples. Sorry. Wrong bank.
4122.expl: A flat cartoon in stick-figure style. Behind a service counter a plain white figure stands with a clipboard in front of him. Through the window behind him a black masked figure smashes the glass, and shards fall on the floor. The masked figure climbs in, points a revolver over the counter and shouts at the clerk, who stares back without moving. After the clerk answers him, the masked figure lowers the gun, turns away and walks back out through the broken window, past the parked cars in the street, leaving the shattered glass and the untouched counter behind.

4123.expl: A hand-drawn cartoon on a grey background. A girl with long dark hair kneels holding a sheet of paper marked with a big red A+. Her face crumples, her mouth turns down and two thick turquoise streams of tears run from her eyes. She throws her head back and wails with her mouth wide open while the tears gush out in great arcs on both sides of her head and pool on the ground around her knees, until she is kneeling in a spreading puddle of her own crying, still holding the paper. The cartoon then cuts to two grinning men in small gold crowns standing on a cliff, each holding up a sheet marked 50, waving them over a crowd of small figures cheering below.

The cartoon then cuts to two grinning men in small gold crowns standing on a cliff, each holding up a sheet marked 50, waving them over a crowd of small figures cheering below.

4124.vo: Hey kids, it's your dad here. I've been on the road for four years now. The things that make life special aren't the things you own, they're the people beside you and the memories you make along the way.
4124.expl: A series of shots from life in a camper van. A curly-haired young man leans out of the open side door of a white van with a shaggy grey dog beside him, the blue ocean and a beach behind them. A drone shot follows the van along a winding coastal road at sunset. Then, on a bare clifftop at dusk, three friends sit on folding chairs around a small open fire built inside a ring of pale stones; the flames burn orange in the middle of the circle and light their faces while a dog sleeps on a blanket beside them and the van stands with its door open behind. Later the friends and the dog sprint across the wet sand of a beach, and at the end they sit together on the open tailgate of the van watching the sun drop into the sea.

4125.expl: A theatre stage under a single beam of spotlight, with the dark silhouetted heads of the audience along the bottom of the frame. Something huge stands on the sand-covered stage floor under a turquoise silk sheet. A man in a white suit walks on from the side, takes the corner of the silk and pulls; the sheet lifts and floats away, and on the stage stands a life-size elephant made entirely of red, orange and white flowers. He steps back and the whole flower skin bursts apart into a curtain of falling petals that pours down over the stage. When the petals clear, a real elephant is standing there in the spotlight with a ring of red flowers on its head, lifting its trunk, and the stage floor is carpeted with petals while the audience films it.

4126.expl: Shot at night on a phone. Two young men climb over a tall black iron fence with spear-shaped tips, next to a red warning sign, and drop down into dark bushes and tree roots on the other side. They walk up through the dark, and then the camera lifts to show where they have come out: a vast city spread below them, thousands of lit windows in tall towers packed along both sides of a dark harbour, with more towers climbing the hillsides and low cloud glowing above them. The two sit down side by side on the concrete edge and look out over the lit-up city.

4127.vo: Here, have some carrot. It's so silky, so soft.
4127.expl: A red dirt track through a dry pine forest. A white and chestnut sifaka lemur comes bounding down the track towards the camera, hopping upright on its back legs with its arms held out. It stops right in front of the camera, sitting up on its hind legs, and a woman's hand offers it a small piece of orange carrot, which it takes in both black hands and nibbles. While it eats, the hand reaches out and strokes the thick white fur of its chest and belly, running over it slowly again and again while the lemur sits still and lets her, staring straight into the camera with big orange eyes.

4128.expl: A sunny back yard behind a house, closed in on all sides by a tall wooden fence, with a brick paved path along the house and a patch of green and dry grass in front of it. A pale golden retriever puppy comes trotting along the brick paving towards the camera, ears flapping and tongue out, then steps down off the paving onto the grass of the yard and keeps coming, tail up. It bounds the last few steps through the grass and drops down right in front of the lens, filling the frame with its face, panting happily in the sunshine.

4129.expl: A grey-blue front door swings open from the inside, showing the hallway of the house behind it: polished wooden floorboards, a carpeted staircase with a striped runner and pictures on the wall. A golden retriever puppy in a mint green bucket hat, a purple harness and a red lead comes trotting out of the hallway, over the threshold and down the brick front steps of the house. Outside, it walks along the pavement in the sunshine with its owner's legs and red lead beside it, past a wooden fence, front gardens and a parked car, tongue out and hat still on.

4130.expl: A bright marble barber's shop with lit mirrors and shelves of bottles. A gorilla sits in the barber's chair under a black cape, with an enormous round afro standing out around its head. A ginger cat in a white barber's coat and a red bow tie stands on the arm of the chair and runs a pair of electric clippers up the side of the afro, cutting a clean line into it. Clumps of black hair drop onto the cape. The cat works its way round, then swaps to scissors and trims across the top, and what is left is a squared-off block of hair with a perfectly level top, like a table top on the gorilla's head. The gorilla looks straight ahead, unimpressed, while the cat finishes and gives a small nod of approval.

4131.expl: A barber's shop with a deep green wall filling the whole background, a mirror and a framed picture hanging on the green paint, and green plants on the counter. A chimpanzee sits in the chair in a green cape with its eyes shut and a big round afro. A ginger cat in a white coat, standing on a wooden stool, works through the hair with a hot styling tool that sends up a puff of steam. The afro comes out sleek and straight, cut into a shiny black bob, and the chimpanzee turns to the camera and grins with the green wall and the green cape all around it.

4132.expl: A marble salon with warm lights and shelves of bottles. A lion sits in a salon chair in a black cape with its head tipped back over a white washbasin. A ginger cat in a white coat sits on its head and works white foam into the mane, then rinses it out with a shower head, so the wet mane hangs down dark and heavy into the basin. The cat then takes a large wooden hairbrush and pulls it down through the long wet mane, stroke after stroke, working out the tangles from the top of the head to the ends hanging over the basin. In the last shots the lion sits up facing the camera with the mane brushed out full and dry, and the cat perched on a stool beside it.

4133.expl: A kitchen with white cupboards and a dark polished wooden floor. A tall stainless steel fridge with a double door, an ice and water dispenser in the left-hand door and a freezer drawer underneath stands against the wall, and a raised metal dog bowl in a wooden stand sits next to it. A man in pink pyjamas crouches down on the floor in front of the fridge next to a golden retriever that is lying there, strokes its back and talks to it. He goes down onto his knees, then lies right down on the floor with his arms round the dog and his head against it, while a second golden retriever lies stretched out on the floor in the foreground.

4134.expl: A barber's shop with a mirror and shelves of bottles. On the black leather seat of the barber's chair sits a very round, very plump hedgehog, so fat that its little legs and paws stick out sideways from a body shaped almost like a ball, with a big round belly hanging over its feet. A ginger cat in a white coat and red bow tie leans in with a pair of electric clippers and runs them over the hedgehog's back, shaving off all the spines. They fall away onto the seat and leave a completely bare, smooth, pale, round body sitting there. The hedgehog looks down at itself, its eyes go wide and its mouth drops open in horror, while the cat covers its own face with a paw.

4135.expl: A football pitch of bright green grass with white markings, laid impossibly high in the air with nothing but sky and a distant lake and forest far below its edges. A young woman in a dark football shirt, black shorts and long socks stands over a white and blue ball on the centre spot. She runs up and strikes the round ball towards the goal at the far end, where the keeper dives across. Then she keeps running, straight on across the pitch to where the green grass simply stops, spreads her arms out wide and leaps off the edge, and the shot follows her turning over and over as she falls through empty blue sky.

4136.vo: Today I'm going to attempt to work out with four golden retrievers. Let's see how it goes.
4136.expl: A home gym with black walls, a squat rack, a red bench and a rack of weights along the wall. A big tattooed man in a white cap and blue T-shirt tries to train with four golden retrievers loose in the room. Lying on the rubber floor working an ab roller, he is swamped by dogs licking his face. He then lies back on the red bench and presses two heavy metal dumbbells straight up over his chest, arms locked out, while one dog climbs up and stands on his stomach and another pushes its nose into his side. At the end he does press-ups on the floor with his hands either side of a dog lying flat underneath him and two more lying on each side.

4137.expl: A pale lilac nursery with a white cot under a cream canopy, a round pink rug on the wooden floor and a cream armchair in the corner, filmed from the doorway. A bearded man is kneeling on the floor in an enormous bright yellow ball gown, the wide yellow skirt spread out all around him over the rug. In front of him a golden retriever sits in a red cape with a white ruff. The man leans down to the dog, picks up a yellow rubber bone from the rug and holds it out; the dog takes the yellow bone in its mouth and holds it there while he strokes its head and talks to it, the yellow skirt filling half the frame.

4138.expl: A man in a white cap kneels on the tarmac drive outside a house and holds out both hands as an old golden retriever steps out of the open door towards him. He takes its head in both hands, rubs its ears and cheeks and kisses the top of its nose. The next shot is inside the open boot of a car, where the dog sits on a blanket beside him with a pink lead and licks at a small tub of vanilla ice cream he holds out. Then in the fenced back garden the dog runs to him across the grass and he crouches down, laughing, and rubs both hands through the fur of its back and sides.

4139.expl: A travel sequence in thick mist. A man in a teal jacket stands on a windswept grassy hilltop swinging a big white sheet through the fog. Then a point-of-view shot looks down at a pair of orange trainers standing at the top of a long, narrow stone stairway that runs straight down the ridge and disappears into the cloud, with a huge rock pillar looming ahead. Next, an empty road runs between two rows of golden ginkgo trees towards a red pagoda under a cliff. In the last shot the man, now with a blue rucksack, walks away up a narrow dirt path worn through the green grass, past a wooden handrail, climbing towards the fog-covered rock tower above.

4140.expl: A run of shots from a trip with friends in wild green hill country. A young man throws himself head first off a high concrete ledge and drops towards the dark water far below; a point-of-view shot from the ledge looks straight down at the white ring of foam where he hit the surface. Someone in an orange shorts and a blue jacket runs down a steep grassy slope in driving wind and mist towards a braided river below. At dusk three friends sit in a row on a narrow wooden plank bridge over a rushing white river, watching the moon over a mountain wall lit orange by the last sun. In the final shot four of them stand on a grassy ridge at sunset with their arms flung wide, one grinning into the camera as the sky burns orange behind them.

A run of shots from a trip with friends in wild green hill country. A young man throws himself head first off a high concrete ledge and drops towards the dark water far below; a point-of-view shot from the ledge looks straight down at the white ring of foam where he hit the surface. Someone in an orange shorts and a blue jacket runs down a steep grassy slope in driving wind and mist towards a braided river below. 4141.expl: A travel sequence. Five young men in swimming shorts lie side by side on their backs on the low heather and grass beside a still forest lake, feet towards the camera, resting in the sun with dark pine trees on the far shore. The next shot shows friends lying stretched out in long grass on a hillside high above a patchwork of green fields, only their heads and knees showing above the grass. Then a point-of-view shot looks down a long red wooden staircase dropping down a green cliff towards a turquoise bay and a white beach far below. In the last shot the camera sits in the grass at the top of a cliff, legs stretched out in front, looking across at a wide waterfall pouring into a gorge under an orange sunset sky.

4142.expl: A short montage of outdoor moments. A big wave breaks over a wall of sand and floods a dug-out pool on the beach at sunset while people watch from the ridge; a man is washed over by the foam. Then a woman floats in a grey-green sea with raindrops hitting the water all around her. Then an empty wet road runs straight into an orange sunset over a snowy plain. Finally a woman in a white shirt and denim skirt spins barefoot and laughing on a wet mountain road in the rain, green cliffs and mist behind her.

4143.expl: The camera looks straight down into a big grey wheelie bin standing on a path in front of green bushes. A raccoon is sitting at the bottom of the bin next to a crumpled green rubbish bag. It looks up at the camera, then stands up on its back legs and stretches both front paws up the smooth inside wall, trying to get out. It slips back down, turns around and curls up, then sits up again and stares at the camera.

4144.expl: A plastic storage box on a wooden floor is filled to the top with pink packing peanuts, and a ferret is digging in the middle of it with only its head showing. Pink peanuts lie scattered all over the floor. A long grey ribbed tube lies bent in a loop on the floor next to the box. Ferrets jump out of the box, run across the wooden floor, dive into one end of the tube and pop out of the other, while another ferret keeps swimming through the peanuts in the box.

4145.expl: Two men in swimming shorts play with a ball in the shallow water of a sunny beach, sailing boats on the blue sea behind them. One man throws himself full length through the air to reach the ball and lands flat in the water with a big splash. Later he leaps up and kicks the ball over his own head with an overhead bicycle kick, both legs in the air. He lands in the water, then stands up in the shallows and raises both fists above his head in triumph while the other man bends over on the sand in the foreground.

4146.expl: A man in a cream sweatshirt walks towards a grey sea at dusk, a thin pink line of sunset on the horizon. He pulls the sweatshirt off over his head as he walks, then runs into the shallow water and drops face down into the foam. He stays there, lying flat on the wet sand with his arms stretched out to the sides and his trainers still on, while the white foam of the waves washes over and around him.

4147.vo: Start the car, go, go, go!
4147.expl: At night in an empty car park in front of a fast-food restaurant, a man in a dark hoodie and cap runs towards a lit-up yellow arch sign. He grabs the sign, pulls it free and hurries back across the tarmac carrying the big yellow piece under his arm. He shoves it through the door of a waiting car, climbs in after it, and the last shot is his face inside the car, laughing, with the yellow sign filling half the frame.

4148.expl: In a concrete parking garage a man in a navy suit runs his hand slowly along the bonnet of a bright red sports car. He opens the door and lowers himself into the red leather seat, then reaches for the start button on the steering wheel and the dials light up. The car rolls out of the garage with its headlights on, and the last shot shows it standing alone in profile on an empty rooftop deck under a grey sky.

4149.expl: An animated cartoon. A small fluffy beaver-like animal with big round eyes falls backwards through a nest of sticks, then tumbles through a grey sky far above the ground. It lands flat on its face on the scaly grey head of an enormous reptile that is floating in a misty lake in front of a pine forest. The little animal sits up, sees the reptile's huge yellow eye opening right under it, and screams with its mouth wide open before running away over the water.

4150.expl: A dark green sports car speeds along a narrow country road, filmed from a camera held close to its side so the grass at the roadside blurs past. Close-ups show the rear wing with the badge on it, and a gold wheel with a yellow brake spinning fast just above the gravel. Another shot runs along the green bonnet towards the road ahead. At the end the car stands still on a sandy track by the dunes with the sea behind it, and a man in a brown t-shirt walks up to it.

4151.expl: A hand holds a bright pink marker over a pencil drawing of a sports car on white paper lying on a wooden table. The hand fills in the bonnet of the car with pink strokes, and the drawing slowly turns from grey lines into a solid pink car. A close-up shows the finished front of the car with its black air vents. At the end the finished picture of the pink car stands on a small wooden easel on the table, with a framed picture of a blue car hanging on the wall above it.

At the end the finished picture of the pink car stands on a small wooden easel on the table, with a framed picture of a blue car hanging on the wall above it.

4152.expl: A large black closed trailer stands on a gravel drive in front of green summer trees, filmed from behind. Its whole back wall begins to tip down slowly, turning into a ramp. As the ramp lowers, the dark inside of the trailer appears and a pale grey sports car is revealed standing inside it. The ramp comes all the way down to the gravel so the car could be driven straight out.

4153.expl: Filmed from inside a car driving on a highway, the shot looks over the bonnet at a bright blue sports car with a big rear wing driving in the same lane ahead. The highway runs straight ahead with white lane markings and a metal crash barrier on the left, green fields and villages on both sides. In front of them stands a wall of grey rocky mountains with snow on the peaks and a long white band of cloud lying across the slopes.

4154.expl: On an orange clay court at night, a woman in a black top, white skirt and blue cap serves a tennis ball. She throws the ball high above her head, swings the racket up and hits it, then runs forward into the court. Floodlights light the court, a green fence runs behind her and palm trees and a lit apartment block stand behind that, with two people watching from a balcony. She then waits with the racket in both hands and plays a forehand back.

4155.expl: In a tiled bathroom, a cartoon-like ginger kitten in a pink t-shirt stands at a toilet holding a white plate smeared with red sauce. It dips the dirty plate into the toilet bowl, then reaches up with one paw and presses the flush button. Blue water swirls round the bowl and the kitten swishes the plate through it. At the end the kitten proudly puts a shining white plate on top of a tall stack of clean plates, with the dirty sauce-covered ones beside it.

4156.vo: Look at this robot. It does dance moves, all this stuff. Do something fun, buddy. He's falling. Grab him! Grab him!
4156.expl: In a garden a small black and white humanoid robot walks along a concrete path towards the camera, its arms swinging, while a young man in a red t-shirt and black shorts walks behind it with his hands out ready to catch it. The robot wobbles and starts to fall; the man rushes forward, dives onto the grass and grabs it. The last shots show the man lying flat on his back on the lawn, laughing, with the robot standing over him.

4157.expl: On a wet tree-lined avenue covered with fallen brown leaves, hundreds of runners in numbered bibs race past the camera on both sides. She stands completely still, smiling, while the runners stream past her towards the start arch in the background.

4158.expl: An animated scene split half above and half below the surface of a bright turquoise sea, with rocky islands in the background. A small brown otter clings to a green bamboo pole that stands straight up out of the water. Behind it a huge grey fish with a wide grin and heavy eyelids floats at the surface, filling most of the frame. The big fish sinks slowly out of sight below the otter, then rises again grinning, and finally disappears completely, leaving the little otter alone hugging the pole.

4159.expl: A point-of-view shot from someone hanging in a harness, with their bare legs and blue-soled trainers dangling in the bottom of the frame. They sweep fast over a steep green mountain meadow, the grass blurring underneath them, and then the ground drops away and they are flying high above a valley. Dark pine forest runs down both sides, a small road winds through the fields below, and the grey rocky peaks of the Dolomites stand against a deep blue sky.

4160.expl: A red sports car with a big black rear wing stands on a narrow strip of tarmac running through orange desert sand, with electricity pylons along the horizon. The car accelerates hard away from the camera and throws up an enormous cloud of orange sand behind it that fills the whole screen. As the sand thins out the car is only a small red dot far down the road, and in the last shot the sand and haze have swallowed it completely and the road is empty.

4161.expl: Two old sports cars stand nose to nose on a concrete driveway in front of a tall green hedge. The camera holds on the front of an orange car on the left, with its round chrome headlight and chrome mirror, and the front of a yellow car on the right, with its indicator and chrome bumper. The camera moves slowly so the two fronts almost touch in the middle of the frame. At the end a man in dark blue overalls and a cap leans over the front of the yellow car and works on it.

4162.expl: A wide, wet stone plaza in Paris at sunset, with the Eiffel Tower rising straight ahead across the river and the columns of a large building on the right. A cream-coloured classic Porsche 911 stands alone on the empty paving in the foreground while the camera drifts slowly sideways past it. The orange sky is full of cloud, a flock of birds turns above the tower, and a few distant people stand at the far edge of the square.

4163.vo: I have always loved mechanical things. The Lamborghini Miura was the first real supercar. You do not just drive it, you have to tame it. It makes you feel in charge.
4163.expl: A man in a dark shirt sits on a metal bar stool in a dim garage beside a yellow classic Lamborghini, speaking to someone off camera about the car while a work lamp glows on the wall behind him. The shot cuts to a close-up travelling along the car's yellow rear deck and its black engine louvres, then back to the man, who reaches out and rests a hand on the bodywork while he keeps talking.

4163.expl: A man in a dark shirt sits on a metal bar stool in a dim garage beside a yellow classic Lamborghini, speaking to someone off camera about the car while a work lamp glows on the wall behind him. The shot cuts to a close-up travelling along the car's yellow rear deck and its black engine louvres, then back to the man, who reaches out and rests a hand on the bodywork while he keeps talking.

4164.expl: A green Lamborghini takes a corner on a race circuit, running over the red-and-white kerb. A close-up then fills the frame with one spinning black wheel: a big red brake caliper is clamped on the dark disc behind the spokes and the yellow wheel-nut turns in the middle. The car is seen from behind on the damp track with its wide rear wing, and the camera finally pans off into a blur of grass and tarmac.

4165.vo: The most important thing is the connection with the car. Every action gets an immediate response. This thing is pure fun, like entering a different dimension.
4165.expl: A young blond man, filmed from the passenger seat of a sports car, drives along a mountain road while he talks; through the side window beside him the trees and the verge rush past as a green blur. The shot cuts outside to a yellow supercar coming fast round a bend below a rock face and a wall of pine forest, then back to him at the wheel.

A close-up shows his hand on the switches beside the steering wheel and the lit instrument dials. He then sits behind the wheel, looking straight ahead through the windscreen.

4167.expl: A point-of-view ride on a chestnut horse in an orange bridle along a wet black-sand beach under a grey sky. The horse walks straight towards a black cliff and into the mouth of a sea cave, and the frame goes almost completely black except for the outline of the horse's ears. A bright doorway of daylight appears ahead, and horse and rider come out again onto the open black beach with a green headland beyond.

4168.expl: A split-screen cartoon of the old fable. In the top half a brown hare bounds over a grassy hill, then sits down, then lies flat on its back asleep. In the bottom half a tortoise plods forward step by step with a purple butterfly beside it and never stops. Behind them the sky turns from green daylight to an orange sunset and then to a starry night with a crescent moon, and the tortoise is still walking.

4169.expl: A man in an Alaska cap and a black hood films himself from a canoe on a wide green river with bushes along the bank. Two brown bears are swimming in the water behind him and one of them comes right up alongside the boat. He keeps his face to the camera and turns only his eyes for a long sideways look at the bear beside him, then relaxes into a grin as it swims past.
