4170.expl: An animated hen leads four yellow chicks across a frozen lake, one chick carrying a white daisy. The ice splits into sharp plates and gives way; the hen and a chick drop into the blue water below and sink among the bubbles. The hen swims up and breaks the surface holding the soaked chick against her chest, lifts it out onto solid ice, and stands over all the chicks huddled together again.

4171.expl: A grey wolf steps out of dense dark leaves onto a stony riverbank and comes slowly towards the camera with its head low. The shot cuts to a close-up of a brown hen, then to two yellow chicks beside a green bamboo tube on the gravel. Back on the wolf, it lies down with its muzzle flat on the wet stones, its amber eyes still following what is happening in front of it.

4172.expl: A grass field burns at dusk in an animated film. A hen snatches up her nest of chicks and flies low over the fire, then lands in a river and pushes through the current with the nest held above the water. She wades out on the far bank, sets the chicks down and drops onto the stones, worn out, while the wildfire still glows on the hillside behind her.

4173.expl: A hen crosses a rope bridge over a deep canyon with a row of yellow chicks tucked along her wings. A big grey wolf comes onto the planks behind her with its teeth bared and runs her down. The bridge gives way: the hen is left hanging from the rope by one wing while the wolf drops away into the mist below. She pulls herself back up and walks on across the bridge towards the sunrise.

4174.expl: A hen carries three yellow chicks in her wings out of a burning barn, beating her wings at the flames in the doorway. Later, under a full moon over a pine forest, the three chicks sit alone on the grass while mice and a red fox creep out of the dark towards them. The hen plants herself in front of the chicks and spreads both wings wide to block the way.

4175.expl: In deep snow at sunset a brown hen creeps low along a drift past a pile of sleeping wolves, one of them curled around a pale egg-shaped stone. She burrows into the snow until only her red comb shows above the surface, waits there, and then stands up covered in snow with a hard stare. The last shot has her out in the open on the pink snow, facing two wolves between bare black trees.

4176.expl: Inside a dark burrow a yellow chick holds a glass jar with a single firefly glowing inside it, and the small flame of the insect lights up its face and its huge eyes. The chick carries the jar to the round mouth of the burrow and looks out at a whole forest filled with thousands of drifting sparks under a full moon. The hen comes and stands beside it in the glow.

4177.expl: A hen runs over a grassy hilltop at sunset carrying a small cloth sack, then climbs a sheer grey rock face with the sack in her beak. At a ledge she tips grain out of the sack into a nest where three grey hawk chicks stretch up with their mouths open wide to be fed. At night the adult hawk lands in front of her beside the sack, wings spread and eyes hard on her.

4178.expl: A hen pecks along a trail of yellow corn spilled over snowy boards beside a wooden fence and squeezes through the gap. She then looks down into a round hole dug in the earth, with a small blue-grey mouse standing at the bottom looking up, and pushes the corn down into it. 4180.expl: An elderly woman in a pink shirt walks a full-grown alligator on a red leash down a tiled colonnade in the sun. A young man carrying a small black puppy stops her and points out that the animal on the leash is an alligator and that her actual dog is right there in his arms. She looks down at it, says she forgot her glasses, and carries on walking.

4182.vo: It is Grandpa's 100th birthday. Time to surprise her with a huge gift.
4182.expl: A young man in a cap crouches on a big garden lawn and sprays purple paint onto the grass through a hose-fed spray gun, leaving coloured shapes behind him. He then leads an elderly white-haired woman, blindfolded with a red cloth, across the freshly painted grass. She takes the blindfold off, gasps with both hands at her face, then sits and lies back on the lawn laughing while a drone rises above her. The camera pulls up to reveal the whole lawn painted as a giant picture reading HAPPY 100 BIRTHDAY GRANPA with orange stars and blue gift boxes.

4183.expl: A young man walks an elderly white-haired woman along a garden path towards a gift box taller than she is, wrapped in white paper with a wide red ribbon and a big red bow. He points at it and she pulls the front panel open like a door. A second young man steps out of the box holding a huge bunch of red heart-shaped balloons and spreads his arms. She raises her hands to her face, then hugs him tightly while the first man stands smiling beside them.

It comes back down the carpet with the ball in its mouth and drops it into the hole in the top of the machine, then waits for the next shot. The same round repeats.

4185.expl: On a yellow woven placemat in a kitchen sits a small grey crocheted mouse with white eyes, pink ears, pink feet and a long pink tail. A hand lowers a white ceramic mug onto the mouse's back and lets go. The mug's weight pushes the mouse's body flat so that only its head, feet and tail stick out from under it, and the mug stands there like it is resting on a coaster. Behind it a plate of waffles with raspberries stands on the table.

4187.expl: Four parrots sit in a row on the back of a beige sofa in front of white curtains: a grey African grey, a white cockatoo with a yellow crest, a blue and gold macaw and a small green parrot. A hand holds a blue and white toy pistol up at them from below and 'shoots' one bird after another. Each parrot in turn flops sideways onto the sofa and lies there motionless with its feet in the air, playing dead, until the whole row has fallen over.

4188.expl: A single skier is a tiny dark figure high on a huge, smooth, untouched snow face under a deep blue sky. He skis down the long incline, throwing up a bright plume of powder snow behind him. The camera pulls back and the whole snow face is revealed dropping away at a steep angle from the ridge at the top all the way down towards the water, with snowy mountain peaks and a fjord catching the low orange sun on the far side.

4189.expl: In a wooden-floored hallway a hand holds a black dog bowl full of brown dry food and pushes a small white pill down into the middle of it, then covers the spot with a dollop of white yoghurt. A black and white husky comes to the bowl and eats. When it lifts its head the bowl is put down on the floor: all the food and the yoghurt are gone and only the single white pill is left lying on the bare bottom of the bowl. The husky sits in the doorway and stares into the camera.

A black and white husky comes to the bowl and eats. When it lifts its head the bowl is put down on the floor: all the food and the yoghurt are gone and only the single white pill is left lying on the bare bottom of the bowl. The husky sits in the doorway and stares into the camera.

4190.expl: A ginger and white cat sits on a low stone ledge outside a zoo enclosure, at the black iron bars. On the other side a huge male lion with a dark mane walks straight up to the bars and lowers its head until its face is right in front of the cat, the two noses almost touching through the bars. A lioness comes up behind and bares her teeth. The cat stays sitting where it is; the lions turn and walk away across the muddy enclosure, and the cat sits calmly at the bars with visitors watching in the distance.

4191.expl: A young man in a black t-shirt jumps up and down with his arms spread wide on the concrete of a launch site at sunset. Behind him, filling the whole frame, stands an enormous stainless-steel rocket lying on its transporter, so big that he only reaches the height of its lower fins. The shot cuts to a low angle looking straight up the shining rocket into the pink evening sky, then to the rocket standing tall in silhouette between two palm trees with the sun behind it. Back at the transporter he jumps again with both fists in the air.

4192.expl: A bald eagle glides low straight towards the camera over flat grey-green sea water, with a dark forested shore behind it. It holds its wings out wide and drops its yellow feet, watching the surface. As it reaches the camera it swings its talons forward, skims the water, and lifts away with a silver fish gripped in both feet, water spraying behind it.

4193.expl: On the brick-paved forecourt of a large brick country house, a whole section of the paving tilts up on a hinge like a huge trapdoor. A dark green Porsche sports car reverses down the opening onto the platform below the paving. The brick lid lowers back over it until the forecourt looks solid again. The last shots are inside the space below the drive: the car parked in a concrete room lit by warm orange wall lights, with the brick ceiling above it.

4194.expl: On a large mown lawn at golden hour, a grown woman in sunglasses, a white t-shirt and white trainers sits in a tiny pink toy jeep, far too small for her, with her legs folded up over the bonnet. She drives it slowly across the grass past a huge old oak tree, filmed from a vehicle following behind her. She steers around, waves an arm, and carries on away from the camera towards a weeping willow, a row of tall poplars and two wooden sheds in the evening light.

4195.expl: A first-person shot from the seat of a red mobility scooter driving down an empty asphalt road between warehouses, straight into a low sun. The rider's hands are on the handlebars and a basket sits on the steering column. The steering column starts to come loose and sinks down; the basket and the handlebars drop away. In the last shots the scooter has come apart completely: a wheel, the basket, the red body panels and the handlebar lie scattered on the road in front of the rider, whose feet are still on the footplate.

4196.expl: A cartoon: a round white character leans over a lit candle that stands in a small grey metal bucket on a bed of straw in a stone cellar. It blows the candle out and the room goes dark, leaving only the bucket and the smoking candle in the gloom. The scene cuts to a bedroom where the same character lies asleep in bed under a blue duvet with a red cap on. A digital clock shows 6:10, four phones lie on the duvet and light up with alarms, and a framed poster on the wall reads WAKE UP. CHASE GOALS. REPEAT. The character sleeps on with its mouth open, drooling.

4197.expl: A cartoon: a round white character with a red cap lies in bed under a blue duvet in a sunlit bedroom, an alarm clock on the bedside table. It picks up its phone, sees 7:01 on the red screen, frowns, puts the phone down and goes back to sleep with a happy smile. Time passes, the light in the room turns brighter. It picks the phone up again and the screen now reads 10:50. Its eyes go wide, it throws the blue duvet up into the air and shoots out of the room, leaving the bare mattress, the flying blanket and a puff of dust behind.

4198.expl: A first-person shot on a narrow concrete pier over bright turquoise sea. The person walks up to a round shaft in the concrete and looks straight down into it: a dark green mossy hole going far down out of sight. They lower themselves in and drop down the shaft, the walls rushing past, the round opening of daylight shrinking above their black trainers. At the bottom the shaft opens under water and they come out over pale sand with orange coral patches on the seabed, still looking down at their own feet.

4199.expl: A paraglider under a red and white wing flies along a grey rock face above a thick pine forest in the mountains. He comes down over a still turquoise lake and pulls his feet through the water, cutting a long white line of spray across the surface, with the whole red wing mirrored in the lake beneath him. He lifts away again, flies over the shore and drops onto a green meadow, where the wing sinks down behind him and a group of people sit at the edge of the grass watching.

4200.expl: A fast drone shot at sunset. It sweeps over a dry clifftop past a single wide tree, where a woman in a white dress stands looking out to sea. It tips over the edge and dives towards a turquoise bay with a natural rock arch in the headland, then races low across the water past a lone swimmer. In the last shots the camera skims the sea surface straight towards the sun on the horizon, and the water and the cloudy sky are one sheet of deep warm yellow light.

4201.expl: Two riders on blue dirt bikes ride side by side across a wide beach at sunset. The sand is covered by a film of water that mirrors the pink and orange clouds so completely that the shot looks like sky above and below. Both riders pull the front wheels of their bikes off the ground and hold them there, so the machines stand almost vertical on their back wheels, their reflections rising to meet them in the wet sand. They ride on into the sunset still standing the bikes up on end.

The sand is covered by a film of water that mirrors the pink and orange clouds so completely that the shot looks like sky above and below. Both riders pull the front wheels of their bikes off the ground and hold them there, so the machines stand almost vertical on their back wheels, their reflections rising to meet them in the wet sand. They ride on into the sunset still standing the bikes up on end.

A hand comes into the shot holding a white kitchen turner and hovers it over the nearest dog's belly, as if about to flip it like something cooking. The dogs do not move; a third dachshund in a green collar walks up to the spatula at the end.

He grips it by the tail, hauls it backwards through the shallow water until it is deep enough to swim, lets go, and steps back to watch it move off on its own into the waves.

4205.expl: A golden hamster comes along a sunlit garden path with a white daisy held in its mouth. It stumbles and goes flat on its face on the paving, the daisy still with it, lies there a moment with its eyes shut, then pushes itself up, sits back on its haunches and holds the daisy against its chest, facing the camera in the low evening light.

4206.expl: A hamster in a pink bow spends a day as an office worker. It sits in a big black office chair at a desk covered in papers with a photo ID badge hanging round its neck on a lanyard, yawns hugely and then dozes off. It fills a small white cup at an office coffee machine, sits on a toilet holding a roll of paper under a framed FOCUS FLUSH FINISH sign, then at five o'clock jumps up at the card reader beside the office door with its badge and walks out through the glass door into the sunset.

4207.expl: A hamster in a pink bow lounges on a small sofa in a dim living room, laughing and then scrolling on a phone. A second hamster in round glasses comes in carrying a pizza box and sets it down on the low table in front of the sofa. The two press their cheeks together, then sit side by side wrapped in a checked blanket, each holding a slice of pepperoni pizza and eating while the television flickers behind them.

Finally it lies flat on its back on the sofa with its belly up, crisps scattered all around it and an open bag of Lay's tipped over on the floor.

4210.expl: A hamster stands on a sunlit wooden kitchen counter with a chocolate-coated ice cream bar in each paw. It keeps the two bars up in front of its face, hiding everything but its ears and whiskers, and holds them there while the sun comes through the window behind it. Then it brings them down and holds them up and out to either side, grinning wide at the camera, with a bite taken out of the bar on the right.

4212.vo: Remember, top with white looks elegant. Wine with camel looks romantic. Mocha with ivory looks soft. Plum with grey looks striking. And sage with cream looks fresh.
4212.expl: A woman and a man stand side by side in a bright white panelled room in front of a cream sofa, posing to camera. Their matching shirt-and-trouser outfits change from one look to the next: both in deep chocolate brown, then cream with a light brown shirt, then tan brown, then dark brown again, and finally pale grey with a beige shirt. The woman changes her small handbag with every outfit so that it matches, and the two lean together and smile between changes.

4216.vo: Remember, if she is wearing red, he goes all black. Main character energy. If she wears white, olive and cream, old money. And if she wears black, tapen and chocolate, quiet luxury.
4216.expl: A couple pose together in a white panelled room in front of a cream sofa. In the first look she wears a deep red satin gown and he an all-black shirt and trousers. Then she wears a sleeveless white tiered cotton dress with white heels while he wears an olive shirt with cream trousers, and they turn to face each other. In the last look she wears a long fitted black dress with black heels and he a tan shirt with dark brown trousers, his arm around her waist.

4217.expl: A corgi drives a small green go-kart straight down the middle of a quiet suburban street of brick houses, its tongue hanging out and its paws up on the steering wheel. Behind it a white police car with POLICE across the bonnet chases it with its blue and red lights flashing, getting closer and closer until it fills the shot right behind the kart, while the corgi keeps driving without looking back.

4218.expl: A corgi sits at the wheel of an old rust-orange tractor and drives it down a narrow road through green vineyards on a sunny day. The camera stays in front of the tractor, filling the frame with its big ribbed radiator grille, round headlamps and upright exhaust pipe. Halfway through, a thick cloud of black smoke bursts from the exhaust pipe as the motor is worked harder, and the tractor keeps rolling towards the camera past the vines and a stone farmhouse on the hill.

4219.expl: Filmed from the back of a huge scaled animal, as a rider would see it. The creature is dark red and black with rows of spines down its neck, horns on its head and an amber eye, and it stands on a cliff above a fjord with a leather saddle and harness strapped over its shoulders. It turns its head, then throws itself off the cliff; the shot dives with it down a gorge past a waterfall, skims low over the water between rock walls, and flies on through fog towards a distant spired castle.

4220.expl: A man in a black t-shirt stands beside a white sports car parked on a road through dry golden hills at sunset. He lifts the front lid and leans in, then works over the bodywork with a grey microfibre cloth, wiping the paint in long strokes in close-up until it is spotless. Close shots follow of the wing mirror and of the rear spoiler rising, and then the car pulls away and drives off down the empty road into the low sun.

4221.expl: A small green cartoon lizard carries a white bowl of colourful star-shaped cereal across a dark living room to a big grey couch, licking its lips. It climbs up the side of the couch with the bowl, gets the bowl onto the cushion, then pulls itself up and settles into the corner of the couch. It tucks a plaid blanket around itself, picks up the remote control, and sits back against the cushions eating from the bowl with the light of the television flickering on its face.

It settles, folds its arms across its chest and grins with its eyes shut, then leans right up to the lens until its face fills the frame.

4223.expl: A green cartoon gecko leans over a white bowl heaped with small red chilli peppers and starts eating them. Its eyes bulge, its skin turns from green to orange to bright red, and a jet of flame shoots out of its open mouth over the bowl. It dives into a tall glass of water and sits curled up inside, still glowing red. Finally it slumps out of the bowl onto the table, back to green, dripping wet with its tongue hanging out.

Then the door opens again and the same lizard comes out completely slim, throwing both arms in the air with a delighted open-mouthed grin.

The hamster leaves the dish, sniffs along the edge of the box and nibbles at its lid until the box opens to show a yellow and green sponge inside, then rears up on its back legs.

The hamster leaves the dish, sniffs along the edge of the box and nibbles at its lid until the box opens to show a yellow and green sponge inside, then rears up on its back legs.

4226.expl: A huge dinosaur crouches at the muddy edge of a jungle river below a tall waterfall and lowers its head to drink. Under the brown water a giant crocodile glides straight towards the camera with its jaws closed. The crocodile explodes out of the shallows in a wall of spray and locks onto the dinosaur, which rears up on its hind legs with the thrashing crocodile hanging from it. A wide shot shows more crocodiles cutting through the water towards the struggle.

4227.vo: Goso. How are you, buddy? You know his name. That's Goso. Have a good day, guys. Nice meeting you. Let's go, boys.
4227.expl: A man in a bucket hat rides a yellow bicycle down a tree-lined park road. An Australian shepherd rides in a wooden crate mounted on the handlebars and a corgi sits on top of his backpack. A police car pulls alongside and a smiling female officer walks over, laughing, and bends down to stroke the dog in the crate while a second officer chats from the car window. Everyone is grinning; then the man pedals away down the shady road.

4228.expl: A man in a khaki shirt climbs into a dark blue helicopter on a sunny airfield. The camera flies low over pine forest and steep green mountains towards a bright turquoise lake. He stands on the grassy shore with his arms spread wide facing the water and the grey rock walls behind it. He then cracks two eggs onto a flat black pan on a small camping stove set on the rocks by the lake, and finally sits at a low wooden table eating the cooked eggs with sliced bread and tomatoes.

4229.expl: A snow monkey with a red face sits hunched on a snowy wooden railing in a forest, sealed inside a thick shell of clear ice that covers its whole body. A person in a dark blue coat and yellow work gloves leans in and taps at the ice with a small hammer. The shell cracks, and the person lifts the whole hollow casing of ice off the monkey and holds it up, dripping with icicles. Underneath, the monkey shakes itself out on the railing, loose and dry.

4230.vo: Evening. Where y'all coming from? Oh, you know, we were just out there hunting squirrels. Why does your friend look like that? Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing. Code 3.
4230.expl: At night, a torch shines into the open window of a dark red pickup truck. A golden retriever in a camouflage jacket and cap sits upright in the driver's seat with a paw on the steering wheel, staring back at the camera. In the seat beside it a dachshund in an orange hat sits stiffly. Nobody moves for a long moment. Then the shot cuts to the truck's red tail lights speeding away down an unlit country road.

4231.vo: You know why I pulled you over? I don't know. But something's wrong with the stop sign. It won't turn green. Step out of the vehicle. Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing.
4231.expl: At night the camera looks at the closed side window of a dark red pickup truck. The glass is completely fogged up, with only vague golden shapes moving behind it. The window clears and shows two golden retrievers in the cab, both wearing baseball caps, one with a paw up on the door, as pale smoke drifts out around them. They sit there staring out. Then the truck pulls away and speeds off down a dark road.

4232.vo: Hey buddy, do you like Mesa? Do you like Ronaldo? Can you show us Ronaldo's overhead kick?
4232.expl: At a marine park with palm trees and empty rows of stadium seating, a shirtless man crouches at the edge of a big turquoise pool holding a large silver ball and talks to a bottlenose dolphin resting at the wall. The dolphin lifts its head and listens, then backs off into open water, launches itself high into the air upside down and strikes the ball away with its tail. The man leaps up with both hands on his head, mouth wide open, watching the ball fly off into the blue sky.

4233.expl: A drone films a tall bridge built of stone blocks, its arches and piers rising out of a green jungle gorge, with an enormous waterfall pouring down the cliff directly behind it. A freight train with a blue locomotive and dark red wagons rolls slowly across the top of the stonework. The camera pulls back to show the full height of the falls, the water breaking into white threads over the rock while the train crosses in front of them.

4234.expl: In a cartoon bedroom a woman in blue pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair stands with both arms flung up, scowling. The shot cuts to a large walk-in closet, its shelves stacked with neatly folded jumpers in every colour and a rail of bright dresses. A man rushes through it in a blur, dragging everything off the shelves and rails until a huge mound of clothes fills the floor. He ends up standing on top of the pile with his arms spread wide, laughing.

4235.expl: A barefoot boy in a black t-shirt and blue shorts stands on the grass at the edge of a still lake at sunset. He whips a fishing rod forward over his head and the line arcs far out across the orange water. He follows through and stands watching the line settle, silhouetted against the sky. The shot then cuts to his hands close up, holding the rod and a silver reel wound with turquoise line, with the sunset and the far shore behind.

4236.expl: Two young men in yellow high-visibility vests and work boots lift a large flat-screen television down from the back of a white delivery van on a city street. As they carry it, a woman in a short brown dress and heels walks past on the pavement. Both men turn their heads to follow her, still holding the heavy screen between them, and one nearly loses his grip. They set the television down and stand with their hands on their hips, watching her walk away.

4238.expl: Two hands rinse a raw rack of lamb ribs in a fast mountain stream, with green hills and grazing horses behind. The rack is then laid on a flat stone slab set over glowing red coals and slowly browns, steaming, with the sun low over the hills. A man inflates a big white tent on the grass with an orange pump. Inside the tent, on a patterned carpet, two men sit at a low wooden table and eat the roasted ribs, which are served on a bed of lettuce with cherry tomatoes.

4239.vo: Ready, my friend? It's my first time. Okay, easy, easy. No more tricks. Take me to the tower.
4239.expl: A first-person shot shows two gloved hands holding leather reins that run to a seagull flying just ahead, harnessed like a horse. The gull carries the camera over a huge suspension bridge half lost in fog, then drops down and races along a narrow strip of green water between two big red cargo ships tied up at a dock. It skims through the spray, and finally levels out over the harbour towards a white lighthouse with a city skyline behind it.

4240.expl: In a carpeted living room next to a white curtain, one husky rolls on its back with its paws in the air while a second husky stands over it, nosing at it. The camera closes in on one of them looking straight into the lens.

4241.expl: A young man in a white pilot's shirt with gold striped shoulder boards and a green headset with a boom microphone sits in the cockpit and looks into the camera. The view swings forward through the windscreen: deep blue sky above a flat white deck of cloud stretching to the horizon. The aircraft sinks into the cloud until everything outside is featureless grey, then breaks out low over flat ground. Finally the nose lines up with a grey runway and the centre line and markings rush past underneath.

4242.expl: A ginger-and-white cat and a tabby cat sit side by side on a dark polished tiled hallway floor, looking up at the camera. A tall white metal safety gate blocks the doorway behind them. The ginger cat walks up to the gate and slips between its bars into the dark room beyond. The tabby then crosses to a small square cat flap set low in the white wall next to the gate, pushes its head through and squeezes its whole body out, until only its striped tail is left in the hallway.

4243.expl: A black cat in a red apron works behind a street hot dog stand while a husky stands at the grill behind it turning sausages with tongs. A customer's hand holds a turquoise bank card out to the card reader on the counter. The cat lays a sausage into a long bun, then squeezes a zigzag of ketchup along it from a red bottle, and finally lifts the finished hot dog up to the camera.

4244.expl: Filmed from inside a car at sunset. On a gravel track beside a wooden fence a big brown longhorn bull walks along with a small white dog next to it, kicking up dust. The bull turns on the dog and they tumble together in a cloud of dust. Cut to two young men in the car, mouths wide open screaming and laughing. The bull then runs straight down the track towards the car, horns forward, and pushes its huge shaggy head right up against the open car window until its nose and horns fill the whole frame.

4245.expl: A long concrete aqueduct wall runs through a jungle of tall palm trees, with water spilling over its edge as a wide waterfall. Young men lie on their backs in the shallow water on top of the concrete channel and slide along it with their arms flung out, throwing up spray. They then stand under the falling water at the foot of the wall, the white torrent pouring over their heads and shoulders. A drone shot pulls back to show the whole mossy wall, the sheet of falling water and one man still sliding along the top, surrounded by green jungle.

4246.expl: Inside a wooden aviary with wire mesh walls in a green wood, a young woman in a green T-shirt and a baseball cap holds a large peacock in her arms and laughs. The bird's deep blue neck and chest fill most of the frame, its crest standing up on its head and its scaly clawed feet dangling against her arm. It leans its head in towards her face, and at the end stretches its long blue neck straight towards the camera until the shining blue feathers fill the shot.

4247.expl: A drone looks down on a huge flat field of bright green rice. In the middle of it sits a round stone well full of dark water, with a narrow footpath leading to it through the crop. A line of boys in red shorts stands along the well's stone rim; one after another they jump in, each landing with a white burst of spray. The last shot is straight down from above: five of them float on their backs in the round pool of water in a star shape, the green field all around.

4248.expl: A huge artificial wave pool inside a hall, with a steel roof, rows of ceiling lights and windows along the upper wall. A big turquoise wave rolls across the pool and a person on an orange board rides down its face before the white foam swallows them. The wave collapses into churning white water that fills the frame, and the person is left swimming through the foam. Staff in red stand watching on the concrete deck above.

4249.expl: A first-person view from the back of a flying red dragon. Two hands grip a saddle horn in the bottom of the frame and the dragon's broad red back, covered in rows of dark spikes running down the spine, stretches away in front. The dragon glides over green valleys, blue lakes and waterfalls, then tips forward and dives towards a canyon where two waterfalls fall into a river. It raises its head and blows a burst of fire up into the sky with its wings spread wide, and finally levels off and glides towards a golden sunset over a wide lake.

4250.expl: A tall storage warehouse with long aisles and racking stacked to the roof with wrapped pallets. In the foreground a chihuahua wearing a yellow hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest stands on its hind legs looking off to the side. Behind it a golden retriever drives an orange forklift carrying pallets of bottled water, while another small dog in a hi-vis vest walks down the aisle. The forklift catches the stack and the pallets of water burst apart, spilling packs of bottles all over the concrete floor. The chihuahua turns to the camera with wide eyes.

4251.vo: This is your side, and this is my side, okay? Okay. Where am I supposed to put my clothes? Here, put them here.
4251.expl: An animated walk-in wardrobe. A hand points along a completely bare wooden shelf and an empty hanging rail on one side of the room, then sweeps across to the other side. The camera pulls back to show the whole wardrobe crammed with pink and purple clothes on the rails and folded in stacks on every shelf, with a deep heap of clothes covering the floor. A muscular cartoon man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers stands in the middle of the heap staring at it, and the shot closes in on his shocked face.

4252.expl: A back garden with a large above-ground pool standing on a wide concrete patio, its slabs marked out by straight joint lines. A young man in sunglasses lies on a patterned Persian rug spread on the concrete, propped on one elbow under a small black umbrella, sipping an orange drink through a straw. Behind him another man in a white T-shirt scrubs the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush, pushing white soapy foam across the slabs. More rugs lie drying on the concrete and the whole patio is covered in suds and water.

4253.expl: A motocross rider sits on a green dirt bike in a wet paddock, caked from helmet to boots in thick brown mud, so that the goggles and the whole suit are one solid brown crust. Two mechanics in team shirts and caps work on him with a pressure hose: one wipes the mud off the helmet with a cloth while the other kneels and blasts water over the rider's legs and the bike. Brown water runs off in sheets and the green bodywork of the bike appears clean again under the mud.

4254.vo: One iced latte with oat milk. Ma'am, we only do fried chicken. No, sweetie. I said oat milk. The customer is always-- Fried pigeon, limited time.
4254.expl: An animated fried chicken shop at dusk. A grumpy ginger cat in a white chef's hat and a stained white apron stands behind the metal counter, with lit menu boards of fried chicken above and a deep fryer full of bubbling oil set into the counter in front of it. A pigeon stands on the counter arguing with the cat, which scowls back with narrowed green eyes. The pigeon then flaps wildly, tips over the edge and drops into the bubbling fryer. A single feather floats down and the cat stares at it open-mouthed.

4256.expl: A grey kangaroo stands upright on a green hillside pasture under a grey sky, with gum trees and a fence in the distance. A person's hand reaches in from the side and scratches the kangaroo's chest and neck with the fingers. The kangaroo half closes its eyes and leans into the hand, then slowly sinks down and lies flat out on the grass, stretching its long back legs and heavy tail behind it while the hand keeps scratching its head and neck.

4257.expl: An animated pond scene. A baby panda and a small green turtle swim underwater below a big lily pad, blowing streams of bubbles, while a grumpy fish watches from behind. They shoot up out of the water and fly through the air above a sunlit bamboo forest with their arms and legs flung out and shocked faces. Then the panda sits on a huge floating lily pad with the turtle clamped in a tight hug against its chest, arms wrapped right around the shell; the grumpy fish pokes its head out of the water below. The last shot shows the panda squeezing the turtle close among pink water lilies.

4258.expl: A long curved steel slide runs down a green mountain meadow, its polished grey chute filling the bottom half of the frame, with dark pine forest and hills behind. A spotted fawn lies curled up in the steel chute at the top of the slide. It sits up and looks straight down the slide at the camera with its ears out, settles back down into the chute, then gets to its feet and walks off into the tall grass beside the slide.

4259.expl: A stop-motion woolly sheep with a curly white fleece, a fluffy tuft on its head and an orange knitted scarf stands against a bright blue sky dotted with white clouds. It starts with a flat, bored face and heavy eyelids, then opens its mouth wide in a shout that shows its square teeth. Its face settles into a hard frown, the eyebrows pulled down over the eyes, and the camera pushes in until only the scowling face fills the screen.

4260.expl: A dark bedroom at night, lit only by a small bedside lamp and the glow of a tablet. A man lies in bed under a thick cream knitted blanket watching the tablet, its light on his face, with a golden retriever lying on the bed beside him. In the lit doorway behind them a dark human figure appears and stands still, only its outline visible against the blue light of the hall. The man falls asleep with his head back and the tablet resting on his chest while the figure keeps standing there, then he is awake and watching the tablet again with the dog still beside him.

4261.expl: A rectangular garden pool with a blue rim and clear turquoise water stands on a lawn in bright sunshine, with a row of small conifers and a dark fence behind it. Two Jack Russell terriers swim in the pool pushing a big red ball with their noses. One paddles across the pool nudging the ball ahead of it towards the camera, water sparkling in the sun, while the second dog swims behind. At the end the red ball rests against the sunlit edge of the pool in close-up with the second terrier still paddling towards it.

4262.expl: A mother brown bear and two cubs walk along a wide grey sand flat at low tide, below a steep mountainside streaked with snow, with pale glacial water behind them. A black raven stands on the sand nearby, spreads its wings and hops aside as the cubs trot past. The family walks on along the shoreline and away from the camera.

4265.expl: A green cartoon parrot with a blazing red crest storms into a wood-panelled living room, wings spread and beak open in fury. A large blue parrot gets off the sofa and folds a wing around it. The red crest sinks and drains from fire-red to pale yellow to soft green, and the angry bird stops shouting, leans into the hug and closes its eyes.

4267.expl: A small white Pomeranian stands on a dark grooming table in front of a window looking onto a sunny green garden. A groomer works round it with scissors, snipping the straggly hair on its back and legs; little tufts of white fur drop onto the table. The dog pants happily, screws its eyes shut while its face is cupped and shaped, and ends up with a perfectly round, smooth, even coat.

4269.expl: A woman in a bright patterned tunic and blue headscarf stands over a raised bed of bone-dry earth in a courtyard full of terracotta pots. The soil is pale and split into a web of deep cracks. Wearing gardening gloves she tips water from a clay jug and then from a brass watering can; the water vanishes straight into the cracks, spreading dark wet patches until the whole bed is soaked and brown.

4270.expl: A point-of-view shot from inside a go-kart: a driver in a bright striped racing suit grips the small steering wheel and speeds along a sunlit tarmac circuit with red and white kerbs, tyre barriers and eucalyptus trees, another kart running ahead. Then a duck waddles out onto the track in front, and the kart drops from full speed to a crawl and creeps along behind the bird until it has crossed.

4272.expl: A woman in a plain white shirt and black trousers stands in a clothes shop between rails of colourful dresses. One by one she puts on shining gold pieces: big gold hoop earrings, then fine gold chains at her neck, then a thick stack of gold bangles on her wrist, then a red belt with a heavy gold buckle. She finishes the look with a wide straw hat, sunglasses and two bags and presents herself to the camera.

4273.expl: An illustrated street scene at dusk. A dark blue saloon has run head-on into the side of a beige hatchback in the middle of a crossroads; the blue car's bonnet is folded up and smoking and one hubcap has rolled away across the road among scattered broken glass. A man in a brown jacket throws both arms up in shock while a man in a green coat runs to the hatchback's driver door. Bystanders watch from the pavement in front of lit shopfronts.

4274.expl: In a sunny supermarket car park a white delivery van has run into the back corner of a grey car. The car's rear wing is caved in and the tail light is smashed against the van's bumper. Both drivers, in matching blue work shirts, get out and clutch their heads in dismay, then lean over the car's boot photographing the crushed panel with their phones and filling in a form.

4275.expl: A shopping centre car park in bright sun. A white car has hit the rear side of a grey saloon, tearing a long crease through the wing and cracking the tail light, with black debris on the tarmac. An older woman in a light blue shirt grabs her head, shouts, and then keeps pointing and talking at the damage and at the young man beside her, while he crouches to photograph the torn panel with his phone and writes on a form propped on the other car's boot.

4276.expl: A very old woman with white hair, in a lilac coat and scarf, walks slowly up a narrow cobbled street of tiled houses with a wooden walking stick. A young man in an apron and a nurse in blue scrubs walk on either side of her, each holding an arm, and several neighbours follow behind. At the top they help her up the stone steps to a blue tiled doorway, and she turns round at the door, smiling, with the little group gathered round her.

4277.expl: A woman in a white shirt and grey cardigan sits at a desk buried under thick stacks of receipts and invoices, lit by a desk lamp at night. She frowns over a long till receipt held up in one hand, runs a red pen down a ruled ledger full of columns of figures, circles one number in red, taps the big black calculator, and finally throws both fists in the air in triumph.

4279.expl: An art-deco poster of a theatre interior. A man in a gold and black geometric suit stands alone in a bright spotlight on the stage, one hand pressed to his heart and the other flung out, head thrown back as he declaims. Heavy crimson and gold curtains are swagged back on either side of the stage, and rows of empty seats stretch away into the dark behind him.

A big studio lamp on a tall stand shines on her from the left, a boom microphone hangs in from the right, and an empty wooden director's chair stands beside her.

4281.expl: A guide in a khaki shirt stands in dense green rainforest holding a leafy twig with a bright green chameleon on it, grinning into the camera. He slides a piece of rough brown bark under the animal; it steps across onto the wood and its skin turns from green to a striped orange-brown that matches the bark exactly. He stares at it wide-eyed and delighted.

4282.vo: It's him. He's all yours. Let's go home.
4282.expl: A couple crouches at a wire kennel door inside an animal rescue centre and greets a tan dog through the mesh; a staff member in a green polo shirt opens the kennel and the couple hug the dog; at the front desk the same woman stamps their adoption paperwork; the couple then walk the dog out on a red leash down the bright corridor and out through the exit.

4293.expl: A watercolour of a twin-engine passenger jet climbing steeply away just after take-off with its landing gear still down, filling the sky above an airport; below it runs a long runway with centre-line markings, an orange windsock on a pole, a lit runway edge light, and in the distance the control tower and terminal with parked aircraft, all under peach-coloured evening clouds with a flock of small birds.

4294.expl: A plane spotter in a keffiyeh with a DSLR on a strap stands at an airport perimeter fence looking up and grinning; a twin-engine airliner crosses just above the fence behind him, and then a far bigger four-engine jumbo passes directly over his head with its landing gear down, so close that its belly and wheels fill the whole frame while he ducks and laughs.

4295.expl: In the desert beside an airport, a man in a grey thobe and keffiyeh with a camera round his neck points up at an airliner coming in over the sand and the perimeter fence; he lifts the camera to his eye and shoots as the green-and-white jet passes low overhead with its gear down, then turns back to the lens grinning as the plane rolls out on the runway behind him.

4296.expl: An illustrated view down from an airport control tower at sunset: ground marshals in orange vests stand on the apron with both arms raised holding marshalling wands to guide the aircraft in, a tug tows a train of baggage carts past a dropped suitcase, fuel tankers cross the taxiway, airliners sit at their jet bridges, and beyond the grass another plane lifts off the runway under a windsock.

4297.expl: A young traveller with a grey neck pillow and a rolling suitcase turns to the camera in a small airport lounge with a propeller plane parked outside; she then rides an escalator down through a huge terminal beneath an enormous departures board covered in flight listings, past rows of luggage trolleys and crowds, and past an indoor waterfall with airliners lined up at the windows behind it, her mouth open in amazement.

4300.expl: An inked comic-book panel of a narrow night-time alley between two brick tenements: metal dustbins in the foreground are heaped over the rim with crumpled paper and waste, a hooded figure runs down the wet cobbles clutching a satchel, a ginger cat leaps off a dumpster lid, steam pours from a grate in the ground, and fire escapes and washing lines criss-cross the dark blue sky above.

4301.expl: A young traveller with a backpack and a camera walks away down a whitewashed blue lane in a Moroccan medina hung with drying laundry, then turns into an extremely tight slot between two blue-painted walls; he edges through the narrow space almost sideways with a wall at his chest and his back, looking up at the sliver of sky above him, and squeezes out of the far end laughing.

4302.expl: A neon-lit city street at night in heavy rain. An ambulance with red and blue roof lights stands in a flooded road, its rear doors thrown wide open and the bright interior visible. Two paramedics in reflective coats push a wheeled stretcher up to the open back of the vehicle. Bystanders in hooded coats watch from the pavement while traffic light streaks reflect in the wet asphalt.

4303.expl: A sunny narrow street of old apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies. A white emergency vehicle marked with orange stripes and blue star-of-life symbols is parked at the kerb with its blue lights flashing. The camera moves in on the bonnet and windscreen, then two crew members in yellow high-visibility jackets walk across the road carrying a red bag toward a cafe terrace where people sit at tables.

4304.expl: Golden evening light on a suburban street. A bearded man in a cream-and-brown varsity jacket and a grey cap has just released an oval brown ball, which hangs in the air at the top right of the frame. Behind him a white clapboard house flies a striped flag from its porch, a chrome-sided diner stands across the road and an old muscle car is parked at the kerb.

4305.expl: A backyard party at sunset. A man in a denim shirt and backwards cap flips burgers on a smoking barbecue. He then turns and holds out a plate with a huge stacked burger to a small boy in a striped t-shirt, who throws his fists up and shouts with delight. The man plays catch on the lawn with a leather glove, and finally sits on the tailgate of a red pickup while the guests behind him cheer with raised cups.

4306.expl: Tall metal gates topped with coiled razor wire swing open at sunset. Men walk out one by one carrying their belongings in cardboard boxes, past a uniformed officer standing in the gateway. Families waiting on the road outside rush forward; a woman throws her arms around a grey-bearded man and sobs, and soon the whole road is filled with couples and families holding each other in the low orange light.

4307.expl: A hand-drawn night scene in a packed stadium stand. Four long strips of cloth in brown, blue, dark red and gold stream sideways from tall poles above the terrace against a starry blue sky. Below them rows of people in winter coats, scarves and flat caps stand with their hands on their chests, mouths open in song; white puffs of breath show in the cold air.

Rows of men and women in dark winter jackets stand shoulder to shoulder, singing with their heads back and their hands pressed to their chests, breath steaming in the cold. Behind them hundreds more hold club scarves in dark red, blue and yellow stretched above their heads in a long line up the stand.

4309.expl: Close-up of a footballer in a green and gold shirt standing in a line before a match at night. She has her hand flat on her chest and sings, tears running down both cheeks and her eyes red. Her team-mates stand beside her doing the same. A flag flies from a pole behind her, and the packed stand of spectators also stands with hands on their hearts.

Her team-mates stand in a line with their arms around each other's shoulders, singing toward the packed stand where a green flag waves. The camera returns to her; she is crying too hard to go on and covers her eyes with her hand.

4311.expl: An outdoor basketball court on a bright summer day. A young man with curly hair in a grey vest laughs as he bounces the ball, watched by a semicircle of onlookers. A man in a business suit leaps and lays the ball into the hoop. The young man then passes the ball to a white-haired elderly woman holding shopping bags, who shoots; everyone looks up as the ball drops through the net, and a courier in a yellow jacket rides up on a bike to take his turn while the crowd claps.

Four curved yellow arcs are drawn in the air in front of his mouth to show the sound travelling out across the empty desert; there is nobody else in the picture.

4313.expl: A bar room with exposed brick, wooden tables and strings of fairy lights across the ceiling. A man in a denim shirt holds a microphone out toward the camera; pints of beer stand on the table in front of him. He offers the microphone to three young women at a table, who laugh; then a bearded man in a high-visibility jacket takes it, puts a hand on his chest and belts out a song while the drinkers around him clap. Finally an elderly woman in a cream cardigan sings into the microphone as the whole room cheers behind her.

4314.expl: A watercolour of a bright holiday flat seen from the open front door, the key still in the lock. A young man with a backpack wheels a large suitcase in across the terracotta tiles. At the far end a woman pushes open the louvered balcony doors onto a blue sea view and the net curtains billow inward. On the tiled kitchen counter in the foreground stands a bowl holding four round orange fruits and a bunch of purple grapes; a beige sofa with folded towels sits beside it.

4315.expl: A woman in a beige trench coat walks through flats one after another. First a cramped room with a bed pushed against the wall, a boiler above it, a radiator and a small cooker by a narrow window. Then a small living room with a grey sofa and a balcony door, where she sits down and the caption 1,200 EUR appears over her. Finally she stands in a vast empty glass-walled floor high above a city, turning to look around with her mouth open as the caption 10,000 EUR appears.

4316.vo: I'm so sorry. My fault, all mine, needed for less.
4316.expl: An office desk by a window. A young man in a knitted vest and glasses sits with his head bowed low over the desk, holding a wrapped bunch of white and yellow tulips; a large brown puddle of spilled coffee covers the laptop keyboard beside him. He sits up, grimaces at the mess and points at himself as he speaks, then mops the keyboard with a cloth. A woman colleague comes and stands over him with her arms folded; he bows deeply and holds the tulips up to her, and she takes them.

4317.expl: A cafe table by a window. A man in a camel coat and a woman in a black polo neck both freeze open-mouthed as spilled drink spreads across the wooden table and soaks the open sketchbook in front of her. He leans in talking fast, pulls napkins from the holder and blots the wet page, then lifts the book clear. He comes back with a cup of coffee, sets it down in front of her and speaks with his hands open; she turns to him and smiles.

4318.expl: A darkened hall with a red-lit stage at the front where a performer stands beside a microphone stand. In the seats a bearded man in a mustard shirt, sunglasses pushed up on his head, claps his hands together over and over with a broad smile, watching the stage. The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.

The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.

4319.expl: A make-up studio with a bulb-lit mirror. A woman with a white towel wrapped round her hair sits with her eyes closed; separate stripes of skin-coloured cream have been dabbed on her forehead and cheeks. A hand dabs an orange sponge over them until the stripes disappear into her skin and the tone is even. A red-haired make-up artist then sweeps powder over her cheek with a brush, and in close-up paints her lips with a dark red lipstick. At the end the woman looks up with an even, finished face and red lips.

4320.expl: A watercolour of a bright studio with tall windows. A man in a light blue shirt leans over a large wooden table covered with big sheets of technical drawings showing rooms and walls in fine line. He steadies a metal rule with one hand and draws along it with a yellow pencil. Rolled-up sheets, a second pencil, an eraser and an angled desk lamp lie on the table, and a small white card model of a flat-roofed house stands on a base board at the right.

4321.expl: A glass-walled office. A woman in a headscarf and a beige blazer leans over a large technical drawing, holding a rule down and marking it with a yellow pencil while two colleagues lean in on either side. She then stands at a table holding a miniature city built in beige card and plastic, with tiny tower blocks, low houses, roads, green lawns and little trees, and reaches in to adjust one of the small towers. Finally she stands outdoors in a yellow hard hat, holding a drawing up in front of a real cluster of tall glass towers.

4322.expl: A charcoal and pencil sketch of a street scene: a man in a dark suit and a woman in a long dark dress dance a tango in the middle of a cobbled street, her body arched back against his arm, their faces almost touching. Behind them a musician in a flat cap sits on a wooden chair playing a bandoneon. A flag with a sun in the middle hangs from a pole on the left, and tall wooden houses with balconies line the street.

4323.expl: A photograph of a narrow cobbled lane running between rows of brightly painted corrugated-iron houses — red, blue, yellow — with a yellow iron balcony above on the left. The lane narrows away towards a low sun at the far end. In the middle of it a couple dance: a man in a brown waistcoat holds a woman in a long grey skirt in a dance hold, both leaning into a long step.

4324.expl: A young man with curly hair and a light blue and white striped scarf walks along a colourful street, then sits at a shaded outdoor table drinking from a mate gourd through a metal straw. The clip then cuts to him standing alone at a viewing railing in front of an enormous wall of blue glacier ice that fills the whole frame behind him and stretches out of shot on both sides. He is tiny against it, and he throws both arms out wide.

4325.expl: A colourful illustration of an open grassy plain. A young man in a wide-brimmed hat, poncho and baggy trousers stands with his back half turned, whirling a set of weighted cords above his head. A brown horse rears up in a cloud of dust behind him on the left. Across the middle of the plain several dark cows graze in a loose group, and behind them stand purple mountains. On the right a light-blue and white flag flies from a pole beside a saddle blanket with a gourd and a metal kettle on it.

4326.expl: A photograph taken at sunset on a flat grassy plain with a low white farmhouse in the distance. A man in a black beret and a work shirt lifts a heavy iron grill rack loaded with racks of ribs off a long open fire pit, sending a shower of orange sparks up. The pit below is full of burning logs and a thick bed of pale ash. A rough wooden table on the left holds a mate gourd with a metal straw, and the pit itself is framed with thick wooden beams.

4327.expl: Outdoors at sunset, a young man tends a large grill covered with sausages and racks of ribs over glowing embers. Behind him a long table with a white cloth is lined with friends and family sitting on both sides, drinks and plates in front of them, watching and clapping. He spoons green herb sauce over the meat, cuts into it with a long knife, then lifts a piece on the knife towards the camera with his mouth open in delight while the people at the table cheer.

4328.expl: A loose watercolour of a living room. A young woman has flopped backwards into a large floral armchair with her legs thrown up over the back, feet in the air, and has just tossed a yellow cushion up above her — it hangs in mid-air over the chair. A tall floor lamp stands to the left, a mug sits on a small wooden side table to the right, and a big window with curtains fills the background. On the pale floor in front of the chair lies a patterned rug with a fringed edge, and a second cushion has landed on the floor beside it.

4329.expl: Three short shots of people sitting down in different rooms. First a young man perches on a small pale upholstered chair in a bare corner of an empty room. Then an older woman lowers herself onto a large sofa piled with patterned cushions in a bright living room full of plants, a side table and a window seat. Finally an older man sinks back into a big brown leather armchair in a room lined with tall bookcases, stretching his legs out in front of him.

4330.expl: A photograph of a wide dirt parade ground under a clear blue sky. Rows and rows of young soldiers in matching tan uniforms and brown boots move forward in step, all with the same leg swung out and the same arm thrown straight up in front of them. One soldier at the front wears a tan helmet. Behind them the ranks stretch back to a long concrete wall with coloured flags on poles above it, and dust rises around their boots.

4331.expl: A low camera on a road looks up at columns of cadets in dark green dress uniforms with gold trim, red stripes and white gloves, all stepping forward in perfect time down the centre line of a city street. A woman officer leads one column. The camera then pulls back to show the columns filling a wide boulevard between tall buildings, with drummers carrying side drums at the front. In the last shots a crowd stands packed behind metal barriers on the pavement, waving white, blue and red flags and clapping as the columns pass.

4332.expl: A comic sketch filmed outside a warehouse. A uniformed police officer stands behind a man dressed as a cartoon burglar — black and white striped suit and cap, black eye mask, a grey swag bag over his shoulder — and clicks handcuffs onto his wrists behind his back against a brick wall. As they walk, brightly coloured plastic gems and rubber chickens tumble out of the bag onto the ground. The officer then holds the burglar by the arm and walks him across the yard to a waiting police car and puts him in the back, with the film crew watching from the side.

4333.expl: A grey train slides to a stop alongside a raised strip of paving in a large railway station with a high arched glass roof. The doors open and a young woman with bleached hair, a green jacket and a black backpack steps down out of the carriage pulling a silver suitcase, grinning. She walks along the raised strip beside the train, past other passengers and departure screens, and at the end of it a group of friends run up and pile into a group hug around her.

4334.expl: An oil painting of a bright, cluttered work room. A woman in a paint-spattered white smock stands at a tall wooden easel by a large window, a wooden palette loaded with yellow, blue and red paint balanced on her arm and a brush raised to the canvas. Blank stretched canvases lean in stacks against the walls and the easel, framed paintings hang behind her, jars of brushes stand on a stool and a low table, and squeezed tubes of paint lie on the table beside her.

4335.expl: In a tiered lecture hall a young woman in a mustard jumper and round glasses sits at a desk in the middle rows, throws one arm straight up and speaks towards the front, eyebrows up. Around her the other students sit taking notes. Then more and more hands go up around her, until in the last shots the whole hall — row after row of students — has a hand in the air, all looking towards the front and speaking at once.

4336.expl: In an empty flat with bare walls and a parquet floor, a man in a grey beanie holds up a folded printed sheet covered in line drawings and reads it while a woman in work trousers kneels and screws round wooden legs onto a white seat. The finished stool stands on the floor. The two of them then hold the sides of a low wooden shelf unit and stand it up, and finally push together and lift a tall wooden wardrobe with shelves inside, closing its doors and stepping back to look at it.

4337.expl: An anime-style drawing of an office corridor with glass-walled meeting rooms. A young woman in a teal trouser suit hurries straight towards the camera with a mobile phone wedged between her ear and her shoulder, mouth open in mid-sentence. She clutches a stack of buff folders against her chest with one arm and balances a cardboard tray of four takeaway coffee cups on the other hand. Loose sheets of paper and pens fly out behind her, and two colleagues stand talking further down the corridor.

4338.expl: A comic-style night scene in the rain. A wet grey cash machine is set into a concrete wall, its screen glowing pink and blue, a bank card sticking half out of the card slot at the top. A fan of banknotes is spraying out of the money slot in the middle of the machine, and one more note flutters away through the air on the left. A young woman in fingerless gloves reaches for the flying note with one hand while her other hand rests on the keypad. Behind her the wet street reflects neon city lights.

4339.expl: A woman in a beige blazer pushes a card into the slot of a cash machine on a busy street, then keys something in. The clip cuts to her walking up to a row of cash machines inside a bright hall, each set into the wall under its own lit sign, and then to a longer row of machines with different bank logos above them where travellers with suitcases stand waiting to use them. Finally she stands in front of one of the machines fanning a thick stack of banknotes in both hands, mouth open in delight.

4340.expl: A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.

4341.expl: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.

4342.expl: A pencil-sketch attic under sloping roof beams. A young woman in a work shirt and loose trousers has both hands on the rope handle of a heavy wooden trunk and is dragging it across the bare floorboards towards the viewer, leaning her whole weight back and bending her knees. Dust rises in clouds around the trunk and off the torn dust sheet it has pulled off the furniture. Behind her stand two stacked suitcases with an oil lantern on top, a rocking chair, rolled rugs and a small dirty window; cobwebs hang from the beams in the foreground.

4343.expl: A soft pastel cartoon of a bright child's playroom. A young woman with a brown ponytail in a rainbow-striped jumper spins on the spot with three small children hanging off her: a boy on her back, a toddler girl held out at arm's length in the air, and another girl clinging to her leg. All four have their mouths wide open, eyes screwed up, heads thrown back. A polka-dot party hat and a rainbow lollipop fly out of the spin. Balloons float at the left, cushions are scattered on the floor, and a wooden toy box full of teddy bears and building blocks stands by the wall.

4344.expl: A warm, sunlit home kitchen photographed from the doorway. An older woman in a patterned apron stands behind a younger woman in a flour-dusted apron and hugs her from behind, both arms wrapped round her chest, their cheeks pressed together. Both are laughing with their eyes closed; there is flour on the younger one's face and on their hands. On the wooden kitchen island in front of them sits a black baking tray of golden pastries just out of the oven, with steam and a metal mixing bowl beside it. Open shelves of jars and spices line the walls, ladles and knives hang on rails, and an oven with a checked tea towel stands to the left.

4345.expl: A woman in a bright multicoloured patterned jacket steps through an open front door carrying a tall stack of wrapped presents with big bows. Two children run at her in the hallway and she laughs down at them. She then holds the phone out for a selfie with a boy and a girl pressed to either cheek — all three have their eyes wide and their mouths open in a scream of delight. She dances through the living room with the children pulling at her hands. The last shot pulls back on a full birthday party: a ceiling of coloured balloons, guests dancing, and a birthday cake with lit candles surrounded by wrapped presents on the coffee table.

4346.expl: A photographic outback scene at sunset. A man in a wide-brimmed bush hat and dusty work clothes walks across bare red sand with a canvas duffel bag slung over one shoulder, turning to look back over his shoulder at the camera; his boot kicks up a puff of red dust. Behind and to his right a mob of five or six grey kangaroos is bounding past through the spinifex grass, each caught in mid-air with its long tail out behind it and its back legs tucked under. A huge red rock monolith glows orange in the low sun on the horizon, with scattered trees and dry golden grass in front of it.

4347.expl: A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.

4348.expl: A photograph of a wide sandy beach on a clear day. A woman in a plain black one-piece swimsuit runs up out of the shallows with a pale, well-used surfboard clamped under her right arm. Her hair is wet and pushed back, her arms and legs are muscular, one foot is off the ground and sand sprays out from under her heel. A wave curls and breaks behind her. Two red-and-yellow patrol flags stand in the sand on either side of the frame, and a wooden lifeguard tower sits on the grassy dune behind.

4349.expl: A young man in the red-and-yellow uniform of a surf rescue service — yellow shirt, red shorts and a yellow-and-red cap — runs down the wet sand towards the sea carrying a rescue board. He paddles out, gets to his feet and rides a clean green wave, crouching low with one arm out for balance, then drives up through the white water with spray flying around him. In the last shot he walks back out of the shallows straight at the camera, grinning, holding the tall yellow rescue board upright beside him; a yellow flag banner stands on the beach behind.

4350.expl: An illustrated alpine scene. A boy in a flat cap, white shirt and red waistcoat runs down a dirt track waving a thin stick above his head, driving a small herd of brown-and-white cows ahead of him. Each cow has a big brass bell hanging from a wide collar under its neck, drawn large and golden in the foreground. A wooden chalet with a stone base and a shingled roof stands on the slope behind them. The meadow is full of small white, yellow and blue wildflowers; further down the valley there are haystacks, barns, a blue lake and snow-capped peaks under heavy purple clouds.

4351.expl: A red-haired woman in a long cream trench coat over a floral dress turns and walks backwards across the gravel forecourt of a huge yellow baroque palace, laughing, with tall fountains playing behind her. The clip cuts inside to a grand hall lit by crystal chandeliers: she leans forward on the wide, honey-coloured polished stone balustrade of a staircase, her forearms resting on its veined surface, and looks down at a string quartet playing on the patterned floor below between two more stone columns. It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.

It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.

4352.expl: A bold comic-book illustration of a skier coming down a steep white slope. She wears a red, white and blue race suit, a blue helmet and mirrored goggles, and is leaning hard into a change of direction: her knees are bent, her body is tipped over towards the inside of the curve, both skis are up on their edges and a thick wall of snow sprays up off them to her left. Both poles trail behind her and speed lines streak down the slope. Above and behind, a cable lift carries red and yellow cabins over dark pine trees, with white mountain peaks and a few clouds in the blue sky.

4353.expl: A young pastry chef in a white chef's jacket and a white bow tie stands at a marble counter in an ornate café. He holds a jug high and pours a thick stream of dark chocolate glaze over the top of a round sponge cake that sits on a white marble cake stand; the glaze runs down the sides. He smooths the top flat with a long palette knife, then pipes a chocolate signature across it from a paper piping bag. He slides a knife under a wedge and lifts it clear of the cake, showing the dark layers inside. In the last shot he holds a white plate up to the camera with the slice on it next to a tall swirl of whipped cream, smiling.

4354.expl: A woodcut-style illustration of an autumn wood in ochre, orange and brown. A woman in a chunky knitted jumper, a long knitted scarf and lace-up boots leans back against a thick tree trunk with one hand, swings her right leg forward and sends a fan of dry orange and red leaves flying up off the path in front of her. More leaves spiral down from the bare branches overhead. A squirrel sits on a fallen log beside the leaf-covered path further back, and acorns and chestnuts lie among the leaves in the foreground.

4355.expl: A soft pastel cartoon seen from above. A round-cheeked baby with one curl of hair, huge shining eyes and a wide open smile lies on its back on a white playmat printed with stars and little animal faces. It wears a pink top and a mint-green nappy, and it is waving both fists in the air and kicking its bare feet up so the toes point at the camera. A pink and blue rattle hovers just above it, still shaking. Adult hands reach in towards the baby from both bottom corners, and teddy bears, folded blankets and soft toys lie around the edge of the mat with sparkles drawn in the air.

4356.expl: A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.

4357.expl: A watercolour of a young woman stopped on a stony mountain trail, seen from behind and slightly to the side, her brown hair blowing across her face as she looks back down the path. She carries an enormous pale khaki rucksack made of thick woven cloth, painted so the weave and the creases show, with brown leather straps, buckles and a stitched patch on the lid, and a dented tin mug clipped to one side. One loose strap hangs down and trails on the ground behind her. The narrow path winds away below through rocks and pine trees, with blue ridges of hills and tall white clouds behind.

4358.expl: A young man in a blue bandana headband and a khaki shirt stands on a sunlit ridge path and holds up a small flat black shoulder pouch in both hands, laughing at how little it is. The clip cuts and he is swinging on a large black expedition rucksack, gripping both shoulder straps. It cuts again and the pack has grown into a tower far above his head: a rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, and blackened pots, pans and a kettle hung all over the sides and bottom. He leans forward under it with both hands hooked into the straps, knees bent, grinning at the camera as he walks up the ridge; other walkers follow far behind on the path.

4359.expl: A black-and-white retro cartoon of a city pavement. A wide-eyed boy in a white shirt and dark shorts has tripped and is falling backwards, both white-gloved hands flung out and his mouth open in shock, one shoe kicking up in the air. In front of him a big paper grocery bag has split down the side, and its contents are flying out: three round metal tins with ribbed lids and paper labels, a baguette, a sliced loaf, a jar and several apples, with a stream of liquid spraying out of one tin. Another apple bounces along the pavement to the right. A curved street lamp, a shop awning, a blank hanging shop sign and two blurred passers-by fill the background.

4360.expl: A woman with long braids in a bright orange and blue patterned dress stands on a sunny city street with a plain tote over one shoulder. She holds a paper gift bag open by its handles and leans over it, eyes wide and mouth open with delight at what is inside. The clip cuts to her walking down the bright concourse of a shopping centre towards the camera with three or four paper shop bags hanging from each hand, past lit shopfronts. It ends on a rising escalator: she stands with bags stacked over both forearms and holds up a patterned brown leather handbag in one hand and a large black leather holdall in the other, grinning straight at the camera.

4361.expl: A woman in a bright floral dress stands on a sunny city street holding up two big brown paper shopping bags, one in each hand, grinning. She then walks through a shopping centre past lit storefronts with bags hanging off both arms, adds more bags and totes, and finally rides up an escalator hugging a pile of paper bags to her chest.

4362.expl: A neon-lit illustration of an airport arrivals hall at night. A long metal conveyor belt curves through the middle of the frame carrying suitcases and bags along it. Empty luggage trolleys stand along the wall.

4365.expl: An older woman pulls a tray of just-baked golden rolls out of the oven in a country kitchen. A younger woman in a red apron turns to the camera holding a warm loaf of bread in one hand and a berry tart in the other, mouth open in delight. The table fills with steaming rolls, croissants, loaves and pies straight from the oven, and both women throw their arms up beside it.

4366.expl: A watercolour of a man at work in a bakery. He wears a flour-dusted apron over rolled-up sleeves and holds a long wooden peel with two golden loaves on the end, sliding them out of a glowing brick oven. Smoke drifts up, baguettes hang from a rail, finished rolls sit on the shelves behind him and sacks of flour stand below. He is smiling as he works.

A person in a grey robe leans on the iron balcony railing looking down at the street, with potted plants beside them, telephone poles and swirling clouds behind.

4368.expl: A woman in a beige dress steps through open French doors onto a small rooftop terrace at sunset. She bends over the potted lemon tree and smaller plants along the railing. Then she reaches to the string of little bulbs looped along the railing and they come on, glowing warm against the darkening rooftops. She stands with an espresso cup watching the sun go down over the city.

4369.expl: In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.

4370.expl: A black-and-white noir illustration of a bank interior. The huge round steel door of the strongroom stands open at the back, its thick locking wheel and bolts showing, with neat stacks of banknotes on the shelves inside. In the foreground a man in a hat slides a bundle of notes across the marble counter to a clerk behind brass railings, while another man in a long coat walks across the chequered floor.

At the back a man in a suit turns the wheel of the huge round steel door and she stares into the corridor of deposit boxes behind it.

4374.expl: A cartoon of a barber's shop. Behind him are a big oval mirror, a striped barber's pole and shelves of bottles.

4376.expl: A woman lies on the grass in a dog park filming herself. A small fluffy white dog plants itself right in front of the camera, opens its mouth wide and starts barking at it. A big spotted dog and a large black-and-white dog behind join in with their heads up and mouths open, and the two women sitting behind pull shocked faces and clap their hands over their ears while the little dog keeps going.
