4377.expl: A young man stands at the bottom of a wooden staircase under the house, grinning up at the camera, and leads his friend down. They pass through a dim storeroom lined with metal shelves of paint tins and cardboard boxes, where the friend hugs himself and shivers, then along a dark corridor. He pushes a door open and the two of them stand looking at a home cinema: a big white screen on the wall with a projector above it, rows of leather seats and a popcorn machine.

4378.expl: A teenage boy squeezes into a tiny bathroom to brush his teeth, standing over the toilet with a chrome shower head and hose on the tiled wall right behind him. Cut to a door opening on a family bathroom where a woman lines coloured rubber ducks along the edge of the bath. Cut again to an older man in a bathrobe pushing open tall double doors onto an enormous marble bathroom with a skylight, a freestanding tub and two shower heads on the glass-walled wall behind him.

4379.expl: A stained-glass style picture of a woman cleaning a bathroom. She leans over a big white roll-top bath in yellow rubber gloves, scrubbing the inside with a stiff brush. The bath is full of white suds and they are spilling over the rim in a wave onto the tiled floor around her bare feet. A brass tap and shower fitting sit at the head of the bath, a towel hangs on the rail and a washbasin stands in the foreground.

4380.expl: A woman in a colourful head wrap and a pastel robe leans over the edge of an empty white bathtub and turns on the tap. Water pours from the tap into the tub. Bottles of shampoo and bath products stand on the ledge behind her. The camera drops down inside the tub and watches from the water line as the running water and bath foam build up, more and more white bubbles spreading across the surface until the whole tub is full of thick foam. In the last shot she is lying back in the full tub with foam up to her chin, eyes closed, smiling, a small blob of foam on her nose.

4381.expl: A pastel cartoon beach on a bright sunny day. Striped parasols and towels are spread out over the yellow sand, with a bucket and spade beside one of them. A girl in a swimsuit and wrap skirt runs barefoot along the water's edge with her hair streaming behind her, while a beach ball bounces beside her. Seagulls glide overhead and a big sun hangs over the sea.

4383.expl: In a barbershop a young man in a white shirt strokes his freshly shaved chin. The shot cuts to a barber at work, then to a customer whose enormous black beard is being combed out — it is dense and bushy and hangs well down his chest. Then the door opens and an older man walks in with a beard so full and long that it reaches past his waist, and he holds it up proudly for the camera.

Finally €20,000 over a huge four-poster bed in a dark red room, where a man in a silk robe throws himself backwards onto the covers.

The third is a grand wood-panelled bedroom where a man in a robe pulls open heavy curtains beside a four-poster bed.

4387.expl: Three very different bedrooms are put side by side. First a teenager's room with a poster-covered wall and two guitars, where a lad throws himself onto a narrow bed. Then a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman unfolds a white futon on the floor. Finally a dark luxury hotel bedroom with wood panelling, where a man in a robe opens the curtains onto a sea view and drops backwards onto the enormous bed.

4389.expl: A swimming race in an indoor pool. A row of swimmers launch off the starting blocks together, but one swimmer is left standing alone on his block. Then she sits at a table with a whole pepperoni pizza in front of her and one lit candle, and takes a bite straight from the slice. Finally she carries the pizza box through to her bedroom and lies back across the bed by herself, smiling.

4394.expl: In a garden a woman holds a clear plastic strip in both hands and pulls the ends down so that it curves into an arch in front of her face, pulling a delighted expression. She does the same with a thick tree branch, hauling it down into a curve over her head. Then on the grass a girl in a leotard drops backwards into a full crab position with her whole body arched, while the woman crouches beside her with her mouth open.

4397.expl: A young man in a green jacket films himself riding an old city bike through Amsterdam. He pedals over a brick street lined with narrow gabled houses and parked bikes, then along a canal with boats moored under bare trees, then past a brick building and in through a wide entrance. Inside he rides down the aisle of an enormous multi-storey bicycle park, racks of bikes stacked to the ceiling on both sides, and points up at them.

Then she is standing in Times Square at dusk, turning on the spot under towers of huge lit advertising screens and grinning up at them.

4400.expl: An anime-style drawing of a woman standing on a grassy clifftop above the sea, holding a battered pair of binoculars up to her eyes with both hands. In each big round lens you can see what she has picked out far away: the open sea and a line of small birds flying over it.

4401.expl: A woman in a khaki field vest stands at the edge of a bright turquoise mountain lake and holds black binoculars to her eyes, scanning the far shore and the pine slopes behind it. She lowers them, reacts, and lifts them again. The scene cuts to a canyon overlook at dusk, where she steps up to a coin-operated tower viewer on a post, grips the handles and presses her face to the eyepiece to look at the rock formations miles away across the canyon.

4402.expl: A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.

He throws it over himself, then another, then another, each one a different colour and pattern, until he is buried under a thick pile of woollen blankets with only his grinning face showing above them.

4404.expl: A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.

4405.expl: A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.

4406.expl: A woman sits at a lit vanity mirror with hard stripes of pale foundation and dark contour drawn across her cheek and forehead. A makeup artist works over them with an orange sponge, dabbing and pressing until the edges disappear, then goes over the same areas with a soft brush. The harsh lines melt into an even, glowing complexion, and at the end she is shown the finished face in a hand mirror.

4409.vo: I can't see anything. This way?
4409.expl: At a house party hung with paper streamers and balloons, a woman with a rainbow cloth tied over her eyes gropes forward with both hands out, laughing, while others reach towards her. Outside in the garden, a blindfolded person swings at a piñata hanging from a beam. Back inside, the whole group is blindfolded, stumbling around the living room with their arms out until they take the blindfolds off and swing the piñata sticks.

4410.vo: Oh, I blinked. You blinked. Don't blink.
4410.expl: An extreme close-up of a wide-open eye opens the clip. Friends in a living room sit facing each other in pairs, nose to nose, eyes stretched wide, each trying to outlast the other without shutting their eyes. One pair after another is shown straining. Finally somebody loses, and the whole room bursts out laughing and points at the loser.

4411.expl: High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.

4412.expl: A delivery driver in a hi-vis vest leans out of his van window in a narrow old town street where a parked lorry leaves him no room to pass. He edges into a market square full of crates and market stalls that leave no way through. Then, on a mountain road, a whole flock of sheep fills the tarmac from verge to verge and walks straight at the van; the driver leans out shouting while the shepherd waves him back and the sheep press against the door.

4414.expl: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.

4415.expl: In a café strung with fairy lights, a young woman with bright red cheeks hides her face behind both hands, then peeks out and gives a small embarrassed wave. Another woman opens a handwritten note, reads it and goes pink to the ears, grinning at the page. At a table of cappuccinos the whole group laughs together, everyone's cheeks flushed, as they say nice things to each other.

4416.expl: At a check-in desk a small printer pushes out a long strip of boarding passes and a hand circles the gate number on it with a blue pen. A traveller with long braids takes hers, reads it and smiles, then holds the printed card against the scanner at the automatic gate until the light turns green. She walks down the jet bridge, through the aircraft door past the crew, and along the aisle looking for her seat.

Next she walks along a gangway onto a small blue and white ferry moored at a sunny harbour. Finally she climbs the aircraft steps onto a plane on the runway and turns at the top of the stairs to wave before going in.

4418.expl: In a rustic kitchen a woman in an embroidered blouse leans over a gas hob where a blue flame burns under a small saucepan. Beside it a big pot of water rolls at a full boil and white steam streams off the surface towards the window. She reaches for a huge lidded pot, lifts the heavy lid, and a thick white cloud of steam bursts up into her face; she rears back with her mouth open.

4419.expl: A soft pastel cartoon of a girl in dungarees and a striped top sitting in a little wooden boat on a calm pond. She holds an oar in each hand, one blade lifted clear of the water and flicking up droplets, the other dipping in and leaving a swirl behind it. A golden puppy lies over the bow watching the water; lily pads, bulrushes, a small jetty and rounded hills fill the background.

4420.expl: An old book plate on yellowed, foxed paper inside a hand-inked border. In the middle, drawn entirely in fine brown pen strokes, is a single long thigh bone seen at an angle: the round ball at the hip end at the top right, the smooth shaft running diagonally down, the two knobs of the knee end at the bottom left. Dense cross-hatching behind it gives the shading and shadow.

4421.expl: In a classroom a girl in a mustard jumper holds a small white bone up close to the camera between her finger and thumb, other pupils working at desks behind her. She turns to a hanging plastic skeleton and lifts a long thigh bone off a grey tray with both hands, turning it so the knobbly ends show; more long bones lie on the tray beside her. The scene cuts to a museum hall where she looks up open-mouthed at the huge mounted skeleton of a dinosaur and points up at its ribcage.

4423.expl: A sunlit desert checkpoint photographed from the side. A long red and white striped boom bar is raised at a steep angle across the top of the frame, its counterweight end low on the left. Under it a person in an olive jacket with a canvas backpack walks over a broad white line painted on the cracked asphalt, kicking up a small puff of dust. A white concrete marker post stands to the left, a plain wooden guard hut to the right, and behind them a chain link fence and bare brown mountains under a clear blue sky.

4424.expl: A selfie video on a road bridge on a bright winter day. A young man in a black beanie with a rucksack holds a small passport in one hand and grins at the camera; behind him two flags snap on poles and a queue of cars waits at a lifted red and white boom bar. He walks on along the footway past a glass control booth, and a broad painted stripe in blue, white and red runs across the road surface beneath his feet. He looks down at the painted stripe, steps over it, and walks on with the river and the far bank in view.

4425.expl: A comic book style drawing of a meeting room high in a futuristic city. A tall robot in a business suit leans right over a glass table, one metal hand slammed flat on the surface hard enough to send a cracking flash out from under it, the other arm flung out pointing at the screen on the wall behind him. His visor glows and his mouth is set in a hard grin. A cup has been knocked over and a pen has bounced into the air. Around the table three other robots shrink back, hands raised to their heads, glowing tablets in front of them.

4426.expl: A woman in a navy trouser suit stands at a whiteboard covered in hand drawn line graphs and pie charts and points at one rising red line while a colleague listens from the table. She turns and walks down the long glass walled room to a table where six colleagues sit with laptops and folders. She leans across the table, hands over a red folder and shakes a colleague's hand. Finally she stands at the head of the table with her arms folded, smiling into the camera while the team works behind her.

4427.expl: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.

4429.expl: A close up on a marble kitchen counter: a cardboard box tips and coloured cereal rings tumble down into a large turquoise bowl, and one pink ring drops last into the milk. The video then cuts to a wood panelled noodle restaurant with two orange paper lanterns glowing on the wall behind. A woman in a grey shirt sits at a dark wooden table holding an enormous white bowl of ramen with both hands, mouth open in delight. She lifts a thick bundle of noodles clear of the broth with chopsticks, steam rising, then dips the chopsticks back into the bowl.

4430.expl: A soft cartoon of a small child with thick curly brown hair, big brown eyes and pink cheeks, laughing with his mouth wide open. He wears a yellow t shirt, rolled up blue denim shorts, white socks and red trainers, and he is caught mid run with both arms flung out and one foot lifted behind him. In front of his other foot sits a large ball painted with red, blue and yellow stripes and dots. Behind him are rounded green trees, pale grass and a soft blue sky with two white clouds.

4431.expl: A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.

4432.expl: A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.

4433.expl: A loose pen and watercolour sketch of a doorstep at evening. A young man in a beige jacket stands side on in the foreground, glancing back over his shoulder with a small pleased smile, one hand in his pocket. In his other hand, held down behind his back, he grips the stems of a big bundle of flowers: red and pink roses and yellow blooms gathered together, with a single petal drifting away. Behind him the front door stands open with warm yellow light spilling out, a young woman inside clapping her hands to her face in delight, a lantern glowing on the wall and terracotta pots either side of the step.

In his other hand, held down behind his back, he grips the stems of a big bundle of flowers: red and pink roses and yellow blooms gathered together, with a single petal drifting away. Behind him the front door stands open with warm yellow light spilling out, a young woman inside clapping her hands to her face in delight, a lantern glowing on the wall and terracotta pots either side of the step.

4434.expl: At a fairground a young man in a college jacket hands a young woman a giant light brown teddy bear in front of a red and white striped stall hung with more teddy prizes, and she hugs it with her mouth open in surprise. They walk on together past the metal rails under a big ferris wheel, and he lays his jacket over her shoulders while she holds the bear. She laughs into the camera holding a white ice cream cone, and he holds another. In the last shot the two of them sit side by side high up on the wheel with the bear on her lap, the whole fair spread out below them with striped tents, stalls and rides.

4435.expl: In the bright hall of a science museum a woman in a denim jacket holds a small pink model of a brain in both hands close to the camera, frowning at it; behind her are display stands and other visitors. She turns the model over in her fingers and studies it. She then leans over a low white display counter set with several large anatomical brain models on stands and points at one of them. Finally she stands in front of a huge glowing pink brain sculpture mounted on a purple wall and looks up at it with her mouth open.

4436.expl: A colour cartoon of a beach in Rio. A player in a yellow shirt, blue shorts and brown boots is upside down in mid air doing an overhead bicycle kick, sand spraying up behind his heel and a worn brown ball flying off above him. A green and yellow flag flies on a pole at the left, and behind the beach rise a green mountain topped by a statue with outstretched arms and the rounded peak of another headland. On the right three children stand with their arms thrown up and their mouths wide open, and on the left a boy watches with his mouth open too.

4438.expl: A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.

4439.expl: A photograph taken at dusk in a narrow cobbled street between old colonial houses with lit windows and glowing wall lamps. In the middle a young drummer marches towards the camera wearing an enormous headdress of green, blue and gold feathers and a matching feathered shoulder piece over a bare chest, a big wooden barrel drum slung at his waist and a beater raised in his hand. Behind and beside him a whole band of drummers in bright shirts play more drums, dancers in gold costumes move among them, and paper streamers in green, yellow and pink fly through the air with bunting strung overhead and the low sun burning at the end of the street.

4440.expl: In a sunny garden dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands barefoot on the mats, other students in white suits watching from the sides. She sets her fists, drops her weight and brings her hand down onto two wooden boards laid across a low wooden stand, splitting them. The stand is reloaded with a block of blue tiles and she raises her fist high above her head and drives it down through them. Finally she squares up to a tall stack of grey concrete slabs, strikes the top of the stack with her hand, and broken pieces fall away onto the mats.

4441.expl: A woman in a bright patchwork ski jacket and striped hat stands on packed snow high in the mountains, the Matterhorn sharp against a deep blue sky behind her. She looks straight into the camera, purses her lips and breathes out hard, and a thick white cloud of warm air bursts from her mouth and drifts away in the cold. She does it again, laughing, and other walkers standing further back on the snow do the same, so several white puffs hang in the air at once.

4442.expl: A hand-drawn illustration of a bright dressing room. A young woman in a long white gown with a veil spins on the spot, her wide skirt lifting and swinging out around her, and she holds a bunch of white daisies up in one hand. As the skirt swings up it uncovers her feet: she wears a pair of plain white shoes with a low heel, one flat on the carpet and one lifted behind her as she turns. Behind her are a tall gold-framed mirror, a bright window with cream curtains, vases of flowers and a dress bag hanging on a hook.

4443.expl: In a bright room two women do up the long row of small buttons on the back of a young woman's white gown, then lower a veil over her dark hair while she smiles. The scene cuts outside to a garden hung with festoon lights and palm trees, where guests in suits and pastel dresses sit in white chairs on either side of a stone path. The young woman walks slowly down the middle between them, veil over her face, holding a big bouquet of white roses, and the seated guests turn and smile at her as she passes.

4445.expl: A young couple walk hand in hand through a wooden garden arch, then lean on a mossy stone wall looking out over the water at a long stone bridge with tall arches carrying a road across a bay. The camera drops to show three pairs of trainers standing side by side on the concrete, then the couple stand together at the red railings of a huge red suspension bridge, holding hands and looking up at its towers and cables as the road runs away from them across the water. The man turns to the camera by one of the red towers, laughing and pointing up at it.

4446.expl: Inside a dark wooden pub, a smiling man in a grey coat leans across a wooden table and knocks his tall glass against another one held by the person filming. Both glasses are full of amber beer with a white head, and you can see the light coming straight through the clear glass and the drink inside. Behind him the pub is fitted with panels of frosted, patterned glass above the bar and beside the windows, with a dartboard, brass beer taps and other drinkers laughing in the background.

4447.expl: An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.

4448.expl: A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.

4450.expl: A cartoon of a children's bedroom with a wooden bunk bed. A laughing boy in blue dungarees carries a smaller boy upside down over his shoulder. The dungarees are worn out and have square patches of a different shade of cloth stitched onto the leg and the hip, the stitching drawn as a line of little dashes around each one. On the lower bunk lies a quilt sewn together from many differently coloured squares, and a cushion made of the same patched squares flies through the air above them, while toy trucks, wooden blocks, a rugby ball and a skateboard lie on the floor.

4451.expl: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.

4452.expl: A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.

4454.expl: A young man stirs a red bucket of foaming water with a wooden stick beside a car on a drive. The clip cuts to an orchard, where a woman lifts a metal bucket full of red apples, tilts it right over towards the camera and lets the apples pour out and roll all over a wooden picnic table; she then sits behind the scattered fruit and bites into one. In the last scene a man kneels on a beach, turns a striped bucket upside down onto the sand, lifts it away and leaves a sandcastle standing, then throws his arms up.

4455.expl: A drawn scene of a piece of open ground where a house is going up. Metal scaffolding poles rise on the left over a half-built brick wall, a concrete mixer turns on its stand, and two wheelbarrows full of wet mortar stand on the bare earth. In the middle a man in an orange hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest kneels on the ground, spreading mortar with a trowel and setting a brick into place, with a spirit level lying along the top of the courses and a stack of spare bricks beside him.

4456.expl: A man in a green bomber jacket walks along a street past an old red-brick block with washing hung out over its small balconies, and puts his hand on the worn brickwork. He steps back and looks up, and right beside the old block stands a tall new tower of blue-green glass and steel that runs up out of the frame. He walks round to its front, where a smooth curved glass revolving door turns in a flat stone facade, and stares up at the rows of glass panels. The clip ends with him at the foot of an old stone building with tall columns and a heavy wooden door.

4457.expl: On a beach at dusk a young woman in a denim jacket crouches over a fire. The fire is ringed by a circle of big pale blocks of rough natural stone, laid one against the next on the sand to make a low wall around the flames, and their grainy, pitted surfaces are lit up orange by the fire inside. She leans over the stones and feeds thin sticks into the middle, the flames climb up between them, and she sits back on her heels with the stone ring glowing in front of her while the sea and two figures show dark behind.

4458.expl: A young man in a stained apron stands in a small home kitchen while everything he is cooking goes wrong at once. Two slices of toast, black and smoking, pop up in the toaster in the foreground. He turns to a frying pan of vegetables on the gas hob and pushes them around with a spatula, wincing. Smoke drifts across the room. He opens the oven and a cloud of smoke rolls out around a roasting bird; he flaps a blue-striped tea towel at the smoke, coughing, the kitchen hazy behind him.

4459.expl: Evening on a beach, sea and dark headland behind. A woman in a checked shirt sits at a low concrete fire pit holding long skewers of marshmallows over the fire. One marshmallow catches light and burns with a tall orange flame right in front of the camera; she pulls back, laughing and open-mouthed. She lowers the other skewers into the flames, and the fire builds until a column of fire and sparks fills the frame against the dark blue sky.

4460.expl: A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.

4461.vo: My friends bury me in the sand! Only my head is out.
4461.expl: A bright beach with blue sea and sky. Two pairs of hands scoop and throw loose sand, working over a body-shaped mound; a pair of bare feet still sticks out at the far end. A hand pats the sand flat along the mound. The camera moves round to the head of the mound, where a grinning young man in sunglasses is buried up to the neck, only his head above the sand. He laughs and talks to the camera while the others keep patting sand around him.

4462.expl: A graveside in a cemetery on a grey day, bare trees and headstones behind. A family in black coats and dark suits stands around an open grave with a pale wooden coffin lowered into it. A woman in a black headscarf steps forward and lays a single white rose on the lid. An elderly man drops a handful of earth onto the coffin. Two workers in overalls shovel soil down onto it from both sides until a mound of brown earth covers the lid, the white rose still on top, while the mourners stand with their heads bowed.

4463.expl: A soft pastel cartoon of the inside of a bus, seen from behind the passengers. The driver sits at the wheel in a dark blue uniform and peaked cap, smiling broadly with one hand raised in a wave to the people getting on. A ticket roll unspools from the dashboard beside him. In the foreground, a woman in pink, two small children and a boy holding a fluffy dog look up at him, one child waving back. Sunlight comes through the windscreen and the open door.

4464.expl: A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.

4465.expl: A man in a cap with a shoulder bag travels through a city by bus. He waits by the roadside as a small van passes, then steps up into a white city bus through the front door. A red double-decker bus drives past tall glass office towers. He climbs the narrow staircase inside the double-decker up to the open top deck, and at the top he throws both arms wide and shouts with delight as the bus drives on between the skyscrapers.

4466.expl: A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.

4467.expl: A woodcut-style illustration of a butcher at work behind his block. He wears a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a green striped apron, and has a heavy moustache. One hand holds a raw steak flat on a thick wooden chopping block while the other swings a big cleaver up above his head, ready to bring it down. Behind him a rail runs across the wall with strings of sausages and whole cured hams hanging from steel hooks, a slab of meat on the bone at the right, and three knives on a wall rack.

4468.expl: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.

4469.expl: A fine black-and-white pen drawing of a kitchen. A young man in a shirt and jeans stands on tiptoe and pulls open the tall wooden wall unit above the worktop, one hand on the swinging door and the other reaching up into it. The shelves inside are packed with stacked plates, tins and rows of preserving jars. Two jars have already tipped out and are falling through the air towards the floor, one past the tiled wall and one large in the foreground.

4470.expl: A man in a light blue shirt stands at the white wall units of a bright kitchen with a patterned tile splashback. He opens the doors of an empty cupboard and shows the bare wooden shelves. He then puts the dishes away shelf by shelf: stacks of coloured plates, nests of green and blue bowls, a pile of purple plates lifted up from below. He closes the doors, opens them again, and the cupboard is now full — rainbow stacks of plates and bowls on the lower shelf and rows of coloured preserving jars along the upper one. He steps back and looks at it.

4471.expl: A dramatic painted illustration of a cable car high in the mountains. A red and cream cabin hangs from a thick steel cable, tilted as it swings past a steel lattice pylon capped with icicles, with snow spraying off the wheels. Passengers in winter clothes look out of the windows and one points ahead; a figure in a yellow jacket leans out of a lower window. Far below, snow-covered peaks and small fir trees fill the bottom of the frame, and a second cabin hangs tiny in the distance. Swirling purple and blue clouds fill the sky around it.

4472.expl: A man in a red padded jacket, glasses and a fur hat rides a mountain cable car and cannot believe how high he gets. He grins into the camera inside the crowded cabin, then leans out of the window as the car floats over the tops of tall spruce trees. At a mountain station he walks across the platform to a gondola full of skiers with a sea of cloud behind him. Back inside, he stares open-mouthed out of the window as the cabin travels along a huge snow-streaked rock face, with the valley and further peaks far below.

4473.expl: A black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon set in a desert. A tall saguaro cactus with a face and a daisy on its head stands on a rock, covered in long sharp spines, looking innocent. Beside it a small round-headed cartoon character in dungarees has just touched it: he holds up one bare hand with spark lines flying off the fingers, his mouth open in a yell and his eyes wide. He is already running away, one shoe flying off and puffs of dust behind his heels, under a blazing sun and desert buttes.

4474.expl: A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.

4475.expl: A warm ink-and-sepia drawing of a small café on a rainy evening. In the foreground the barista pours a stream of milk from a steel jug into a cup on the wooden counter while steam curls off the espresso machine behind him. Cups, mugs and saucers are set out in rows on the shelves above the machine and stacked along the counter. A cake stand with a glass dome shows a cut sponge cake with one slice missing, and a blank chalkboard sign stands beside it. At a small round table by the window a woman in a coat lifts a cup to her lips, with rain and warm street lights outside.

4476.expl: A red-haired woman in a beige turtleneck stands at a coffee bar and knocks back a small espresso, setting the glass down on a saucer. A barista then pours steamed milk into the cup she is holding, drawing a leaf in the foam. The shot opens out into a huge ornate cafe hall with chandeliers, arches, marble tables, a cake trolley and newspapers on a rack, where she sits at a marble table with her cappuccino, smiling and looking around the room.

4478.expl: A woman in a mustard jumper stands at a white wall next to a window with a big photo calendar hanging on it. She uncaps a red marker, leans in and draws a red ring around one number in the grid, grinning at it. She then scribbles a large cross over the ringed number, and finally turns to the camera beaming and points at the marked day with her finger.

4479.expl: A close shot from the front of a red-haired woman in a black and green cycling jersey riding a spin bike in a packed gym class. She is bent over the handlebars, face red and mouth open, pushing the pedals as fast as she can while other riders work in the rows behind her. She keeps glancing down at the little blue console on the handlebars, and at the end she takes one hand off the bars and claps it to her forehead in disbelief at the number on the screen.

4480.expl: A stylised woodblock-style illustration of a camel with a patterned saddle blanket striding along the top of a desert dune at sunset. The whole bottom half of the picture is one long sweeping ridge of sand that bends across the frame in bands of orange, red and cream, and the camel's neck and the swirling clouds above it repeat the same bending line. A red sun sits low behind it.

4481.expl: A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.

Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.

4482.expl: A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.

4483.expl: An illustration seen from behind of a woman in a red checked jacket running across a frozen lake, ice skates slung over her shoulder and a hockey stick in her hand. On the right bank stands a small cabin built of stacked round tree trunks with snow on its roof and smoke rising from the chimney, next to a Canadian flag on a pole. Snowy pines and a rocky peak fill the background and red maple leaves blow across the ice.

4484.expl: A man in a red checked shirt kneels in a wooden canoe on a still turquoise mountain lake, mid-stroke with a wooden paddle. Behind him a wall of snow-capped rocky peaks catches the first low golden light of the morning on its faces while the lower slopes and pine forest are still in cold shadow, and a moose wades in the shallows near the far shore.

4485.expl: A young man in a red checked jacket films himself on a Canadian trip. He first paddles a red canoe across a glassy turquoise lake ringed by snowy peaks. He then stands on a viewing platform in a blue plastic poncho with an enormous waterfall thundering right behind him, the whole curve of it churning white and throwing spray and mist over him while he laughs. Finally he walks through a forest of blazing red and orange maples and holds a single red leaf up to the camera.

4487.expl: A young man in a bobble hat and a red checked jacket films himself through a snowy day. He is first out on a frozen pond with a hockey stick, gently taking shots at a small child in an orange jacket who is playing goalie in front of a net. He is next shovelling the snow off a path in front of a house while an elderly woman stands in the doorway waving and calling thanks to him. Finally he is at an outdoor table with a huge stack of pancakes he has made, pouring syrup over it while four delighted children lean in around him with empty plates.

4488.expl: A large bearded man in a white shirt sits in a busy open-plan office with a telephone handset wedged against his ear. His desk is buried under printed forms and official papers, many of them already marked with big red crosses. He grabs a sheet, slams a rubber stamp down on it and leaves a red X across it, then bangs the stamp onto the ledger in front of him again and again, getting angrier until sheets of paper are flying up all around his head.

4489.expl: A dark inked illustration of a woman leaning over a table and blowing hard at a tall candle in a metal holder. The flame is bent sideways by her breath and trailing smoke. Thick melted drops run down the whole side of the candle and pool on the holder, and beside it on the table lie a matchbox and the collapsed remains of an older candle that has melted into a puddle.

4490.expl: A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.

4491.expl: An illustration of an enormous layered canyon at sunset, drawn in bands of orange, red and brown. On a rock ledge at the right edge stands a tiny figure in a conical hat leaning on a walking stick. From up there the ground drops away in step after step of striped cliff to a narrow green river winding along the bottom of the canyon far underneath, with tall rock spires rising out of the depths and a red sun in the swirling sky.

4492.expl: A man in a long black coat carrying a cream folder walks across a wide cobbled square in the early morning light, scattering a group of pigeons that flap up around his feet. Behind him two rows of tall flag poles line the square and lead the eye to an enormous ornate stone building with a gilded dome and a statue on a column in front of it, lit gold by the low sun, with a red tram and cars passing along the road at its foot.

4493.expl: A black and white woodcut-style illustration of an old bearded seaman in a peaked cap on the deck of a ship in a storm at night. He is braced with both fists clamped on the spokes of the big wooden steering wheel, teeth gritted and leaning his whole weight into it to hold the ship on course while a towering wave curls over the rail behind him, rain slashes down and a lantern swings on its rope above his head.

Cut to a woman in a business suit unlocking a clean silver saloon, captioned 20,000 EUR. Cut to a red Ferrari with both butterfly doors standing wide open, and a man in a tailored suit strolling up to it, captioned 500,000 EUR.

4496.expl: A barefoot man in a beige t-shirt and grey joggers stands on the bare wooden floor of a bright open living room. He bends down to a rolled-up patterned rug and pushes it away from him so that it unrolls across the boards. The red and blue rug ends up lying flat in the middle of the room; he walks onto it, then drops onto his back and stretches out on it with his arms out.

4497.expl: A soft illustration of a small village shop seen from the customer's side of the counter. A dark-haired young shop worker in a floral apron leans over the wooden counter and holds out a single coin between his fingers, while the customer's two open hands reach up from the bottom of the frame to take it. In his other hand he holds a jar he has just scanned. Behind him a conveyor belt carries apples, a pear, oranges and packets towards a paper grocery bag, and shelves of bottles and jars fill the wall.

4498.expl: A group of teenagers sit around a low table in a school common room. One boy in a navy hoodie holds out his left arm, which is in a white plaster cast supported by a sling. His friends take coloured felt-tip pens out of a white cup and write their names and messages on the cast, one adding a yellow sun and another a scribbled signature. By the end the cast is covered in names and drawings in green, orange, blue and red, and the boy holds his arm up and laughs at it.

4499.expl: A red-haired young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and a backpack films himself on a selfie stick as he goes round several castles. He runs up a steep grassy slope towards a stone tower and touches the old wall, laughing. The camera then sweeps through a castle courtyard hung with coloured banners, and finally he walks up a path through trees towards an enormous turreted castle on a hill, grinning back at the camera.

4500.expl: A montage of people snatching things out of the air at the last moment. A young woman in a park pulls a falling tennis ball into her chest; a goalkeeper in green throws himself sideways and pins the ball to the grass in front of the goal; a young man in a kitchen shoots out a hand and grabs a plastic bottle before it hits the floor; a woman in a garden takes a whole watermelon out of the air with both hands; a boy lying on the grass stops a huge beach ball above his face with his hands and feet.

4501.expl: A soft cartoon illustration of a plump green caterpillar with yellow stripes resting along a big green leaf in a sunny garden. A bite-shaped piece is missing from the edge of the leaf just in front of it, with one crumb of leaf floating away. Behind it are rounded bushes, pink, blue and yellow flowers and sparkles of light.

A man in a dark suit stands under a huge painted dome inside a grand building, tilting his head back to take in the painted figures and gold panels above him.

4503.expl: A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.

4504.expl: An open-plan office where a team has just hit its target. On a big wall screen a dashboard shows a figure ending in 000, and a man and a woman in front of it throw their arms out at each other in delight. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over the desks; the whole team jumps up from their laptops, high-fives across the tables and hugs, balloons bounce around the room, and at the end they lift a colleague up on their arms while everyone cheers.

4505.expl: A bright cartoon of a small boy who has tipped his chair too far. He is caught mid-fall, leaning back with the blue and yellow chair going over behind him, both front legs off the floor and his trainers kicking up in the air. His eyes and mouth are wide open, his arms fly out to the sides, and motion lines show the chair swinging over. Beside him is the table he was sitting at, a green chair still standing, and a patterned rug on the wooden floor.

4506.expl: Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.

4507.expl: An illustration of an airport check-in desk seen from behind the counter. A ground agent in a blue uniform and cap holds a long curling paper label and loops it around the handle of a battered brown leather suitcase that sits on the weighing plate. A second printed strip is already hanging from the handle. The passenger in a green jacket stands on the other side of the counter watching. Behind them the belt runs into a dark hatch, screens hang from the ceiling and three more travellers queue at a rope barrier.

4508.expl: A man in a navy t-shirt and glasses is at a busy airline counter with a trolley piled high with luggage. Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.

The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.

4509.expl: A traveller in a cream polo shirt and sunglasses moves through the steps of arriving. First he lowers a brown leather holdall onto a small counter scale, whose display reads 12.95 while a member of staff scans the tag. Then he takes his boarding pass from a hand across the desk, signs a form at a marble hotel reception with a smiling receptionist, and taps his way through a self-service machine in the terminal. He ends up walking off through the hall carrying his bags.

4510.expl: A young woman in a khaki leather jacket stands in the middle of a busy airport hall under an enormous departures board full of flight times and destinations. She holds a boarding pass in both hands, looks down and reads it carefully, then lifts her head and scans across the rows on the board, frowning slightly as she compares the two. When she finds what she is looking for she smiles, drops her hands and walks away past the other passengers with their trolleys.

4511.expl: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.

4512.expl: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.

4514.expl: A cartoon restaurant kitchen. A grinning chef in a tall white hat and white jacket stands in the middle: one hand tosses a copper frying pan whose contents (a lobster, prawns, bell peppers, onion rings and mushrooms) fly up in a huge sheet of orange flame, while the other hand holds out a steaming wooden spoon. Behind him three other cooks in white hats watch him and cheer, one with a pot lid, one with a whisk, one with a knife. Copper pans hang on the wall and plated dishes with silver cloches wait on the pass under warming lamps.

4515.expl: A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.

4516.expl: A soft pastel cartoon inside a wooden barn. A plump speckled brown-and-white hen has just launched herself off her nest and hangs in mid-air with her wings spread, eyes shut and beak open, loose feathers drifting around her. Below her sits a round nest built of dried yellow grass with three pale eggs in it and two more eggs on the ground beside it. The whole barn floor is covered in the same loose dried yellow grass and more of it is heaped in the stalls behind.

4517.expl: A dark woodcut-style print of a Victorian rooftop. A young sweep in a flat cap and long coat braces himself on the steep slate roof, one boot on the tiles and one against the brickwork, and grips a rope with both hands, one high and one low. The rope runs up over the tall brick chimney stack and down into one of its clay pots. Thick black smoke pours out of the pots and blows across a grey sky, and the roofs and chimneys of the town stand behind him.

4519.expl: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.

4520.expl: An ink-and-colour illustration of the Great Wall. In the foreground a woman in a long blue coat and a scarf climbs a broad stone staircase carrying a painted paper lantern, and a red flag flies from the watchtower above her. Behind her the wall runs on and on in one unbroken line: over a green ridge, down into cloud, and up again over the far blue mountains until it disappears at the horizon. Pine trees cling to the slopes and swallows dart over the battlements.

4521.expl: A photograph on the Great Wall at sunrise. A woman in a red jacket and black trousers walks straight towards the camera along the brick walkway with her arms held out wide, a cream paper parasol in her left hand. Behind her the wall drops away to a square stone watchtower, and beyond that the wall and its towers climb over one wooded ridge after another until they fade into the mist and the pale gold sun far away.

4522.expl: A traveller films herself right through a trip. First she is up on the Great Wall in a turquoise jacket, cap and rucksack, laughing at the camera with the wall snaking over green hills behind her. Then she lies back in a wooden boat drifting down a wide river between tall grey karst peaks in the rain, a fisherman poling past on a raft. Then it is night in a crowded street market under red and yellow neon signs, where she lifts a soup dumpling out of a bamboo steamer with chopsticks and grins at the camera.

4524.expl: An older woman in a red cardigan stands at a floured wooden table making dumplings. Her hands close a round wrapper over its filling and press the edge over on itself into a ridge of little pleats, and she sets each finished one down in neat rows on the tray in front of her, dozens of them. Her family gathers round her under a paper lantern and red decorations: a man, a woman and two small children in red, the children copying her hands. At the end the man lifts the lid off a bamboo steamer and steam billows up over a basket of finished dumplings while everyone leans in and laughs.

4525.expl: At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.

4526.expl: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.

4527.expl: A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.

4528.expl: A woodcut of a village church at night. The tall stone tower with its pointed spire rises against a swirling blue sky with a crescent moon and stars; a bell hangs in the open window of the tower with its rope swinging, and a flock of black crows scatters away from it. Warm light shows through the pointed stained-glass windows and small figures in pale robes walk in through the open wooden doors. All around the church, leaning stone markers stand in the rough grass over the buried dead, with a bare tree on each side.

4529.expl: A woman in a long cream lace dress pushes open the heavy wooden doors of a small chapel and steps inside. In a large cathedral she takes a lit candle and touches it to the wick of another one on an iron stand until a row of flames burns beside her. Then she walks down the middle of the nave, and the whole stone floor and the pillars around her are covered in patches of red, blue, green and yellow thrown down by the stained-glass windows; she stops among them, looks up at the windows and turns slowly while the patches fall across her white dress.

4530.expl: A dark cinema drawn in black and white. At the front a wide screen glows bright blue with a blurred moving picture on it, and a broad beam from the projector cuts through the dark air above the rows of seats. Most of the seats are empty and a few silhouetted heads watch from the rows. In the middle a man has jumped up out of his seat and is hurling a bucket of popcorn into the air; the popcorn scatters through the beam and over the seats around him while the man in front of him ducks away.

4531.expl: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.

4532.expl: A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.

4533.expl: A photograph in a wood-panelled courtroom. A woman in a patterned dress stands in the middle of the floor in front of the bench and holds a large certificate with a ribbon seal up over her head with both arms, laughing. Behind her an older man in a suit and three other family members clap and wave small paper flags, two little boys among them, and paper confetti falls through the light from the tall window. A small flag stands on the desk beside a signed document, and seated guests watch from the front row.

4534.expl: A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.

4535.expl: A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.

4536.expl: Close-up of two clay-covered hands shaping a wet pot on a turning potter's wheel. The upper part is already a smooth thrown neck with curled clay handles; the lower part is still a rough lump. Specks of wet clay are flung across the wooden wheel head and the bench. Behind, out of focus, wooden shelves hold rows of finished pots and lumps of raw clay, with wooden tools lying on a bench.

4537.expl: A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.

4538.expl: A woman with curly hair and a knotted headband leans over a glass coffee table loaded with remote controls, magazines, tubes and sprays, scrubbing the glass with a white cloth. Spray bottles stand around her. She moves to the sofa and pulls the seat cushions straight, punching them back into shape. The living room is then shown from the doorway, empty and bare, with sun on the parquet and one rag left on the floor. She sits down on the sofa, leans back, stretches her legs out and stays there, looking round the finished room.

4539.expl: A hand-drawn comic-style picture with thick black outlines, flat colours and motion lines. A grinning man with round white eyes, a patched apron, big yellow rubber gloves and brown shoes swings a mop across a blue-and-cream chequered floor. Sparkle stars and soap bubbles pop off the wet tiles. A grey mop bucket on castors, full of suds and fitted with a wringer, stands to the right. Behind him are office windows with a drawn city skyline, a potted fern and a radiator.

4540.expl: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.

4541.expl: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.

4542.expl: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.

4543.expl: A pencil-and-charcoal drawing of a huge sea cliff seen from the side. The rock face is a sheer, layered wall dropping straight into the sea, where white surf boils around its foot. A single thin rope runs down the middle of the face, and a tiny figure hangs on it about halfway down, dwarfed by the rock. Seabirds wheel in the empty grey sky to the left; tufts of coarse grass grow on the ledges at the bottom right.

4544.expl: An illustration split straight down the middle into two opposite halves. The left half is burnt orange desert: cracked dry ground, bare dead trees, a white blazing sun and grey rocky hills. The right half is deep blue ice: jagged frozen slabs, snow-laden fir trees, falling snow and heavy grey cloud. Down the seam between them rises a column of white steam shot through with glowing blue lines. A metal machine stands on each side, one in the sand, one on the ice, and a metal platform runs along the bottom of the frame.

4545.expl: A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.

4546.expl: A soft watercolour of a doctor's consulting room. A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round her neck stands with her back to us, one hand on a boy's knee. The boy sits on a green examination couch with his sleeve pushed up, holding his upper arm. Behind them are a cream cabinet with a tray of pens and papers, a blank framed notice on the wall and a potted plant. A blood-pressure cuff and its bulb lie on the counter in the foreground. Through the open door a woman and a small girl in yellow wait on chairs outside.

4547.expl: A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.

4548.expl: A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.

4549.expl: A charcoal drawing in blacks and greys. A bare forearm grips the wooden handle of a shovel and tips its load of chunky black lumps forward; the lumps and a shower of black dust fall through the air onto a big heap of the same shiny black rock below. Behind is a dim brick cellar lit by a single bare bulb hanging on a flex. Some of the lumps have spilled out over the drawn border onto the pale grey paper.

4550.expl: Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.

4551.expl: A campsite on a pine-fringed lake shore under a blue sky. A blond man in a red fleece stands beside a pitched orange dome tent, grinning, then bends down and crawls in head first. A green tent and another group of campers sit further along the shore. The orange tent sags, then folds flat with only his boots sticking out of the door. He sits up under the collapsed fabric, the whole tent draped over him, and looks round laughing.

4553.expl: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.

4554.expl: A marshmallow on a stick chars over a toaster, then a bearded man in a strawberry-print apron turns rows of hot dogs on an outdoor barbecue with tongs. The grill erupts and a wall of orange flame leaps waist-high off the grate; the man keeps turning the sausages while a semicircle of relatives behind him stare open-mouthed.

4555.expl: A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.

4556.expl: An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.

4557.expl: A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.

4558.vo: Hey, hey. It's okay. We're here. Thanks.
4558.expl: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. 4560.expl: A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.

4561.expl: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.

4562.expl: A red-haired woman in a wool jumper stands on an open moor of purple heather, holding an open brass pocket compass close to her face and frowning at the needle. She crouches down and holds it flat in both palms until it settles, then straightens up, sets her jaw and strides off across the heather. The last shot shows her at sea, gripping a large ship's compass in its binnacle with the horizon behind her.

4563.expl: A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.

4564.expl: A soft watercolour of a village barn raising on a summer meadow. A long line of villagers in waistcoats and caps leans back on a rope, hauling a big wooden roof frame upright, while an old man in a straw hat stands on the platform pointing and directing them. On the left, women in aprons carry trays of loaves and pies out from a trestle table under an awning; a girl holds a basket. Children run across the grass with buckets and tools for the men on the ladder, and thatched cottages sit behind.

4565.expl: An anime-style painting of the inside of a spacecraft. A child in an orange spacesuit with a white life-support pack and a tether floats up to a big round porthole, seen from behind, with both gloved hands pressed against the glass. Filling the window is the earth as one enormous blue and green ball, wrapped in white cloud, with the land masses spread across it. Instrument panels with glowing screens and bundles of cable line the walls, and a strip of black starry sky shows through a second window above.

4566.expl: A photograph taken at sunrise from the highest rocks of a mountain. A woman in an olive jacket and a climbing harness pulls herself up over the last granite slabs, one hand flat on the rock and the other arm swung up behind her, her hair blown across her face by the wind. Below and behind her, ridge after ridge of bare mountain drops away into a hazy valley with a pale river winding through it, and the ranges fade into blue haze at the horizon under a streaked dawn sky.

4567.expl: A soft cartoon of a young woman standing in a bright room with a bookshelf, potted plants and a sunlit window behind her. She wears an olive green jumper over a white collared shirt. She has turned her head away, screwed her eyes shut and pulled up her arm to cough hard into the crook of her elbow, her cheeks flushed pink, with little motion lines drawn beside her face.

4568.expl: A school yard with a giant world map painted across the tarmac in bright colours, each land mass a different colour. A girl in an orange hoodie and rainbow trainers jumps from land mass to land mass, landing squarely on the yellow one, then hopping on across the map. Her classmates in tracksuits stand in a wide ring around the edge of the map watching her. She finishes by landing with both feet on the white land mass at the bottom right and throwing her arms out wide, laughing at the camera.

4569.expl: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.

4570.expl: Three kitchens in a row. A bearded man in a vest tosses sliced peppers and carrots out of a wok over a roaring blue flame in a food truck above a turquoise sea. Then a woman in an apron stir-fries at a street stall in a crowded market street, ladling in stock until a wall of orange flame leaps out of the wok and she laughs behind it. Finally a man in a white double-breasted chef's jacket with his name stitched on the chest sets a sprig of microgreens on a plated dish of pork, carrots and purée in a stainless steel restaurant kitchen, then steps back and looks at it.
