4571.expl: A fishing beach with a big wooden boat sitting high on timber skids. A crowd of villagers, men and women of all ages, put their shoulders and hands against the hull and shove it forward down the rollers towards the sea, straining with their heels dug into the sand. An old man in a blue shirt walks ahead of them hauling on a wooden beam and shouting the count. The boat runs down the skids and reaches the water, and the group ends up in a circle in the shallows, hugging each other and cheering.

4572.expl: A woman in a mustard blouse and red glasses sits alone at a long desk in an empty lecture theatre, with a takeaway coffee cup beside her. She works through a pile of exam papers with a red pen, drawing corrections across a sheet, then putting it down and pulling the next one over. Each time she looks up the two piles either side of her have grown taller, until they tower well above her head and hide her behind them. At the end she sits back, staring up at the towers of paper with her mouth open, spare red pens scattered across the desk.

4573.expl: A busy diner with red vinyl booths, white tablecloths and a violinist playing between the tables. An elderly woman in a grey suit sits at a booth and slides a folded napkin across the cloth. A man in a blue shirt and tie with a gold watch heaves a brown leather briefcase up onto the table opposite her. The two of them then sit behind raised menus, glancing sideways at each other. The camera pulls back to show the long tablecloth is draped over a wheelbarrow parked at the table, and under the cloth the barrow is heaped with banded bundles of cash; they reach across and shake hands over it.

4575.expl: A reading room in a library, with tall wooden shelves of books and other students working at the tables behind. A young woman in a beige cardigan sits at a table with an open book, a pen, her glasses and a water bottle in front of her. She presses her hand over her mouth, her eyes watering and her face screwed up, then bends forward over the table and coughs hard into her fist and into the crook of her sleeve, several times. The students behind her keep reading.

4576.expl: A large hall with long tables covered in stacks of paper. A young woman in a green sari with a lanyard sits at one table, a pen in her hand, lifting sheet after sheet off a tall stack and marking a tally sheet on a clipboard in front of her. The camera pulls back to show dozens of people down both sides of the tables doing the same, each behind their own towers of paper, with observers standing along the walls. At the end she raises a hand in the air.

4577.expl: An ink drawing on aged paper. A woman in a blue robe and a conical straw hat stands on a rocky cliff edge with her arm stretched out towards the land below her. Beneath her lies a wide valley: a patchwork of green and gold fields, a broad river winding through it, small villages of tiled roofs, and a walled town on a hill in the distance. Snow-capped mountains close the horizon, birds fly below the cliff and tall grass leans in the wind in the foreground.

4578.expl: A photograph taken from a hilltop on a clear day. A man in a black jacket with a canvas backpack strides past a stack of stones on the stony path, both arms flung out wide, seen from behind. Below him the whole plain is divided into a patchwork of farm fields: green pasture, standing green crops and pale gold fields already cut, separated by hedges and lines of trees, with a river curling through them, farmhouses dotted about and low hills and the sea on the horizon.

4579.expl: A woman in a denim jacket sewn all over with national flag patches grins into the camera from behind a spinning school globe. The shot cuts to her in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris with both arms thrown up, then to a selfie on the back of a scooter riding past green rice terraces in Bali, then to her standing on the crest of a desert dune at sunset with her arms spread wide, and finally jumping on the dune towards the camera.

4580.expl: A cartoon of a diner with a red-and-white checked tablecloth, a jukebox and neon signs on the wall. A boy and a girl lean their heads together over one tall milkshake glass topped with whipped cream and a cherry, each drinking through their own bent straw. Their hands are joined on the table in front of the glass, both are blushing, and a pink heart-shaped balloon floats above them.

4581.expl: A cartoon of a den built out of blankets over a sofa in a sunlit living room. Inside it a boy in a blue hoodie holds up a lit torch and points at a stack of cushions, while a girl in dungarees kneels beside him laughing with her hand at her mouth as she eats a sweet. A striped bowl heaped with wrapped and jelly sweets floats between them, with loose sweets scattered around it, under a string of paper stars and hearts. Teddy bears sit on the sofa behind.

4582.expl: A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.

4583.expl: A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

4584.expl: Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.

4585.expl: A woman in a red beret, a striped top and dark jeans, carrying a baguette under her arm, walks from one side of a narrow Paris street to the other over the white stripes on the road, past a red-awninged cafe. The shot then cuts to a wide boulevard in front of the Arc de Triomphe, where she walks the whole width of the road with a crowd of other people while the light is green and the cars wait, and steps up onto the far side.

4586.expl: A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.

4587.expl: A man in a red jacket films himself from the handlebars as he rides. First he sits on his bike on a sandy track between green fields, looking up at a level-crossing sign against a blue sky. Then he is stopped at the edge of a village road, one hand on the handlebar, watching cars go past a traffic light. Finally he is at a big city junction under tram wires, with traffic lights, cars turning and a crowd of people waiting on the far pavement, his mouth open in surprise.

4588.expl: A drawing of a city street at night in heavy rain, lit pink and blue by neon buildings and glowing signs. A young man in a long black hooded coat and white trainers strides across the striped crossing in the middle of the road. Cars are stopped on both sides of him with their headlights on, and other people in raincoats walk across in front of and behind him. The wet road throws back the coloured light in long reflections and rain streaks the air.

4589.expl: A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.

4590.expl: A cartoon of the top deck of a big white passenger ship at sunset. A woman in a pink swimsuit leaps off the edge into the deck pool and throws up a huge splash. Around the pool stand rows of red, blue and yellow sun loungers under red-and-white striped parasols on the wooden deck, and a steward in a white uniform and cap carries a tray of cocktails along it. Two striped funnels rise behind, seagulls circle, and beyond the rail the sea is turquoise with a palm island and a big orange sun on the horizon.

4591.expl: A woman in a straw visor pulls a suitcase up a metal gangway towards an enormous white passenger ship, its many decks of balconies and its orange lifeboats filling the frame behind her. She walks along the ship's wooden promenade deck with a keycard on a lanyard, someone dives into the pool on the top deck between the two funnels, and she eats at a buffet beside the panoramic windows with green cliffs sliding past outside. At sunset she stands at the deck rail with her suitcase as the ship sails through a bay of rocky islands.

4592.expl: Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.

4593.expl: A young man in a navy tracksuit walks down a long, bright hospital corridor on two metal crutches, with a grey walking boot strapped onto one foot. He swings himself forward step by step towards the camera. Behind him a nurse in white scrubs follows with a clipboard, watching him walk. Windows line one wall and handrails run along both sides of the corridor.

4594.expl: A young woman in a party dress cries hard, tears running down her cheeks as she presses a tissue to her face. The camera pulls back to show she is in the middle of a group of friends in evening clothes, all of them crying and laughing at the same time. They press in on each other, arms round shoulders and backs, until the whole group ends up in one tight knot of people hugging.

He holds a tissue box on his lap, and the sofa around him is buried under a mound of crumpled white tissues. He pulls one tissue after another, presses it to his eyes, and drops it onto the pile.

4596.expl: A young woman with her hair in a messy bun sits curled on a sofa under a checked blanket, crying. Her eyes and the skin around her nose are red and swollen. She lifts a white tissue to her face, covers her nose with both hands and blows it, then lowers the tissue and goes on crying with the blanket clutched to her chest.

4597.expl: A watercolour of an evening folk festival under a canopy strung with paper lanterns. Two couples in embroidered shirts and waistcoats dance in the middle of a wooden floor; the woman in front spins so hard that her striped red skirt and the coloured ribbons in her flower crown fly out around her. On the right a fiddler draws his bow, in the foreground a drummer beats a big frame drum, and market stalls hung with pottery and woven cloth stand behind, where other people clap along.

4598.expl: In a coffee shop lined with shelves of brightly coloured cups, a red-haired woman in cat-eye glasses orders at the counter. A hand slides her a normal rainbow-striped mug of coffee and she lifts it and grins. Then a far bigger mug appears, and a bigger one still, until she is gripping a pastel-striped mug the size of a bucket with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open, its handle as thick as her wrist.

4599.expl: A close-up at a market stall in low evening sun. A hand tips a small drawstring cloth pouch upside down over a scrubbed wooden counter, and coins and folded paper notes in red, green and cream pour out of it and tumble through the air. A dozen coins have already landed and lie scattered across the boards. Brass balance scales, glass jars and a wicker basket stand blurred behind.

4600.expl: At a money-changer's booth in a busy covered bazaar, a moustached man in a grey shirt and dark waistcoat holds out a thick bundle of banknotes in both hands over a glass case. He counts through a stack of purple notes, then spreads dozens of notes into a wide fan across the counter, laying different currencies side by side. A young woman in an orange beanie watches with her mouth open in amazement, and at the end he passes a handful of notes over to a hand reaching in from the camera side.

4601.expl: A woman in a cream jumper works on a grey corner sofa in a bright Scandinavian living room. She smooths the seat with both hands, then carries cushions over one at a time - mustard, pink, teal, patterned - and sets them along the back of the sofa in order, straightening each one as she goes. When the row is finished she steps back to look at it, then drops backwards onto the cushions and lies there with her arms spread.

4602.expl: A fine pen-and-ink drawing of a customs hall. An open suitcase on a metal bench shows neatly folded shirts and trousers; a uniformed officer in a peaked cap holds a rolled sleeping bag up above his head and squints at it. Beside him a worried traveller in a long coat stands with her hands clasped under her chin. To the right a second officer holds a spaniel on a lead, and the dog has its front paws up on the bench with its nose towards the case. Booths, striped barriers and a turnstile fill the background.

4603.expl: A road cyclist in a teal kit and a white helmet rides down a narrow tarmac road that winds through green tropical hills. The camera holds on him from the front as he drives on the pedals, then swings to the side as he tucks low over the handlebars; behind him the road curves away with a crash barrier along its edge. He leans hard through a bend, then straightens up on a long descent with mountains and cloud filling the horizon.

4605.expl: A comic-style illustration of a red and cream tram running along rails set into a cobbled street. Its scissor-shaped arm is pressed up against the overhead line, and a burst of yellow lightning-bolt sparks flies off where the two pieces of metal touch. More lines run across the pink sunset sky to the corners of the frame. A girl in a yellow jacket leans out of an open tram window with her blue scarf streaming behind her, pigeons flap up from the cobbles in front of the tram, and a castle and a gothic tower stand on the hill behind.

4606.expl: A young man in an olive jacket films himself with a selfie stick as he travels. First he stands on a stone bridge at sunrise, the river orange behind him and a domed church and a tall gothic tower on the far bank. Then he stands in a crowded square looking straight up at the face of an astronomical clock set into a stone tower, with pigeons bursting into the air around it. Finally he sits in a wood-beamed beer hall, lifts a litre tankard, drinks and laughs with the men beside him.

4607.expl: Inside a brewery a blonde woman in a denim shirt and apron pulls a beer. She holds a glass tankard under the tap and lets the beer run in, then works the handle so a thick white head builds up over the rim. Two full tankards stand on the steel drip tray. Behind her rise tall, round brewing vessels of polished reddish-brown metal that glow under the lights. She carries a tankard over to three waiting friends and the four of them clink glasses over an old wooden barrel.

4608.expl: A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.

4610.expl: A warm illustration set in the hallway of an old house. A little girl in a red patterned dress and pigtails comes flying down the staircase, one arm swinging a leather school satchel, the other stretched out ahead of her. At the bottom a man in a tweed jacket and tie has dropped into a crouch with both arms wide open to catch her, grinning up at her. A grandfather clock, a coat rack with hats and coats, a patterned rug and the front door fill the hall behind them.

4611.expl: A young girl and her mother are baking together in a bright kitchen. Their hands crack an egg into a glass bowl of flour with a whisk in it. The girl, flour on her nose, holds up a crayon drawing of her family and shows it to her mother, who beams at her. They hug tightly, the drawing still in the mother's hand. Then the girl high-fives and dances with two men in the kitchen. The clip ends with several families walking hand in hand across a sunlit park.

4612.expl: A busy street market. A moustached stallholder in a shirt and waistcoat stands behind a huge pyramid of peaches and holds one up to a young customer, turning it in his fingers to show it off. The customer leans in over the fruit. The vendor then piles peaches into a cardboard box and hands it across the stall. Brass hanging scales sway above the display, other stalls and shoppers fill the street behind.

4613.expl: An allotment garden under a grey sky. An older man in a flat cap and body warmer tips a black bucket of kitchen scraps onto a heap inside a wooden compost bin: carrot tops, apples and banana skins scatter over the surface. He then works a spade into the heap and lifts up great forkfuls of dark crumbly earth, turning it over so the older, rotted material underneath comes to the top. Raised beds of cabbages and a greenhouse stand behind him.

4614.expl: A couple are getting a room ready for a birthday party. A man in a bright floral shirt stands on a blue stepladder and tapes the end of a rainbow paper garland to the wall so that it drops down in a long loop. He then drapes a string of fairy lights along a set of shelves. Below him a woman in a denim jacket blows up an orange balloon. A HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting and rows of hanging lights go up on the wall, and by the end coloured paper streamers hang from the middle of the ceiling down to every corner, with balloons covering the floor.

4615.expl: A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

4616.expl: A pencil sketch of a misty wood. Tall bare tree trunks rise on every side and thin branches criss-cross the pale sky, with fog drifting between them. In the middle a large stag with wide branching antlers rears up over a fallen mossy log, front hooves off the ground and head thrown back, its breath steaming in the cold air. Dry leaves swirl around its legs in the wind.

4617.expl: A medieval re-enactment battle on a grass field in front of a large crowd. A bald, red-bearded man in chainmail and steel arm and leg armour shoves forward behind a painted round shield, roaring. Two knots of fighters slam into each other and grind together, shields locked, shoving and swinging. One fighter is knocked down and lies on the grass while the others keep pushing over him. Spectators watch from behind a rope barrier with flags flying above them.

4618.expl: A viking re-enactment in front of a packed grandstand. A grinning red-bearded warrior crouches behind a big round blue shield with a metal boss. He and the fighters beside him lock their painted shields into a solid wall, then break into a run and rush forward together across the grass, shields level and heads down. Bodies go down on the field. The clip ends with the red-bearded man standing over the fallen, raising his sword in one hand and his shield in the other.

4619.expl: A wooden cabin kitchen with a fjord and snowy mountains through the window. A young man in a thick Nordic wool jumper holds a handful of frozen dark berries under the running tap, then picks up a whole raw chicken, pale and frozen, and turns it over under the water so it runs off the skin into the steel sink. Finally he heaves a huge whole salmon up out of the sink and holds it across both hands, mouth wide open in amazement. Jars of preserves and two kettles stand on the counter behind him.

4620.expl: A charcoal drawing of an airport terminal in the middle of the night. A young man lies stretched across a row of metal seats with one arm flung over his forehead, a backpack beside him and a wheeled suitcase parked at his feet. Behind him more stranded passengers sleep across the seats, curled up in their coats. A big round clock on the wall reads about half past four. Beyond the black glass wall, planes sit on the dark apron. A cleaner pushes a mop cart down the empty concourse and a crushed paper cup lies on the floor.

4621.expl: An airport departure lounge in daylight. A woman with long silver hair, a brown hoodie and a navy travel pillow round her neck stands under two big blue departure boards and tilts her head back at them in despair. She drops into one of the seats. All around her other travellers wait: men in suits sprawled asleep across the chairs with their heads back, people slumped over their bags. Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

4622.expl: A woman with red hair in a mustard tracksuit sits at an airport gate holding her boarding pass. She throws her head back against the seat, opens her mouth and lets out a long groaning breath at the ceiling. She looks down at her watch, taps it, and checks it again. Later she has a grey travel pillow round her neck and her bare feet up on her suitcase as night falls outside the window. In the last shot she is lying flat out asleep across the row of seats with four empty coffee cups lined up on the floor beneath her.

4623.expl: A cartoon of an election count. A tall wooden ballot box painted in red, white and blue stripes is tipped on its side above a long wooden trestle table, and folded paper slips pour out of it onto the tabletop. A heap of the slips has already built up in the middle and more flutter through the air. Smiling officials in suits and hats stand along both sides of the table with their hands out, ready to spread the pile and sort it. Behind a rope barrier a crowd of onlookers watches, and banners hang on the brick wall above them.

4624.expl: A photograph looking down a packed town hall with a bare wooden floor and tall windows. More than a hundred people of all ages sit on rows of plain wooden chairs, and almost every one of them has a single hand raised straight up in the air to vote. Papers rest on their laps. A long empty table with stacks of paper and three chairs faces them at the front of the room. Sunlight falls in stripes across the floorboards between the rows.

4625.expl: A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.

4627.expl: A stout older man in a flat cap and shirtsleeves waves a white handkerchief above his head, three times over. First he stands beside a city tram stop as a long white tram slides away from the kerb past him. Then he is on a station platform under the overhead wires as a red and cream train pulls out along the track. Finally he stands alone on a stone quay in the sun, waving up at an enormous white cruise ship as it moves off its berth into the deep blue sea, a lighthouse in the distance.

4628.expl: A young man with red hair in a green jumper stands at a living room window beside a packed wicker picnic basket. He gestures out at the street, where rain is running down the glass and the parked cars and brick houses are grey and wet. He drops a last apple into the basket, then lifts out the folded tartan blanket and hugs it against his chest, his face falling as he looks down. He turns away, sinks onto the arm of a chair by the radiator, and ends up slumped in the armchair with the blanket over his knees, chin on his hand, staring out at the wet street.

4629.expl: A woodcut print in ochre, orange and brown. Sand dunes roll away one behind another, their curving ridges carved in fine parallel lines, until they blur into a flat line at the horizon with no end in sight. A tiny robed figure with a walking staff is climbing one of the ridges far off, no bigger than a thumbnail against the sand. In the foreground a bleached longhorn cattle skull lies half buried in the dune. A large stylised sun hangs in the empty yellow sky above.

4630.expl: In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.

4631.expl: A man in a denim apron leans over a workbench and draws a birdhouse on a sketchpad with a pencil, adding a roof, a round hole and arrows. He then fits flat wooden pieces together into the same shape, and finally holds the finished wooden birdhouse up next to his drawing, smiling at the camera.

4632.expl: A woman in a rainbow jumper stands behind a completely bare wooden desk and pats it. She then sets a bright rainbow desk lamp on it and switches it on, adds an open laptop, a small potted plant, a pot of coloured pens and a stack of colourful books. At the end she sits down at the finished desk and smiles at the camera.

4633.expl: A man in a black raincoat leans into the driver's seat of an old blue car and tries to start it, dropping his head onto the steering wheel. He opens the bonnet and pokes at the battery terminals in the rain while buses pass on the wet street behind him. He gives up, closes the bonnet, leans against the car, then sits down on the kerb in the rain and covers his face with both hands.

4634.expl: A watercolour illustration of a young woman with a backpack standing at the end of a sandy coastal path, seen from behind with both arms thrown up in the air. Below and ahead of her lies a colourful seaside town of pastel houses around a turquoise bay full of small boats, with hills and a warm orange sky behind. Wildflowers grow beside the path in the foreground.

4637.expl: A woman in a white hard hat and a yellow high-visibility jacket stands behind a red-and-white barrier and films herself in front of a red brick building. Behind her an excavator with a large claw tears at the top floor of the building; clouds of dust rise and bricks and beams fall into a growing heap of rubble. By the end the upper part of the house has gone and she holds up her phone showing the collapse.

4638.expl: A woman in a white hard hat and yellow high-visibility jacket films herself in front of a brown brick house whose roof has already been torn open. A yellow excavator swings its arm into the top of the house; the roof and the front wall break away and crash down in a cloud of dust. She turns to watch as the house is reduced to a heap of broken bricks and splintered timber, then waves at the camera in front of the ruins.

At the end he holds up a clean white t-shirt and smiles.

4642.expl: On a sunny beach a shirtless boy in yellow swim shorts digs into the sand with a metal spade while a light brown dog scrapes at the sand beside him. He throws shovelful after shovelful onto the mounds around him and the hole grows steadily deeper and wider. At the end he and the dog are both sitting down inside the finished hole, with only their heads and shoulders showing above the sand, the sea behind them.

4643.expl: In a bright apartment a woman in a padded gilet with headphones round her neck positions two actors by a window, putting a hand on the man's shoulder to move him. The shot widens to show the film crew at work: two large cameras on tripods, a camera operator in headphones, boom microphones over the actors and studio lights. The woman sits at a monitor watching the take, then punches the air, and the crew clap.

4644.vo: I'm so sorry. Work. Right. Sorry.
4644.expl: A young man in a black jacket stands in a hallway looking at his phone with a pained face as he apologises. In the kitchen behind him another young man in a stained apron is serving a hot pan of stew onto a table laid for three, under a paper banner reading 'Congratulations'. The friend leaves through the door; the cook is left standing alone at the table, then sits down by himself in front of the untouched dish and the single candle.

4645.expl: Two hands work over a grey pegboard tray covered in brightly coloured plastic balls and rods. At the end they lift a tall column of balls and rods that have been joined end to end, with more joined shapes standing on the tray below.

4647.expl: In an open-plan office a young man in a denim jacket sits on a black office chair with his feet up and whirls himself round and round on it. He stops and stands up, but staggers sideways with his arms out and his eyes wide, and has to grab the edge of a desk to stay upright. He leans over the desk holding on, then slides down and sits on the floor holding his forehead while a colleague watches from behind.

Behind them are an eye chart, a shapes chart, a lamp and a glass cabinet of bottles; a reflex hammer and a lollipop lie on a metal tray in front.

In the room there is a glass cabinet of medicine bottles, a fern on top of it, and a second stethoscope, a lollipop and instruments on the counter in front.

4650.expl: In a school laboratory a student in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue gloves tips a blue liquid from a small beaker into a conical glass flask on a black bench. Within seconds a thick pale-blue foam surges up out of the flask's neck and pours down the sides onto the bench. The foam keeps growing into a tall column that rises higher than his head and turns pink, yellow and rainbow-coloured, while he steps back with his mouth open in astonishment and classmates watch in the background.

4651.expl: A soft watercolour painting of the open sea at sunset. A grey bottlenose dolphin arcs through the air above the water, its body dripping, with a second dolphin breaking the surface just behind it. Below, green-blue waves catch the golden light and white spray rises where the dolphins left the water. The sky is peach and pink, with a low dark coastline on the horizon.

4652.expl: At an outdoor event a crowd presses against a barrier to watch an arm-wrestling table. A woman with a red flower in her hair grips hands with a man across the padded table, both leaning in with their elbows planted on the pads. Their faces strain and their mouths open as they push; the crowd behind them laughs and reacts. In the last seconds the tension breaks and the same people sit together laughing, holding plastic cups of drink at the table.

4653.expl: A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.

4654.expl: In a bright flat a woman stares hard at a wooden shelf that has just been screwed to the white wall, her brow furrowed and her mouth twisted in disbelief. Behind her a man holding a screwdriver smiles and gestures at his work. She raises a white mug, edges it slowly onto the shelf and lets go, watching to see if it holds. The shelf holds the mug; she steps back, folds her arms and looks at it sideways, still unconvinced.

4655.expl: In a sunlit bedroom a bare-chested young man picks up a light blue shirt and pulls it on. He fastens the buttons one by one down the front, then swings a navy suit jacket over his shoulders and pushes his arms into the sleeves. He knots and straightens a dark tie at his collar, tugs the jacket into place, and finally stands in front of a mirror in the full suit, adjusting the tie one last time.

4656.expl: A woman in a plaid shirt, safety glasses and a tool belt presses a cordless drill against a red brick wall; dust puffs out as the bit bites in. She then taps a wall plug into the hole with a hammer, leaving a line of fixings along the brickwork. Metal brackets go up and she lifts long pine boards onto them, pressing each shelf level against the wall. She sets a stack of coloured books on the finished shelf, then stands back with her hands on her hips looking at the two mounted shelves.

4657.expl: In a busy covered street market a woman in an orange vest top sips iced tea from a clear plastic cup through a straw, her cheeks pulling in as she draws the liquid up. She then holds a whole green coconut in both hands and drinks from the straw pushed into its top, tipping it towards her mouth. Finally she lifts a plastic water bottle high, puts it to her lips and swallows in long gulps, then lowers it and breathes out, smiling.

4658.expl: A point-of-view shot from inside an open-topped vintage car: two tanned hands hold the thin black steering wheel while the car rolls down a narrow cobbled village street between whitewashed houses with people walking ahead. The road opens onto a coastal highway with the blue sea and cliffs on the left, and the wheel turns as the car follows the bends. The camera then shows the driver herself, a woman in a colourful shirt and sunglasses, one hand on the wheel, looking out at the ocean as she drives along the clifftop road.

4659.expl: A sequence of drivers seen from inside their vehicles. A man in a suit holds the steering wheel of a saloon car crawling through city traffic, with rows of cars and brake lights ahead and skyscrapers above. A woman smiles at the wheel of a white box van stopped at a red traffic light in a suburban street, then pulls away as the light turns green. A couple sit in a blue convertible parked above the ocean, and a bearded man in a checked shirt drives a car along a winding forest road at sunset with his window down.

4660.expl: In a shopping centre a woman in a long red coat staggers along the polished floor with an enormous armful of shopping: stacked gift boxes, hat boxes, paper carrier bags, a scarf and a hat all balanced against her chest, so high they hide her face. A lipstick falls and rolls away on the tiles. The load tips and everything slides out of her arms, boxes and bags tumbling down and spreading across the floor around her feet. She ends up standing over a wide heap of boxes stacked and scattered on the tiles, throwing her hands up.

4661.expl: A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.

4662.expl: A small propeller plane flies low over green grassland and releases a wooden crate from beneath its fuselage. The crate comes down under a parachute and lands in the grass, where a smiling woman in a striped robe runs up and takes hold of it by the handles. The plane circles back and drops a whole string of crates, each on its own coloured parachute, and the sky fills with them. Villagers walk out from their white round tents to collect the boxes, and the woman raises both arms towards the descending parachutes.

4663.expl: A pastel cartoon in soft pinks and greens. A hand in a blue sleeve squeezes the pink rubber bulb of a glass pipette held above a child's forehead. A single large rounded bead of clear liquid has just left the glass tube and hangs in the air, catching the light, with a smaller one still forming at the tip. Below it the child tilts her face up with her eyes shut tight and her mouth pursed, waiting for it to land. A labelled glass bottle stands on a shelf behind them.

4664.expl: A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

4665.expl: A run of small mishaps, one after another. A black phone lies face down on a wooden kitchen floor where it has just landed. On a city pavement a girl holds an ice cream cone with only half a scoop left, the rest of it splattered pink on the ground beside her feet. In an office a woman in a blue blouse throws up her hands in panic as a whole file of white papers flies out of her arms and scatters through the air. In a kitchen a man's plastic bag splits and oranges, peaches and a jar roll out across the tiled floor. Finally a watermelon bursts open on a market street, pink flesh and juice sprayed in a wide splash, while shoppers jump back with their hands over their mouths.

4666.expl: Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

4667.expl: Seen from directly below, a small white and red propeller aeroplane passes low across a clear blue sky and lets a wooden crate fall from underneath it. The crate floats down on a rainbow parachute into open green grassland, where a woman in a striped robe runs up laughing to take it. The aircraft banks and comes round again, its wings and propellers clear against the sky, dropping a line of further crates under coloured parachutes. It flies over a settlement of white round tents while villagers and horses gather in the grass and a woman spreads her arms wide beneath the falling loads.

4668.expl: On a sunny rooftop terrace above a deep blue sea, a grey-haired woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron hangs white washing on a rope line. She shakes out a white shirt, pegs it up, straightens it with both hands, and at the end lifts a white cloth to her nose, closes her eyes and breathes in the smell of it.

An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.

The camera shows the view around her: rows of tiled and flat rooftops with aerials and chimneys stretching to the horizon, with washing lines hanging between the buildings below.

4671.expl: A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.

4672.expl: A woodblock-style illustration of a pond. A brown duck with an orange bill and orange webbed feet drops down onto the water with its wings spread, throwing up a tall white splash and rings of ripples. Two yellow ducklings paddle nearby. Both edges of the picture are filled with tall green reeds and broad water-plant leaves rising straight out of the shallow water, with hills and clouds behind.

4673.expl: A black-and-white cartoon in an old gym. A skinny character with thin rubber-hose arms and legs tries to lift one huge dumbbell in one gloved hand. The weight drags his arm and shoulder down, his knees buckle, his face is screwed up and drops of sweat fly off his head. Racks of barbells and dumbbells and a much bigger dumbbell lying on the floor fill the room around him.

4674.expl: An elderly man in a waistcoat and glasses cleans a crowded antique shop full of clocks. He beats a feather duster over a gilded mantel clock on a table, then reaches up and runs the duster along the wooden shelves of a tall bookcase packed with old books, small framed pictures and wall clocks. Clouds of grey dust rise into the light from the window and drift across the armchair in front of him.

4675.expl: A black-and-white cartoon of an Amsterdam canal street. A wide-eyed young man in a coat and a striped scarf races over the hump of a cobbled canal bridge on an old bicycle, so fast that both wheels have left the ground and he is flying. A wooden crate of tulips is strapped to the back rack and the flowers and petals are shooting out behind him. Tall gabled houses, parked bicycles chained to the railing and a houseboat on the canal fill the background.

4676.expl: A traditional Dutch cheese market on a cobbled town square. Two carriers in white uniforms and orange sashes trot past with a wooden barrow stacked high with yellow cheese wheels on their shoulders, watched by a crowd of onlookers. A young carrier picks a heavy wheel off a pile, lifts it up to the camera and grins, then stacks more wheels into tall towers before clapping his hands over the finished piles.

4678.expl: A run of close-up shots of different people eating. A bearded man bites into a dripping cheeseburger in a fast-food restaurant; a woman lifts a mouthful of ramen noodles out of a bowl with chopsticks and sucks them in; a man in a canteen forks food off a plate of fried fish, chips and salad; a boy with curly hair takes a bite out of an enormous triple cheeseburger held in both hands.

4679.expl: A young man in a turquoise T-shirt and a backwards cap sits at a metal counter in a busy taqueria, with cooks working behind him. Two tacos sit on paper in front of him. 4680.expl: A photograph in the desert at Giza. A blonde woman with a beige scarf wrapped round her head and a loose linen shirt is climbing onto the back of a camel that is kneeling in the sand. She grips the wooden pommel of the leather saddle with both hands and swings one booted leg over the animal's back, kicking up a cloud of dust. Behind her stand the three great pyramids and the Sphinx in the dusty haze.

4681.expl: A traveller films herself through a trip in Egypt. First she rides a camel in front of the pyramids with a scarf over her hair. Then she walks through a covered bazaar where hundreds of coloured mosaic-glass lamps hang from the ceiling and the walls, glowing red, blue, orange and green; she reaches up, takes hold of a big blue glass lamp and turns it in her hand, laughing. Finally she stands on the deck of a wooden sailing boat at sunset with her arms spread wide.

4682.expl: A photograph in an old stone-arched spice market. A young man in a striped galabeya stands behind his open sacks of goods and pours bright orange-yellow turmeric from a big brass scoop into a sack heaped with the same powder, catching the falling stream with his other hand. Around him are more sacks with neat cones of red, yellow and orange spice, dried herbs and ginger root, with brass lanterns and a carved wooden screen behind.

4683.expl: A grinning young cook in a white coat and a white cap builds a big bowl of koshari on a steel counter in a busy restaurant. He starts from a white bowl of cooked rice, tips brown lentils out of a ladle onto it, piles tubes of pasta round the edge, then pours a big ladle of red tomato sauce over the whole heap and tops it with crispy fried onions. Loose grains of rice are scattered all over the counter.

4684.expl: In a bright open-plan office with plants and laptops, colleagues greet each other by bumping elbows instead of shaking hands. A woman raises her bent arm and taps her elbow against a man's; a bearded man in a blue shirt bumps elbows with her and laughs; then the whole team stands up along the desks, everyone with one arm bent and lifted, and they touch elbows down the row, laughing.

4685.expl: A comic-style illustration on a building site. A young workman in a yellow hard hat sits on a metal stepladder in front of an open grey fuse box on a wooden wall, with a small screwdriver held in his teeth. He holds red-handled pliers in one gloved hand and a bundle of cut red, green and blue wires in the other, and looks up at the row of circuit breakers he is working on. Coils of cable hang over his shoulder and lie on the floor, with a tool belt on his hip and a work light behind him.

4686.expl: A dark flat with no power. A woman in a yellow hard hat with a headlamp stands at a wall panel, holding a pair of pliers and a bundle of coloured wires. Close-ups show gloved hands stripping a red wire and pushing it into a circuit breaker set into a broken-open wall box. A family stands in the dark hallway behind her lighting the corridor with phone torches. She works at the fuse panel, then turns to the camera smiling as the flat lights come back on.

4688.expl: Two young men in yellow raincoats lean over the wooden rail of a small boat on a calm blue sea. A dark shape the length of the boat glides just under the surface beneath them. It blows a tall column of spray, then a barnacled humpback whale pushes its head and long ribbed throat up out of the water right beside the hull, rising higher than the men before sliding back down.

The whale slips back down and leaves a wide swirl of white foam turning on the water next to the boat.

Sunlight comes through a big window on the left. Behind him more people sit at their own desks with computers, under a wall clock and shelves of files.

4692.expl: In a supermarket a worker in a green polo shirt and apron reaches into a cardboard box full of drink cans standing on the floor by a cold room door. He carries the cans to the aisle and lines them up on a shelf already packed with rows of colourful tins and cans. He straightens the front row so all the labels face out, then picks up the empty flattened box and walks off down the aisle between the full shelves.

4693.expl: A painted scene in a corner office at sunset. A confident man in a grey suit and tie stands behind a big wooden desk, one hand on the desktop, and leans forward to shake hands with a younger man in a brown jacket who sits with his back to us in the visitor's chair. A signed folder, papers and a telephone lie on the desk between them. Through the wide window behind him is a city skyline with traffic in the streets below.

4694.expl: In a bright office a woman with short white hair in a blue suit leans over a desk and spreads a printed document on a clipboard in front of a young man in a suit, pointing at the line where he has to sign. He takes a pen and signs it. They stand up, she puts a hand on his shoulder and they shake hands while the staff at the desks behind clap. At the end she leads him to a free desk with a small box marked Welcome on it, and the whole office applauds.

4695.expl: In a flat with a parquet floor a man lifts the body of a plastic bin off a full bin bag, then tips a cardboard box of odds and ends into a bigger box on the floor. He pulls a metal drawer out of a cabinet and empties that in too. By the end the whole living room floor is buried under a spreading heap of toys, boxed games, plastic tubs and building blocks, and he stands behind the emptied cabinet holding it, mouth open at the state of the room.

4696.expl: In a climbing gym an older woman with glasses chalks her hands and takes hold of a red grip on a bouldering wall. A group of young climbers stands on the mats below her, shouting up at her, punching the air and clapping. She pulls herself off the ground and works her way up the overhanging wall while they keep cheering, raising their arms and applauding as she reaches high above them.

4697.expl: A stark black, white and yellow illustration of a sprinter in the first instant of a race. He is driving out of the starting blocks in a packed floodlit stadium, front knee still on the track, back leg extended, one arm thrown up. A burst of yellow light and jagged lightning bolts explodes from the blocks where his foot pushes off, and white lines streak backwards along the lanes behind him. A spotlight beams down and the crowd is a silhouette in the stands.

4698.expl: A man in blue overalls works in a workshop on a stripped scooter whose engine block sits exposed in the frame, tightening a part with a screwdriver and grinning at it. The shot cuts to an open car bonnet with the four-cylinder engine, belts, alternator and hoses in plain view. Then he is outside on the grass beside a huge chrome-topped V8 engine mounted on a black steel stand, first pushing it, then standing back with his hands on his head, astonished at the size of it.

4699.expl: A painted factory interior. A man in a yellow hard hat, safety glasses and a work jacket stands in the foreground holding a clipboard with a technical drawing on it and points upwards with his other hand. Behind and above him rises a wall of old industrial machines: a giant toothed gearwheel on a shaft, riveted drums and pipes, round pressure gauges with coloured dials, control panels with buttons, and steel walkways, with steam drifting up between them.

4700.expl: In a bright electronics lab a young man in glasses fits a black gripper onto the end of a jointed robotic arm bolted to the bench next to circuit boards and cables. He sits down at a sticker-covered laptop and types, watching the arm. The arm swings round on its own and holds out a white mug; he takes it, laughs and drinks from it, and two colleagues at the benches behind him raise their arms and cheer.

4701.expl: A young man in a bucket hat kneels on the wet sand beside a tall, carefully carved sandcastle with towers, battlements and arched gates; kite surfers are out on the sea behind him. The surf runs in around the base of the castle. Each wave eats away more of it: first the outer walls slump, then the towers collapse one after another, until only a shapeless lump of wet sand and one small stump are left in the foam, and he sits back on his heels looking at it.

4702.expl: A brown and white goat pushes its head out between the boards of a wooden gate in a barn pen where other goats are standing. It works its horns and shoulders through the gap and squeezes its whole body out of the pen. Outside, a farmer in a straw hat lunges for it past a row of feed sacks but misses, and the goat gallops off down a red dirt track between rows of olive trees, growing smaller as it runs away.

4703.expl: A man in a navy suit and a white hard hat presses a carved wooden sign into place above the door of a new stone building, then pulls a cord to drop the cloth covering beside it. Outside on the steps he hauls on a halyard and pulls a green flag up a tall white flagpole while a crowd of people in suits and hard hats claps and two drummers play. He then cuts a teal ribbon stretched across the steps and the crowd applauds.

4704.expl: A heavy bearded man sits bare-chested in a small wooden sauna wearing a thick grey fur hat with ear flaps and a white towel around his waist. In front of him a pit of grey stones glows orange in the middle. He reaches for a wooden bucket at his side, lifts a wooden ladle of water and tips it over the hot stones. A thick cloud of white steam bursts up and fills the whole cabin until he almost disappears in it. He sits back grinning and gasping, waving a hand through the steam, with a snowy window behind him.

4705.expl: A sunlit colonial town square. A woman in a denim jacket films herself smiling and clapping while behind her a group of musicians in matching pale blue shirts play guitars and a tuba beside a stone fountain. A young waiter in a bow tie and apron carries a tray of glasses out of an archway and waves at the camera. The shot pulls back higher and higher: families, a policeman and small children gather in a ring around the players, and the whole plaza with its church tower and yellow and red buildings comes into view under a bright blue sky.

4706.expl: A packed football stadium at dusk. In the front row a heavy man in a sky blue shirt with a striped scarf around his neck throws both arms in the air, tips his head back and roars with his mouth wide open. Around him fans with flags painted on their cheeks yell and punch the air. The camera lifts to show tier after tier of supporters on their feet, arms up, mouths open in one long roar, and finally the whole bowl of the ground with a small boy on his father's shoulders in the middle of it.

4707.vo: Look up, say uh-uh. - Uh. - All good?
4707.expl: A free health check under a white gazebo at a school fair. A young woman in a white nurse's tunic leans over a seated young man and shines a small lit instrument into his ear. He tips his head back, opens his mouth wide and she presses his tongue down with a wooden stick and looks into his throat. She then straps a blue blood pressure cuff around his upper arm and listens while he sits still and smiles. Other students queue behind the table, watching and giving a thumbs up.

4708.expl: A soft watercolour of a dirt track winding through vineyards and olive trees towards a little chapel with cypresses on a hill. A cream and orange minibus is stopped at the roadside with its door folded open. A boy in a straw hat and backpack jumps down from the step with his arms out, another boy in a yellow shirt points up the track, and a woman in a green dress runs after them with a wicker picnic basket and a camera. Ahead of them on the track a man in a white shirt with a lanyard holds a wooden paddle high above his head so the group can see where to follow, and a second picnic hamper stands on the ground by the bus.

A cream and orange minibus is stopped at the roadside with its door folded open. A boy in a straw hat and backpack jumps down from the step with his arms out, another boy in a yellow shirt points up the track, and a woman in a green dress runs after them with a wicker picnic basket and a camera. Ahead of them on the track a man in a white shirt with a lanyard holds a wooden paddle high above his head so the group can see where to follow, and a second picnic hamper stands on the ground by the bus.

4709.expl: A young man in a bucket hat climbs into a minibus with a small yellow flag clipped to the dashboard, then turns to the camera grinning and waves a paper ticket and a wristband in the air. The shot cuts to his own view in the bow of a wooden longtail boat racing across bright turquoise water between tall green limestone cliffs. Finally he stands with about ten other people, all in the same wide-brimmed hats and daypacks, packed together on a stone viewing platform in front of a wide waterfall; they crouch, throw their arms up and cheer at the camera together.

4710.expl: Three people work out together on a path in a green park. An older woman in a bright red tracksuit stands in the middle between a young woman in a mint jacket and a young man in a grey hoodie. All three stretch both arms straight up over their heads with their palms open, then jog on the spot swinging their arms bent at the elbow, then swing both arms wide out to the sides at shoulder height. They keep smiling at the camera while other walkers and a dog pass under the fresh green trees behind them.

4711.expl: A rower drives a narrow single scull across flat water in a navy racing suit. He hauls both oars through the stroke with his arms and shoulders straining, teeth bared and forehead screwed up. The camera closes in until only his face fills the frame: eyes squeezed shut, cheeks tight, mouth open and gasping, skin shining with sweat, hair stuck to his forehead. A line of spectators stands on the far bank under a blue sky.

4712.expl: A young man puts his mouth close to a window furred with white frost and breathes hard on the glass until a clear round hole opens in it and his face shows through. He is then at a party with friends around him, leaning over a birthday cake covered in lit candles; he purses his lips, breathes out hard and the flames go out. Next he leans over a row of coloured paper party blowers on a white table and puffs them so they uncoil and shoot out one after another. Finally a long table crowded with dozens of candles and a room full of friends all lean in and puff together, then cheer with their arms up under the streamers and fairy lights.

4713.expl: On a stone quay in an old harbour, two men in black overcoats and flat caps hand a heavy brown leather suitcase down to a white haired old man in a long dark coat as he steps into a small wooden rowing boat. Along the harbour wall a line of villagers in headscarves, shawls and old fashioned coats stand pressed together with their hands lifted, waving at him. The boat pushes off and is rowed out of the harbour; the camera holds on it as it gets smaller and smaller on the flat grey sea until it is only a dark speck on the horizon.

4714.expl: An elderly man in a tweed waistcoat and bow tie sits at a table in a hall full of onlookers, handling a painted porcelain vase in white cotton gloves. He lifts it up and tips it to look at its base, then screws a small brass eyeglass into his eye socket and studies the flowers painted on the side from a few centimetres away, turning the vase slowly in his gloved hands. He sets it down on the table, looks up at the couple sitting opposite and tells them what he has found while the crowd of older visitors behind him leans in, mouths open.

4715.expl: A man and a woman in clear safety goggles stand at a weathered picnic table in a sunny park with a big green striped watermelon on it. Taking turns, they stretch coloured rubber bands over the melon one at a time until dozens of them squeeze a tight belt around its middle and the fruit bulges out above and below. They lean back from the table grinning and flinching. The melon bursts: the green rind splits into curved shards and bright red flesh sprays across the whole table and out onto the grass. The two of them jump back, clench their fists and shout with delight.

4716.expl: A man with a headlamp, a khaki shirt and a backpack pushes his way through thick jungle, ducking under hanging vines and climbing over roots on a muddy path, looking around him all the time. He then wades along a dark dripping rock tunnel with only his headlamp lighting the walls. He comes out on a wet boulder at the mouth of a cave: sunbeams cut down through the opening onto a turquoise pool with a tall waterfall pouring into it. He stands on the rock, machete in one hand, and throws his arms wide, staring up at what he has found.

4717.expl: A man with a headlamp pushes between huge elephant ear leaves in a green jungle, then the picture goes almost completely black: nothing can be seen except the white glare of his headlamp and a faint outline of his face and shirt. He crouches in the blackness beside a wet rock wall, the small beam picking out drips and stones a metre in front of him. He walks on through the black tunnel towards a bright opening at the far end, a silhouette against the light, and steps out onto a boulder in front of a wide waterfall falling into a turquoise pool, where he spreads his arms and looks up.

4718.expl: An extreme close up fills the screen with one brown eye: the white, the ring of brown around the black centre, the reflections of the ceiling lights and the long lashes above and below. A thumb comes in and gently pulls the upper lid open wider. An optician holds a small black torch beside the eye and shines it in, and the brown ring lights up amber while the black centre shrinks. The shot pulls back to show a young woman smiling in an optician's shop with walls of spectacle frames behind her, and finally the optician holds up a big cut through model of an eyeball beside her while she points at it and talks.

4719.expl: A soft painted portrait of a young person filling the whole frame from the top of the head to the base of the neck. They have tousled mid brown hair, thick dark eyebrows, large brown eyes with small white highlights, pink cheeks and a small closed lipped smile. Below the mouth the rounded chin and the line of the jaw stand out clearly against the pale neck, and behind them is a blurred wash of green meadow and blue sky.

4720.expl: A group of teenagers crowd a phone held at arm's length in a bright classroom and take turns pulling faces into it. A girl with curly hair pushes her lips out in a fish pout and rolls her eyes sideways. A boy in glasses shoves his face right up to the lens, then grins with his mouth wide open. A girl with rainbow braids stares with her eyes stretched as wide as they go and her lips pushed forward. At the end the three of them squeeze their heads together and burst out laughing at the camera, mouths wide open, one of them showing her braces, while classmates work at the desks behind.

4721.expl: A woman in a soaking wet orange hooded raincoat films herself on a grassy hillside above a lake, grinning and pointing back over her shoulder at a full rainbow arching right across the grey sky. She turns to look at it, and second by second the colours grow weaker: first the left hand side thins out, then only a short faint band is left low on the right, and then the sky is empty and grey. She keeps standing there in the wet grass looking at the place where it was.

She turns to look at it, and second by second the colours grow weaker: first the left hand side thins out, then only a short faint band is left low on the right, and then the sky is empty and grey. She keeps standing there in the wet grass looking at the place where it was.

4722.expl: An outdoor garden party on a lawn, with a floral arch, string lights and a cream sofa behind. Guests in summer dresses and pale suits stand in a group; several of the women wear dark sunglasses. One by one the women swoon and sag at the knees while the others grab them under the arms and hold them up. A man in a beige suit fans himself with a white plate. By the end everyone is lying on the grass and on cushions, still fanning themselves with plates.

4723.expl: An indoor trampoline park with a huge pit of coloured foam cubes. A man in orange shorts lies half buried in the cubes, laughing. Others run to the edge and drop off it, dropping through the air into the pit and disappearing under the blocks. More people leap in one after another, landing on their backs and sides among the foam, until several of them are lying in the pit surrounded by scattered cubes.

At the end two women lie side by side in the foam pit laughing together.

4725.expl: A sunlit farmhouse kitchen where three generations make pizza together. A man stretches a disc of dough in the air while a small boy presses his own ball of dough on the floured worktop and a grandmother rolls out another with a wooden rolling pin. Then a woman and a man carry two finished margherita pizzas out of the oven. The scene moves outside at night to a long table under string lights, where a steaming margherita is set down in front of the whole family and everyone clinks glasses of red wine over the food.

4726.expl: An older man in a flat cap, checked shirt and rubber boots works his vegetable plot at sunset beside a sunflower field. He bends down and pulls carrots out of the dark soil by their green tops, then throws handfuls of grain out across a freshly seeded bed. He carries a wooden crate along the rows while a dog runs past, and finally stands behind a wooden hand cart loaded with cabbages, marrows and a crate of carrots, smiling and giving a thumbs up.

4727.expl: A man in a blue polo shirt spends a sunny day with his children in a suburban garden and park. He jogs alongside a child in a helmet learning to ride a blue bike, holding the handlebar. He crouches on the grass and lifts a baby high over his head, then sets the baby on his shoulders and stands up, both of them laughing. He plays catch with an older boy who throws a yellow ball back to him, and the shot lifts away over the neighbourhood to a wide green park full of families.

4728.expl: A woman in blue medical scrubs comes home through her front door at the end of a shift, hanging her keys in a bowl. She yawns hugely with her eyes screwed shut, peels off her grey jacket and drops her bag, yawning again and rubbing her face with her hand. She staggers to the sofa and drops onto it sideways, and the clip ends with her lying asleep on the cushions with her eyes closed and her phone beside her.

4729.expl: Two young women walk through a dark haunted-house corridor at a funfair, hung with fake cobwebs and strings of coloured lights. They cling to each other with their eyes wide and their mouths open, edging forward. A masked figure in a white mask appears in the corridor behind them and they bolt, running towards the camera through a black curtain. They burst out into the daylight of the fairground, still gripping each other's hands, panting with their hands pressed to their chests.

4730.expl: A photograph taken from above of nine people in business suits seated around a large round wooden conference table in a formal wood-panelled room. The nine lean in from all sides of the table and stack their hands together in the middle, talking as they do it, while a loose sheet of paper falls through the air over the table.

4731.expl: A flag-raising ceremony outside a large curved glass building. A woman in a grey uniform suit hauls on a rope and a flag climbs its pole above her. The shot widens to a long line of women in the same grey suits, each raising a different national flag on a white pole, so that the flags of many countries rise together in a row. Rows of officials in dark suits stand watching in silence, and the final shots show the whole semicircle of flagpoles in front of the glass facade with a large flag flying at the centre.

4732.expl: A man in a work shirt builds a wooden fence across a sunny back garden. He holds a squared timber post upright, then screws a horizontal rail into it with a cordless drill. He knocks a post into place with a yellow rubber mallet along a run of fence that already carries rows of vertical palings, checks the top rail with a spirit level, and works along a string line pegged into the fresh soil. At the end the finished fence runs the full length of the lawn and he leans over the top of it and smiles.

4733.expl: A watercolour illustration of a boy lying ill in bed. He is propped on a pillow under a checked quilt with a glass thermometer in his mouth and a folded blue cloth laid across his forehead. His cheeks and nose are painted bright red and orange wavy lines rise from his head to show the heat coming off him. A lamp glows on the wooden bedside table beside the bed.

4734.expl: A young woman lies ill on a sofa under a thick grey blanket in a lamp-lit living room, her face flushed red and a thermometer in her mouth. An older woman sits beside her, holds the thermometer steady and reads a second one, frowning at the number. She puts a hand on the young woman's forehead to feel how hot she is, then lays a folded damp cloth across it and smooths it into place, staying at her side the whole time.

4735.expl: Soldiers in camouflage uniforms train in hand-to-hand combat on a churned muddy field under a grey sky. A woman in uniform drives blow after blow with her gloved fists into a black padded shield held up by a man in front of her. He then grabs her from behind around the chest and they grapple, stumbling in the mud. Around them dozens of other soldiers do the same drill in pairs on grey mats laid over the mud, and at the end she stands close to camera throwing punches into the air, breathing hard.

Behind her rows of other uniformed soldiers work in pairs across the whole ground, and one lifts another clean off her feet and throws her over her shoulder onto the mats. 4737.expl: A sunny tropical back garden by a pool. A woman in swimwear holds a tall glass under a brass garden tap and lets the water run into it until it brims over. She then tips a grey metal jug with a curved handle and pours a long stream of water from it into a rainbow-striped watering can, and pours another jug of water into a big black bucket. Finally she stands over a blue inflatable paddling pool and fills it with a green garden hose while friends on sun loungers behind her cheer and raise their arms.

4738.expl: A young woman kneels on the tiled floor of a small hostel room with bunk beds and digs frantically through a black backpack, pulling out handfuls of clothes and throwing them behind her. She lifts the mattress and pillow of the lower bunk and pushes her head under the bed frame to look underneath. A wide shot shows the whole room afterwards: clothes, caps and shoes lie scattered over the entire floor, from the door to the window, with almost no bare tiles left. She then sits in the middle of the scattered clothes holding a red passport, stares at it open-mouthed, and finally hugs it to her chest and laughs.

4739.expl: A woman in a mustard cardigan with round sunglasses pushed up on her head leans over a second-hand stall in a busy street market, with lit shop fronts and passers-by behind her. She rummages through a heap of old objects piled on a wooden crate: cloth, hardback books, old film cameras, a brass jug and a mosaic lamp. She pulls a dark wooden case out of the pile, sets it down and opens the lid, and her mouth falls open: inside, on red velvet, lies an enormous cut diamond. She lifts it out with both hands and holds it up in front of the open case, grinning.

4740.expl: A grey, overcast roadside scene drawn in comic style. A young man in a beanie and fingerless gloves kneels on the cracked tarmac and holds the forearm of a second person who is sitting in front of him wearing a cycling helmet and torn trousers. The second person's elbow and forearm are grazed open and bleeding red. The kneeling man holds up a sterile wipe packet he has just torn open; the empty wrapper flies away in the air behind him. An open green first-aid tin sits on the ground with rolls of gauze, plasters and scissors spilling out of it, a loose bandage roll unwinding across the tarmac. A bicycle lies on its side in the background and a figure watches from a distance.

4741.expl: A young man in yellow waterproof dungarees stands in a small blue and orange wooden fishing boat on open sea below green cliffs. He leans right back with both hands on a fishing rod that is bent almost double, dragging the line up out of the water until a large silver fish breaks the surface on the hook and swings over the side of the boat. He then works a round landing net, hauling it up out of the water and swinging it in over a wooden crate on the deck, where several silver fish are already lying. At the end he lifts the full crate up towards the camera with both hands and grins.

4742.expl: An outdoor bootcamp session on a grass field at golden hour, with pull-up bars, mats and kettlebells set out and a trainer and other athletes working in the background. A woman in a dark red sports bra and leggings, with visible arm and stomach muscles, swings two heavy battle ropes up and down with both arms, her jaw set. She then swings a large black kettlebell up between her legs with both hands, breathing hard. Finally she jumps up onto a tall wooden plyo box, lands on top of it, straightens up with her arms thrown open and shouts in triumph while the trainer claps behind her.

4743.expl: A young man with headphones round his neck films himself in a window seat of an airliner. In the first shot the plane is racing along the ground past green fields and low houses outside the window and he grins into the camera as it lifts off. The shot cuts to cruising altitude at sunset: the wing and engine are lit orange above a floor of cloud, and he holds up a plastic cup of orange juice from the drinks trolley that a crew member is pushing past behind him. In the last shots it is night, and through the window a whole coastal city glows in orange lines of street lights far below as the plane descends; he turns from the window and claps his hands together with delight.

4744.expl: A pale turquoise salt lake with bare desert hills behind it. A woman in an orange swimsuit and a wide straw sun hat lies on her back on the surface of the water, arms spread out, not sinking, with a yellow rubber duck bobbing at her shoulder. Behind her three more people lie on their backs in a row in the same way, two of them with their hands folded behind their heads and their eyes closed. The woman drifts, then opens a glossy magazine and holds it up above her face and reads it while she is still lying flat on the water, her feet sticking up at the front of the shot.

4745.expl: A boy in a green t-shirt crouches on a bank of round pebbles beside a clear turquoise mountain river and sets a small white paper boat down on the water. The current takes it at once: the boat is carried out from the shallow pebbly edge into the deeper green water and moves steadily away downstream, turning slowly as the surface ripples past it. The camera follows it as it travels the length of the reach and passes under the arch of an old stone bridge, with white rapids visible upstream beyond the bridge, until the boy is left standing on the grassy bank watching it go.

4746.expl: A viewing spot at the end of an airport runway under a bright blue sky, with a row of parked airliners on the apron behind. Two men stand on a low concrete wall with big white telephoto lenses on tripods, one crouched behind his camera with his eye to the viewfinder, tracking a jumbo jet as it comes in to land; a third watches beside them. A young man with bleached hair in a denim jacket leans back in the foreground filming himself and staring straight up. The aircraft passes directly overhead, so low that its whole underside, four engines and lowered landing gear fill the frame, while the photographers swing their lenses up to follow it and the man raises one finger and points at it.

4747.expl: An older man in a flat cap and a dark knitted cardigan stands at the stern rail of a ferry crossing the Bosphorus at dusk, with the wake churning white behind him and a domed mosque and the city skyline on the shore. He holds a torn piece of bread in one hand and holds crumbs out in the other. One big white and grey sea bird glides in from the left at head height with its wings fully spread; then a second and a third arrive, and by the end of the clip a dozen of them are hanging in the air all around him, wings out and red beaks open, some almost within touching distance while he laughs.

One big white and grey sea bird glides in from the left at head height with its wings fully spread; then a second and a third arrive, and by the end of the clip a dozen of them are hanging in the air all around him, wings out and red beaks open, some almost within touching distance while he laughs.

4748.expl: A steady shot filmed through an aircraft window in flight. The white wing with its upturned winglet cuts across the frame against a deep blue sky. Below it, white masses of water vapour drift past far above the ground: at first scattered puffs with fields and roads visible in the gaps between them, then thicker banks, and by the end an unbroken white layer stretching to the horizon so that the land is completely hidden and only the flat white top and the blue sky above it can be seen.

4749.expl: A montage of people in the air. Two tandem skydivers hang under a canopy above a patchwork of green and brown fields with clouds below them. A woman swings in a harness under a rainbow paraglider wing over an alpine valley. A hot-air balloon drifts at sunrise with two passengers leaning on the basket rim. Then a group of skydivers falls through blue sky, and in the last shot about twenty of them have joined hands into a single wide ring against the clouds.

4750.expl: A woman in pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair kneels on a wide white bed in a high-rise flat and folds washing. She holds up a tie-dye t-shirt, lays it flat and folds it, then folds a grey lace top. A wicker basket of clean washing sits beside her. The folded items grow into neat stacks, and by the end the whole bed is walled in by tall towers of folded clothes in every colour.

4751.expl: A woman in an orange jumper films herself while holding a yellow umbrella high above her head so the group behind her can see it. She walks backwards down a narrow cobbled lane between yellow and white houses, and a small group of visitors follows her. She leads them past a yellow tram on rails, along a busy street with more people trailing behind, and turns back to smile at them while a stray dog trots alongside.
