4752.expl: A young man in a white apron is baking in a bright kitchen. He looks worried at the hob, where a pale pancake sits in a frying pan and he prods it with a spatula. He pulls on black oven gloves and opens the oven, which glows orange inside. He lifts out a baking tray of biscuits that have come out completely black and cracked, holds it up, and leans over it with his face screwed up in disappointment.

4753.expl: Two young men stand on a suburban pavement beside a low brick wall with a road bike leaning against it. One in a navy hoodie stands with his arms folded tight and his jaw set, refusing to look up. The other, in black with a takeaway coffee cup, leans on the wall and talks to him steadily. The folded arms drop, the first one looks down and half-smiles, and the two step together into a long hug over the wall.

4754.expl: An amateur football match on a worn grass pitch. A player in a dark maroon kit shoulder-barges a player in white off the ball and the white player goes down. The female referee in black points sharply at the offender. He turns to her with both palms raised, arguing and pleading that he did nothing. She raises a yellow card above her head; he keeps talking at her with his hands open, then walks off grimacing.

4755.vo: I'll show you this. Oh, I see.
4755.expl: In a clinic a doctor in a white coat stands at a lit X-ray viewer showing the bones of a hand and wrist. She points a pen at a thin dark line running across one of the bones. The young man beside her leans in and looks at the line on the film. He then sits back with his forearm in a thick white plaster cast held up in a blue sling, winces, and holds the casted arm against his chest.

4756.expl: A woman with a red scarf rides a bicycle along a paved riverside path with a long baguette sticking out of the front wicker basket; the Eiffel Tower and a stone bridge over the river fill the background. She then walks between rows of a purple lavender field at dusk with her arms out, turning to laugh at the sky. Finally she sits under the red awning of a pavement cafe at sunset, biting into a croissant with crumbs on the paper in front of her.

4757.expl: A teenager in a plaid shirt leaps down a flight of stone steps outside a big brick building with both arms flung wide and his mouth open in a shout. He vaults over a metal farm gate onto a country lane at golden hour. He rides a bicycle down an empty road through open fields with both hands off the bars and his arms stretched out to the sides. At the end he stands with the bike on a grassy hilltop above a wide valley, tips his head back to the setting sun and throws his arms open.

4758.expl: A man in a cream sweater opens a tall fridge-freezer in a bright white kitchen and looks at completely bare shelves. The camera drops to an empty freezer drawer holding only one ice-cube tray. Then hands start loading the shelves: bags of frozen vegetables and berries, tubs, boxes and packets, until every shelf and drawer is packed. The last shot is a wide of the double doors open on a fridge stuffed from top to bottom while the man beams at it.

4759.expl: Rows of pale baguettes on a wire rack slide out of a glowing bakery oven. Trays of croissants and pains au chocolat are pushed into a shop window while a crowd in winter coats watches from the wet Paris street outside. A man in a shirt and a flour-smeared apron picks up a baguette, holds it to his ear like a telephone, then turns to the camera grinning and holds it up in front of the bakery door.

4760.expl: On a sunlit cobbled street in Lisbon two teenagers stand face to face with a single ice cream cone between them; he hands it across to her and they slap hands. They then run together along the rails after a yellow tram. The scene cuts to a wooden jetty at sunset where a group of friends dance, then pull into one tight huddle with their arms around each other, silhouetted against the low sun.

4761.expl: On a frozen lake under a low winter sun a man in an orange hooded parka cooks breakfast on a small portable gas stove. A single egg fries in a black pan; he lays strips of streaky bacon in beside it and they curl and brown. The shot widens to a large flat pan holding rows of bacon rashers around a heap of fried potato chunks and two fried eggs, which he lifts towards the camera, steaming in the cold air.

4762.expl: A man carrying a leather briefcase walks through a doorway into a narrow white room hung with small framed drawings. He moves on into a larger white hall where other visitors stand in front of sculptures on plinths, and tips his head back to look up at a big block-coloured abstract canvas. The last shots put him alone in a vast glass-roofed hall, walking towards an enormous painting on the far wall and spreading his arms in front of it.

4763.expl: A young man slouches on a sofa with a controller, playing a racing game on a big TV. Next a young woman sits at a desk in a dark room lit by pink and green RGB lights, hands on a glowing keyboard and mouse in front of a game on the monitor. Then a whole living room of friends leans towards the screen with controllers up, shouting. It ends in a packed esports arena where the crowd stands and cheers as a champion is shown on the giant screen above the stage.

A blue bowl of crisps sits on the cushion between them. She jumps up onto the sofa with a fist in the air, cheering, and crisps scatter over the seat; he throws his head back laughing. They drop back down onto the cushions still playing.

4765.expl: A modelling-clay scene of a cottage garden. A woman in a straw hat and blue dungarees strides along a sandy path tipping a watering can, and a thick blue stream of water pours over a raised bed of tomato plants. Behind her stands a small greenhouse with a clay frame and pale glass walls and roof, with plants inside. A cottage with washing on the line, a wooden gate, seedlings, empty flower pots and a trowel fill the rest of the garden.

4766.expl: An elderly woman in a straw hat, blue cardigan and a floral apron pushes open a wooden garden gate under an archway of roses and comes down the path. She walks between tall pink and white hollyhocks, then bends over a bed of tomato plants tied to bamboo canes and turns the ripe red fruit over in her hand. Further along she works between beds of marigolds and dahlias beside a wheelbarrow heaped with cut flowers, then stands in the middle of the beds and throws her arms open.

Further along she works between beds of marigolds and dahlias beside a wheelbarrow heaped with cut flowers, then stands in the middle of the beds and throws her arms open.

4767.expl: A woman in a wide straw hat, white shirt and a denim work apron with tools in the pockets clips a round clipped bush with a pair of long shears in a formal park garden. She works her way along a row of the round bushes, then swaps the shears for a metal watering can and pours a fan of water over a long bed of pink and white flowers. She finishes walking down the gravel path between the clipped bushes towards the camera, smiling, shears in her gloved hand.

4768.expl: A string of reaction shots in a living room strung with fairy lights. A woman claps a hand over her mouth beside a present with a red bow. A man on the sofa holds up two red-backed playing cards, eyes wide and mouth open, a game box on the table in front of him. A woman laughs with her mouth open, then covers her face as confetti falls around her over a board game. The last shot is the whole group on and around the sofa, all gasping at once at the board game on the coffee table.

4769.expl: A woman in a denim cap with a plait, an orange fleece and a backpack holds the camera at arm's length on a canyon viewpoint at sunrise. Behind her a wooden post-and-rail fence runs along the rim, closing off the drop. She turns from the camera to the canyon, her mouth open, and swings her free arm out towards the orange-lit rock walls; then she claps her hand over her mouth and keeps staring out over the fence at the canyon.

4770.expl: A claymation airport departure area. A traveller with a backpack and a duffel bag walks through an open rounded door into a ribbed jet bridge tunnel. On the right an agent in a blue uniform and cap sits at a wooden desk with a monitor and raises a hand towards him. Blue rope barrier posts snake across the floor, rows of moulded seats stand empty and a white and red airliner waits outside the tall window.

4771.expl: A red-haired woman in a bright green raincoat opens a series of ever grander gates. First a low white picket gate in a cottage flower garden, then a heavy wooden farm gate with sheep grazing behind it, then tall black iron gates opening onto an avenue of clipped hedges. Finally she grips a huge gold-painted gate and looks through it at an enormous stately palace, then turns to the camera smiling with the palace and its wide gravel forecourt behind her.

4772.expl: An orange and pink sunset over a flat coastal marsh. An enormous mass of starlings wheels across the sky, thousands of dark specks moving as one body and changing shape from a curl to an S to a wide spiral. People stand along a wooden boardwalk watching; an older woman in a plaid coat and beret points up at the birds while a grey-haired man beside her stares open-mouthed at the sky.

4773.expl: A cobbled city square with cafe terraces and pastel townhouses. A young man stands alone in the middle of the square playing an accordion, his open case on the stones in front of him. A few passers-by slow down, then more stop, a cyclist halts, and within seconds dozens of people have collected around him in a wide ring. By the end a large crowd fills the square and everyone is clapping. A woman with a long red plait watches from the foreground.

4774.expl: A cartoon garden scene under a blossoming apple tree hung with bunting. A white-haired old woman sits laughing in a floral armchair; a grown man in a shirt and brown trousers stands behind her laughing with his head back; a younger man holds a small boy in dungarees up in the air, and the boy throws his arms wide as a red and yellow beach ball flies above them. A scruffy little dog stands on the grass and a picnic table with a checked cloth sits to the right.

4775.expl: A bright living room with plants on the windowsill. A white-haired woman in a cream cable sweater sits on a sofa cradling a tiny swaddled baby whose face is still red and crumpled, only days old. She smiles down at it. A second older woman sits beside her and rests a hand on the bundle, then a teenage boy and a young woman lean in from either side. All four gather around the baby and finally look up at the camera, smiling, the infant still asleep in the great-grandmother's arms.

4776.expl: A sepia engraving of a man standing on a tree-lined park path. He wears a long tailored coat over a waistcoat, a bow tie and a tall top hat, and has a waxed moustache. With one gloved hand he lifts the top hat off his head in greeting, smiling slightly at the viewer, while his other gloved hand rests on the curved handle of a walking cane. Bare trees and a railing line the path behind him.

4777.expl: A silver-haired man in a grey three-piece suit moves through a city. He holds a cafe door open and waves someone ahead of him inside. In a marble shopping arcade he bends down and picks up a blue patterned scarf that a passer-by has dropped. At a rainy tram stop an elderly woman is standing with heavy paper shopping bags and loose oranges; he steps in and opens his black umbrella over her head. Finally, on a tram, he lifts his straw hat to a seated woman.

4778.expl: Inside a small craft workshop. Two hands hold a black open-ended spanner next to a shiny chrome one, comparing them against a pale board where a whole graded row of spanners hangs in size order. A woman in navy overalls and safety glasses then stands at a workbench with a clamp and vice, using two fine tools to fit a small brass clock movement with visible toothed wheels. At the end she reaches up to a carved wooden cuckoo clock hanging on the timber wall while a colleague works behind her.

4779.expl: A travel selfie video. A man with a backpack films himself grinning in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, its columns and bronze horse statue above him and cyclists crossing the square behind. The scene cuts to him leaning on a stone parapet in the mountains, looking across a pine forest at a white fairy-tale castle half hidden in mist. Finally he is inside a festival beer tent strung with lights, where men in traditional jackets and hats hold up stone beer mugs and a giant pretzel while he raises a mug of his own to the camera.

4780.expl: A plain office with a venetian blind. A man and a woman sit side by side at a wooden table, each with their own printed document and pen in front of them, and each signs their own sheet. They then twist the wedding rings off their fingers and set the two rings down on the bare table between the papers. Both stand, turn away from each other, and walk out of the room through two different grey doors, leaving the two documents, the two pens and the two rings behind on the table.

4781.expl: An outdoor garden ceremony. A blonde bride in a white dress and veil, tears on her cheeks, slides a ring onto the finger of a groom in a black suit while he laughs with joy. They kiss under a tall flower arch. Confetti falls as they turn hand in hand and walk back down the aisle between rows of clapping guests, past flower arrangements and lavender, and at the end the whole wedding party throws their arms in the air and cheers.

4782.expl: A sunny asphalt school yard fenced in behind a low building. A girl in denim dungarees with yellow ribbons in her bunches runs up and then hops along a hopscotch grid chalked on the ground, landing with both feet in the numbered squares. Other children swing a long skipping rope to one side, a boy bounces a ball at the back and a teacher watches from behind. At the end her friends rush in and pile into a laughing group hug around her.

4783.expl: A young woman with curly hair carries a small chocolate cake with one lit candle up behind a young man sitting indoors; he turns and his mouth falls open. The scene cuts to an outdoor basketball court at sunset where he dribbles a ball with the low sun behind him, then to the same woman standing under the hoop holding up a handmade sign with a red heart on it and cheering. In the last shots the two of them stand face to face with white cake frosting smeared over their cheeks and chins, laughing, then lean into the camera together with a lit dome and Paris rooftops behind them.

4784.expl: A large family party in a house hung with cut-paper bunting. A man holds out a wrapped present with a purple bow to a very old woman, who takes it with both hands while relatives watch and smile. She is then handed an open tin of chocolate-chip cookies by a middle-aged woman in a floral shirt. A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.

A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.

4785.expl: A young woman on a sunlit paved terrace outside a house holds an empty stemmed glass up to the camera and smiles. In close-up, orange juice is poured from a jug into the glass until it is full, standing on a pale stone table beside plates and a second jug. The shot widens: the woman and a young man sit at the laid table on the terrace, oleander bushes and a low wall behind them, and raise their glasses of juice towards the camera.

4786.expl: A dark tropical beach at night. A woman in a white shirt stands at the water's edge where the breaking waves shine bright blue, and bends down towards them. She crouches and drags her fingers through the wet sand, and hundreds of tiny points of blue light flash on around her hand. She draws a curling spiral in the sand that glows blue and slowly fades. In the last shot she stands back as a wide sheet of water rushes in, the whole shoreline flashing with blue points of light under a full moon and palm trees.

4787.expl: A high-contrast black and white illustration of a prospector's hands, dark water and trees behind them. The two hands tilt a wide round pan at the edge of a river; water and grit spill over the near rim in a black stream. Inside the pan, picked out in bright yellow against the black and white drawing, lie two solid gold bars, a heap of rough gold nuggets and a scatter of fine gold grains, with one nugget lifted between finger and thumb and glinting above the pile.

4788.expl: A busy hair salon. A stylist with long braids leans down and cups her hand to the ear of a client sitting under a leopard-print cape; the client's eyes go wide and her mouth drops open. The client is moved under a dome hair dryer and the two keep talking closely. Two women in the background stare with open mouths at a man having his hair clipped by a barber. At the salon's front desk a receptionist looks up from her computer with her mouth open, then the stylist is back beside the client under the dryer, both wide-eyed.

4789.expl: A wood-panelled office with a huge political map of Africa covering the back wall, stuck with coloured pins. A woman in a green suit sits behind a broad polished desk; a man in a dark suit stands beside her holding out an open folder, and she gestures with a rubber stamp in her hand as she speaks to him. An assistant with a tablet stands to one side while the man works at the map behind her. She signs a document, presses the rubber stamp onto it, closes the folder and sits back alone at the desk facing the camera.

4790.expl: A dark ink-and-wash drawing of a long boardroom table in a panelled government room with heavy curtains and flags. Two men lean in from opposite sides of the table, faces twisted, shouting and jabbing their fingers at each other. Papers are strewn across the polished wood and one sheet is still in the air. Other men in suits sit or brace their hands on the table between them, and a woman with a folder has stopped in the open doorway at the back of the room.

4791.expl: A formal meeting in a tall wood-panelled room with a blue flag on a stand and daylight through a shuttered window. A woman in a dark suit stands and leans over the long table, setting down an open buff folder of documents in front of the others. Loose white sheets and a notepad lie on the polished wood beside a glass water jug. Five colleagues in suits, some seated and some standing behind the leather chairs, watch her place the folder.

4792.expl: A small girl in a pale dress spins on the spot in a beamed living room, her skirt flying out, while a white-haired woman in an armchair claps and laughs. The two sit at a low table with a flowered tea set as an elderly man sips from a small cup. In close-up, the girl's hands lower a young flowering plant, roots and soil together, into a hole dug in dark earth while a man's hand steadies it and a trowel lies beside the hole. The camera pulls back to a sunny garden bed where grandparents and several children kneel in a row, setting plants into the soil and watering them.

4793.expl: A white-bearded man in a checked shirt stands on a wooden dock over a lake with a curly-haired boy, both gripping a fishing rod as a small fish comes up on the line. The scene cuts to a workshop close-up: a large weathered hand presses a folded sheet of sandpaper along the pitched roof of a half-finished wooden birdhouse, rubbing it back and forth while a child's hand holds the box steady. The man then stands at the workbench with five children around him, gesturing over the finished birdhouse. In the last shot two old men play chess at a low table in a park while children watch and kites fly overhead.

4794.expl: A white-haired woman in a flowered apron and oven gloves lifts a hot tray of chocolate-chip cookies out of the oven in a wooden cabin kitchen while a small girl behind her presses her hands together and gasps. Two girls crowd in beside her and she hands each of them a cookie from the tray. She then sits in a wing armchair with a picture book open on her lap, one girl asleep against her shoulder and the other leaning in wide-eyed as she turns the pages. In the last shot she sits at the head of a long garden table with the girls and other adults, all clinking teacups over a plate of the cookies.

4795.expl: In a pine kitchen an elderly woman in a floral apron pulls an open oven door down and slides out a tray of chocolate-chip cookies while two small girls bounce beside her with clenched fists and open mouths. In close-up her hands hold out two of the warm cookies and each girl bites into one. She then sits in an armchair knitting a blue square on needles with a wool ball in her lap and a girl dozing against her arm, and reads aloud from a picture book with her glasses on. The last shot is a garden table under fruit trees where she and the children sit around a cake stand and teapot.

4796.expl: A boy in a cap and blue T-shirt runs along a gravel path past flower beds, then leaps into the arms of an elderly man outside a modern house, who swings him up off the ground. The boy and a white-haired woman tip a metal watering can together over pink dahlias in the garden. At a wooden garden table the boy leans on his elbows and carefully leans two playing cards against each other into a standing triangle, with more cards laid flat on the boards in front of him. The last shot is the whole family in the back garden, children at the picnic table and on a rug on the lawn.

4797.expl: At an outdoor restaurant on an Italian street a young waiter in a white shirt and dark apron stands over a checked tablecloth and grates a large block of hard cheese onto a plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce. He keeps going, grinning, as the diner beside him leans in laughing and the cheese buries the pasta. The camera holds on the plate as the shavings pile higher and higher until the food has disappeared under a huge white cone of grated cheese that rises above the wine glasses. In the last shot he holds up the cheese block and grater beside the mountain of cheese and smiles at the camera.

4812.expl: A young man in a knitted vest holds up a blue shirt, slides a wooden hanger into it and smooths the shoulders and sleeves flat. He holds the finished shirt up straight so the collar and buttons sit square. He then carries it to an open wardrobe where a long rail of shirts hangs sorted by colour, from white through blue to orange and dark green, and slides his shirt into its place in the row, evening up the neighbouring shirts with his hand.

4813.expl: A young man in a wool jumper and rubber boots stands on a stone quay at sunrise with seagulls flying past. Behind him a small wooden boat is tied up on still water, then rows of white sailing yachts moored side by side; he runs his hand along a mooring line stretched from a yacht to the quay. Further along he leans on a rusty iron bollard with a thick rope coiled around it while a container ship is loaded by tall cranes and a tugboat crosses the water behind him.

4814.expl: In a vegetable garden a hand takes a big red tomato off a staked plant hung with green and red fruit. A man drops the tomato into a wicker basket that already holds cucumbers and more tomatoes. In the next shot a man turns the soil with a spade and pale potatoes come up out of the dark earth. A woman in a headscarf kneels behind a full basket and holds a large potato up to the camera in surprise, and finally a couple tip a basket of peppers onto a wheelbarrow already heaped with tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers and potatoes.

4815.expl: A woman in a cream blouse sits at a desk in a busy open-plan office with a monitor, keyboard and paper coffee cup in front of her. She presses her fingertips against both temples and moves them in small circles, screwing up her face. She keeps pressing, moving her hands up over her forehead and into her hair, then lowers her head into her hands and finally lays her head down on her folded arms on the desk while colleagues work behind her.

4816.expl: A young woman in a neon yellow vest stands on an outdoor basketball court breathing hard with her mouth open after playing. She presses her flat hand onto her chest over her heart and looks down, still panting. A man in a green shirt comes up beside her, puts his hand on her shoulder and stares wide-eyed at the camera; the two of them then lean over the smartwatch on her wrist and both react in shock at the number on it while other players carry on with the ball behind them.

4817.expl: A cartoon drawing of a burnt orange landscape under a huge spiralling sun. The ground in the foreground is baked hard and split into deep cracks, and a winding riverbed running through the hills has dried to a thick orange sludge. A shaggy dog lies panting in the last of it with its tongue out, a lone tree droops and melts like wax, and a man in a soaked shirt walks slowly forward wiping his forehead as heat lines rise off the ground around him.

4820.vo: Stress. Tim is coming today. Tim? Really? Then I'll go home and change. This is the strongest friendship.
4820.expl: Two young women meet face to face in a club with purple and pink neon lights behind them. They are wearing exactly the same patterned mini dress, and they stare at each other's dress with their mouths open. The blonde one shouts angrily at the other, then her face breaks into a smile as they talk it over; the dark haired one starts to cry and laugh at once, and the two of them fall into a long hug in their matching dresses.

4821.vo: I bring your pizza. I am your sunshine today.
4821.expl: Filmed from inside a car looking out of the open window across an empty marked car park. The sun sits low on the horizon at the end of the tarmac and floods the whole shot with orange light, throwing a long shadow behind a woman walking towards the car. She is barefoot in a white summer dress and carries a flat pizza box in both hands; she comes up to the window smiling, leans in and hands the pizza box through it while the sun goes down behind her.

4822.expl: A young woman in a white summer playsuit sits on the edge of a bed typing on her phone with both thumbs and grinning at the screen. 4844.expl: In a bright kitchen a young chef in a blue apron runs a long knife through a white onion on a wooden board, leaving a heap of onion rings. Cut to a garden table where an older man in a grey polo presses a knife down through a whole watermelon until the green rind splits in two. Then a bearded man in a checked shirt swings an axe into a big log on a woodpile and it splits open. Finally a woman standing in a huge orange pumpkin in a field raises a long blade over her head and brings it down, and the pumpkin lies open in two seedy halves on the grass.

Finally a young man in a straw hat and green shirt turns a big black camera with a long lens towards the viewer at a red-carpet event.

4851.expl: A red-haired woman in a khaki shirt and bush hat lies over a patch of desert sand and sweeps a wide brush across it, uncovering a small round coin. She brushes again and the sand falls away from a flat grey slab. The slab turns out to be a stone tablet carved with rows of hieroglyphs, and she scrapes along its edge with a pointed trowel, mouth open in amazement. Finally she stands in a sandy excavation pit beside a colossal carved pharaoh's head, with other workers climbing over the stone around it.

4852.expl: A young man in a workshop apron grins as he works an adjustable spanner on a blue circuit board at his bench, tools hanging on the pegboard behind him. Cut to him in goggles with his hair on end, holding the small board up in both hands over a heavy bench vice. Then he stands back with a screwdriver as a small mechanism is clamped in the vice, and next a larger machine with a motor and rails sits on a rolling bench in front of him, his mouth open. Finally he throws both arms up in a garage in front of a huge machine of purple pistons and interlocking metal gears.

4853.expl: Extreme close-up of a woman squinting through a gold eye loupe at a minute brass cog held in a pair of tweezers right in front of her eye. She sits back at a workbench covered with tweezers, tins and springs, in a shop whose walls are hung with wall clocks, and holds the loupe up to her eye. Next she points a fine tool into the open case of a mantel clock, its brass wheels visible behind the glass. Then a tall grandfather clock with brass weights and a swinging pendulum fills the frame, and finally she stands with her arms out under the enormous brass gears of a tower clock.

4864.expl: A young woman works at a laptop in a bright home office and raises one finger asking for quiet as she talks. Behind her a young man slips past the doorway, then another man carries a box through. Then an entire marching band files into the room in matching navy, orange and light blue uniforms, playing trumpets, a trombone, a sousaphone and a bass drum. She throws her hands up and shouts in disbelief while the band plays on around her desk.

Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.

4915.expl: Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.

At the end they stand on bare rock at the top, drop their packs, and throw their arms up over a wide green forest valley.

A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.

4929.expl: Seen from behind, a student in a grey hoodie with a backpack runs along a sunlit path across a university campus. He hurries down the aisle of a full lecture theatre towards the speaker at the lectern. A close-up shows his hand writing lines in blue pen in a spiral notebook, with a yellow highlighter and a laptop beside it. A stack of library books and a steaming paper coffee cup stand on a table between the shelves. In the last shot he stands up at his classroom desk with his fist in the air, a paper marked with a large red A on the desk in front of him, while the other students clap and cheer.

4930.expl: A schoolgirl in a grey jumper and white collar sits at a desk in a classroom writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil, other pupils working behind her and a whiteboard at the front. She puts her hand up, beams, and slaps a high five with a hand reaching in from off camera. A close-up shows her carrying on writing a list of lines down the page. An adult hand then presses a large gold glitter star sticker onto the finished page beside her writing. In the final shot she holds the open notebook up to the camera with both hands, the gold star on the page, laughing with delight.

4931.expl: A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

4932.expl: A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.

Back inside, passengers sit in blue seats behind him while he keeps one hand on the wheel and presses a red button on the console, smiling and speaking towards the door.

From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.

She pushes a throttle lever as the boat moves over the water, then points ahead over the bow.

4941.expl: A young firefighter in full turnout gear slides down the brass pole of a fire station and walks out past the bay doors in helmet and jacket. The clip ends with the firefighter smiling in front of the red fire engine while the man holds the cat.

4942.expl: A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.

He turns back to the camera beaming with his hands on his hips.

The camera passes behind the easel and comes round to reveal a finished painted face - a woman with green eyes and multicoloured hair - while the artist throws both arms in the air beside it.

4948.expl: A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.

4949.expl: Two walkers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a rust-coloured pine forest path, sunlight coming through the trunks behind them. The trees thin out and they pick their way up a bare grey rock slope with a wall of snow-covered peaks opening up across the valley behind them. They pull themselves up the last stones onto a narrow rocky crest under a deep blue sky, and stand at the top looking out over a huge white mountain range, raising their poles above their heads.

4950.expl: In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.

4951.expl: A watercolour illustration seen from a dark hallway looking through an open front door into a warmly lit entrance hall. A young man in a dark coat and scarf has just stepped inside, keys still dangling from his hand, and is leaning down towards a golden dog that has run up to him with its tail swinging. Behind him are coats on hooks, boots lined up under a shelf and a wall of framed family photos under a glowing ceiling lamp.

4952.expl: A hand pushes down a door handle and opens a flat door. A young man with a backpack and a rolling suitcase steps into a narrow hallway; a golden retriever jumps up at him and he crouches to stroke it. An older woman in an apron comes out of the kitchen and they hug for several seconds while the dog sits at their feet. The last shot is a bedroom with a warm lamp and a bookshelf, where he drops backwards onto the bed and lies spread out on the quilt.

4953.expl: A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.

4954.expl: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.

4955.expl: A cartoon of a crowded shared dorm room with metal bunk beds on both sides and a bank of tall grey lockers along the back wall. Washing lines strung across the room are hung with socks, underwear and small towels, and backpacks, hiking boots and rolled sleeping mats lie all over the floor and beds. One boy is climbing down from a top bunk and has thrown an orange rolled-up mat through the air; a small child standing on a lower bunk reaches out to catch it, while a boy on the top bunk opposite laughs so hard that tears fly off his face.

4956.expl: A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.

Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.

4960.expl: An arrivals hall at an airport. A red-haired woman in a mustard jacket wraps both arms tightly around a dark-haired woman and holds her close, eyes shut, beaming over her shoulder. Around them travellers wheel suitcases past under the yellow Arrivals sign. More family members close in until the whole group is holding each other in one long group cuddle, laughing and rocking together.

4961.expl: A living room with a balcony full of houseplants. A grey tabby house cat lies flat on a rug with its belly to the floor, eyes locked on a small grey toy mouse on the wooden floor in front of it. Its owner sits at a low table behind, watching open-mouthed and covering his mouth with excitement. The cat wiggles, springs forward at the toy, then settles on the floor with its paws crossed, looking straight at the camera while the man throws up his hands.

4962.expl: A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.

4963.expl: A bright empty room during a move, with flat-pack furniture parts, screws and cardboard boxes on the floor. A red-haired woman in dungarees sits on the floor gripping one hand in the other, squeezing her hurt finger and screwing up her face. She stands, shakes the hand out, then bangs her bare toe on the leg of the half-built table and hops. Later she carries a white wardrobe with a man, who ends up clutching his own arm while she grabs her foot again.

4964.expl: In a modern kitchen at dusk, a man in a denim shirt with a towel over his shoulder lifts a spoonful of tomato-vegetable soup from a pot on the stove, blows on it and tastes it, then holds the spoon out for the woman beside him, who leans in and tastes it too. 4980.expl: On a hilltop above green fields under a clear blue sky a woman tilts her head back, closes her eyes and breathes in deeply; a man holds a mug of coffee under his nose and breathes in the steam; a woman with curly hair pushes her nose into a bunch of bright flowers; a man leans open-mouthed over a fresh loaf of bread; finally a group of friends stands in a circle with their arms spread wide, heads back, all taking a deep breath together.

4982.expl: On a green football pitch a player in a white kit dribbles the ball, then suddenly pulls up, grimaces and doubles over. He drops onto the grass and grips his leg just above the boot, his face twisted in pain. Two opponents in blue crouch down, take him under the arms and lift him back onto his feet, and he ends up sitting on a wooden bench at the side of the pitch, still holding the same spot above his foot.

At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.

A woman on a stepladder holds a cordless drill against a small bracket high on the wall while a man in a blue polo steadies it from below; he then reaches up to a round detector on the ceiling. The two of them carry a large flat screen over to the wall, lift it onto the bracket and press it firmly into place, then step back and look at it. At the end a whole wall of nine screens is up and switched on.

4987.expl: In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.

4995.expl: A watercolour cartoon of an Italian town square. In the middle a stone fountain sprays three jets of water over a carved group of human figures on its basin. A young man in a striped shirt rides a red scooter across the wet cobblestones past the fountain, a pizza stall behind him. Pigeons take off in the foreground, an Italian flag hangs on a pole on the left, and the Leaning Tower of Pisa and a cathedral dome rise over the tiled roofs.

4997.expl: A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.

4999.expl: A manga-style drawing inside a wooden training hall. A barefoot young man in a dark blue training robe grips a long bamboo sword in both hands and drives forward against an opponent, whose own bamboo sword and gloved hands come in from the left edge of the frame. Speed lines cut across the whole picture, dust bursts from the floorboards under his heel, and a Japanese flag hangs on the wall behind him with a stone garden visible through the open sliding doors.

He then presses a handful of rice into shape in his palm and lays the orange slice over it, torches the finished pieces with a small blowtorch, sets a piece down on a grey plate in front of the camera and grins.

5001.expl: A woman in a striped headscarf rides a train and looks out of the window at a river and dry hills sliding past. She then rides in a crowded minibus with bundles of luggage strapped overhead. Finally she hikes up a stony mountain path with a canvas backpack and a walking stick and stops on the ridge, where the whole valley opens out below her: a blue-painted village spread over the slope and bare brown mountains running to the horizon.

5002.expl: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.

5003.expl: An ink-and-wash drawing of a dense green rainforest. A man in a wide-brimmed hat and a dirt-stained shirt stands in the middle of the frame and swings a machete, cutting through the hanging leaves in front of him so that fronds and scraps fly off. Thick vines loop across the whole picture, huge dripping leaves hang on both sides, mist rises off the tangled roots at his feet, and a macaw flies overhead against a pale sky.

5004.expl: A watercolour of red desert at sunset. A kangaroo is caught in mid-air, both back feet off the ground, driving itself forward in a long bound across the red sand, its heavy tail streaming out behind it for balance. A joey's head pokes out of the pouch on its belly. Dust puffs up where its feet just left the ground, low saltbushes dot the sand and pink clouds fill the sky.

5005.expl: A young woman in a navy polo shirt sits in a coastal watch station with nautical charts pinned to the wall and a brass bell beside the window. She scans the water through binoculars. Through the glass the sea curves inland between two green headlands, sheltered water dotted with moored yachts, small boats and orange buoys, with the open sea beyond. An orange rescue boat powers out across the water leaving a long white wake, and she lowers the binoculars and points at it.

Through the glass the sea curves inland between two green headlands, sheltered water dotted with moored yachts, small boats and orange buoys, with the open sea beyond. An orange rescue boat powers out across the water leaving a long white wake, and she lowers the binoculars and points at it.

5011.expl: On a Paris cafe terrace two women in coats hug at a table set with coffee cups. Then an elderly grey-haired couple sits on a green bench by the street; the man cups the woman's cheek and they kiss for a long moment. Finally a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man dipping the woman backwards while guests at the cafe tables clap.

5013.expl: Three kitchens are compared with a price caption over each one. First a frail old man stirs a pot on a single gas burner in a shabby room with peeling walls, captioned 500 euro. Last a man stands at the marble island of a glass-walled penthouse kitchen with the city skyline behind him, captioned 100,000 euro.

They look up at the working light, then fold the ladder away.

5021.expl: An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.

5022.expl: Three lit interiors in a row. First a dark study at night where a bent desk lamp throws a warm pool of light over stacked books, folders and a laptop while someone works at the desk. Then a colourful living room where a woman reaches to a tall floor lamp with a wide drum shade and it comes on, filling the room with warm light. Last a grand marble hall where a woman in a long silver gown stands under an enormous crystal chandelier that blazes above her and casts sparkling reflections on the polished floor.

5023.expl: A young man with bleached hair in a blue rain jacket stands at a wire fence beside an airfield under a clear sky, filming himself with a gull perched on a fence post in front of him. A small white propeller plane comes down and touches its wheels on the runway behind him. Then a huge four-engine airliner drops in very low right over his head, wheels out, and lands on the runway; he turns to watch it, throws both fists in the air and shouts in delight.

At the end the whole cafe raises coffee cups around her and her tower of books.

Below and behind him a roped line of smaller climbers works its way up the slope. Carved swirls of cloud and a low sun fill the sky.

5032.expl: On an alpine trail below snowy peaks a woman in a red jacket holds an open map, raises her arm and points along the path, and a line of hikers with poles and backpacks walks behind her. Then a women's rowing four cuts across a turquoise lake, the woman in the bow setting the stroke and finally punching a fist into the air.

5041.expl: An anime-style illustration of a night storm over a city. Thick black clouds fill the top of the frame, and a huge white-violet bolt of lightning splits the sky and slams down onto a wet concrete rooftop, bursting into a blinding white flash with sparks and debris flying out sideways. Smaller branching bolts spread across the clouds, rain falls in streaks, and the skyscrapers behind the roof are lit violet by the strike.

5042.vo: Ooh, my legs. Leg day. Ow, ow.
5042.expl: Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.

Below and behind him dry grass, flat-topped acacia trees and purple hills stretch to the horizon, where a big orange sun is rising.

5047.expl: An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. 5048.expl: An elderly woman in a colourful headscarf works at a pair of tall black wooden doors studded with iron and hung with two heavy ring handles. A thick chain is threaded through the rings and closed with a big iron padlock, and she turns a key in it with both hands, a huge bunch of keys hanging at her belt. In between there is a shot of her standing on a wall above the old town holding a whole watermelon over a wooden crate, with a church tower and tiled roofs behind her. She goes back to the doors and works the padlock again, and the doors stay firmly shut the whole time.

5049.expl: A montage of things being shut and locked up. Hands hook a brass padlock through the metal hasp of a wooden garden gate and snap it closed. A man in a cream jacket crouches by a bike rack in a town square and threads a lock through his bicycle frame, then spins the dial of a combination padlock on a rainbow cable wrapped around the rack. In the last shots he turns a key in the lock of a wooden front door under a porch light at dusk, pulls the door closed behind him and walks away.

5050.expl: An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries. A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.

5051.expl: A young woman in a hostel dorm with metal bunk beds tips a khaki backpack out onto the floor and rakes through the growing heap of clothes. She stands over the mess with her hands on her hips, mouth open in dismay, then kneels and searches under the bunk, shakes the empty backpack, and finally sits down on the bed holding her head, because whatever she is looking for is not there.

5052.expl: An inked, muted illustration of a railway station hall. A porter's trolley is stacked far too high with battered leather suitcases, canvas bundles and tied sacks, and the whole tower is sliding off. Cases tumble through the air, one lands open on the tiled floor with a wheel spinning away, and a man in a dark jacket throws both hands up as the baggage rains down on him. Blurred travellers and a second trolley stand in the background under the arched glass roof.

5053.expl: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a hijab loops a clear plastic ID tag onto the pulled-up handle of a black hard-shell suitcase, threads the strap and clicks it shut, then shows the card with her photo and name inside. The scene cuts to an airport baggage hall, where she waits by the carousel with her phone; a black case with a bright pink fluffy tag comes round and she pulls it off the belt.

5054.expl: Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

5057.expl: A soft watercolour of a girl on a village path at sunset. She reaches up and pulls open the flap of a big wooden mailbox on a tall post, and a fan of letters bursts out of it; more envelopes drift through the pink sky and one large envelope floats past the bottom of the frame. Hedges, a tiled cottage roof and a half-timbered house sit behind her.

5058.expl: A teenage boy in a navy hoodie walks up to a black roadside mailbox, pulls the flap down and finds it empty, pulls a face and walks off. A postman in a blue postal uniform and cap, with a mail bag over his shoulder, comes along the street and pushes a bundle of letters into the same box. The boy comes running back delighted, opens it again and hauls out a thick stack of envelopes and a brown parcel.

5059.expl: A young man in a navy hoodie stands at a black roadside mailbox with its red flag up and pulls the front hatch open; the box is empty. A postal worker in a blue jacket and cap arrives and pushes a thick block of white envelopes and a brown parcel into the box, filling it completely. The man reaches back in, drags out the enormous stack of letters and holds it against his chest, mouth open in delight.

5060.expl: A short montage of people of one sex at every age, all in a sunny park. A baby boy sits in a pushchair reaching for a coloured stacking toy held out to him; a boy rides a green kick scooter along a paved path past a colonnaded museum; a young man in a black vest does pull-ups on an outdoor bar; the same man flexes both arms and smiles at the camera; finally a father in a blue polo carries his little son on his shoulders while a grey-haired grandfather on a bench waves at the camera, all three waving.

5061.expl: A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.

5062.expl: A woman in a burgundy trouser suit strides through a busy open-plan office carrying a tablet, pointing and giving instructions to people at their desks. She stops beside a seated colleague and shows him something on the tablet screen. Next she stands at a whiteboard in front of four colleagues and draws a rising line graph with a blue marker, explaining it and pointing at the peak. Finally she stands among the desks, hands on the tablet, talking to the room while everyone works at their screens.

5063.expl: A military band in black ceremonial uniforms with red-striped trousers and peaked caps moves down a city street in formation, legs swinging up high in unison and white-gloved arms swinging, brass instruments raised. An officer with a sword strides at the front. Behind steel barriers a dense crowd films and waves Indian flags. The shot then cuts to a wide view down a flag-lined avenue where a huge column of uniformed ranks stretches into the distance, watched by a grandfather holding a child in the foreground.

5064.expl: Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.

5065.expl: A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.

He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.

5075.expl: A man stands in a sunny Italian square holding a tall pink and white soft-serve ice cream. In the heat it melts faster than he can eat it: pink streams run down the cone, over his fingers and along his forearms, coating his hands. He licks at it desperately, then the whole scoop slides off the cone and splatters on the cobblestones, leaving him with sticky hands and an empty cone.

5077.expl: A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.

5079.expl: A young woman with a straw tote bag walks away from the camera down a cobbled Mexican street strung overhead with rows of coloured paper banners. She then stands at a fruit market stall hung with bananas and stacked with oranges and limes and takes a large bite of a taco, pulling a delighted face. She climbs a wide flight of worn stone steps on an ancient ruin, and at the top she turns to the camera and throws both arms wide, with a huge stone pyramid rising out of green jungle behind her.

In the last shot she stands in a room lined with mirrors on the walls and floor, so the yellow dress is repeated in every direction.

A dark-haired woman in a fitted purple dress then walks through a dining room under a chandelier, stops at a tall gold-framed mirror and turns side-on to check how the purple dress fits, and finally looks over her shoulder at the back of it and laughs.

5083.expl: Two young women bake together at a floury kitchen counter. The blonde one in denim dungarees whisks yellow egg in a small white bowl while the other, in a green hoodie, steadies a big cream mixing bowl of pale batter. They tip a heap of small red berries into the batter, then each take a wooden spoon and stir hard together. The mixture thickens and turns brown, and both of them laugh and pull faces at how heavy it has become.

5085.expl: A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.

5087.expl: A white tiled kitchen floor is covered with a long line of muddy brown animal paw prints leading from the door across the room. An older man in a flat cap and braces dips a string mop into a grey bucket of water, wrings it out, and then pushes a flat mop over the prints. The tiles he has passed over come up white and clean again, until he stands at the far end of a spotless floor that reflects the window.

5088.expl: A soft watercolour of a wooden farmhouse at sunrise. A boy in a long pale nightshirt leans out of an open window with both arms stretched high above his head, mouth open in a yawn, just out of bed. Outside, the sun is coming up over misty hills and sends long rays across a meadow full of grass and small flowers. A cockerel stands on a fence post with its beak open and a few birds fly in the distance.

5089.expl: A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.

5090.expl: A claymation-style scene set in a small baby's room. A woman in a blue jumper kneels on a patterned rug and holds a baby in yellow striped pyjamas up in the air; both are laughing. Behind her stands a wooden cot with white bedding, and around the room there are wooden building blocks on the floor, a knitted purple elephant toy, a chest of drawers, a shelf with potted plants and a curtained window letting in warm light.

5091.expl: A young man in a black leather jacket and jeans rides a small green two-wheeler through a sunny town, sitting up at the handlebars with the round headlight in front of him. He then stands astride a big black machine at a lookout above the sea. In the last part the camera rides with a whole group of riders in helmets and leather jackets as they roll down a coastal road above blue water.

5092.expl: A young woman in a grey t-shirt and black work gloves carries a large cardboard box down a driveway towards an open removal truck on a sunny suburban street. She walks back up the ramp, and two other people join her: one man inside the truck and one on the ground help her push a brown leather sofa in beside the stacked boxes. She then lifts another box up into the truck and finally turns to the camera, grinning and out of breath.

5093.expl: A man in a jumper and jeans pushes a red petrol lawn mower straight towards the camera through a back garden where the grass has grown long, pale and gone to seed. Each pass cuts a clean green strip out of the shaggy grass, and the shots alternate between behind the mower and in front of it. By the end a wide band of short green lawn runs down the middle of the garden with the tall unmown grass still standing on either side.

5094.expl: In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.

5095.expl: Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.

5096.expl: A pencil sketch of a woodland floor seen close up. A large mushroom with a thick stalk and a smooth domed cap grows straight out of the ground, its gills drawn in fine lines underneath. A hand comes in from the right and a finger touches the base of the stalk at ground level. Fallen leaves, twigs and smaller mushrooms cover the earth all around, with bare trees sketched softly in the background.

5097.expl: A young red-haired street performer in a denim jacket covered in enamel badges plays an acoustic guitar on a cobbled street at golden hour. An open guitar case lies on the stones in front of him. A small crowd of passers-by has stopped in a loose semicircle to listen, including a woman holding a toddler. He strums hard, throws his strumming hand up over his head, then leans back into the guitar and sings while the onlookers smile and clap.

5098.expl: A packed floodlit football stadium at night. A young man in the foreground has his face painted half light blue and half white, the colours of his country, and wears the same light-blue-and-white striped shirt and a matching scarf. He hammers a big drum strapped to his chest while the whole stand around him sings and jumps in the same colours. Scarves are held up overhead, and then a huge light-blue-and-white flag is passed over the crowd until it covers the whole frame; he looks up at it, still shouting.

5099.expl: In a flat with a huge political world map on the wall, housemates take turns stepping up to it. Each one holds a small square instant print showing their own face and a little paper flag, and presses both onto the map over the country they come from. A man in a green football shirt sticks his onto northern Europe, a woman with a camera round her neck presses hers onto Africa, a long-haired man adds one near Japan, a blonde woman adds one over South America. The map fills up with flags and small portraits, and at the end the whole group crowds behind the framed map, holds it up and takes a selfie with it.

5100.expl: A big coloured world map hangs on a wall framed by fairy lights. Four flatmates come to it one after another. A man in a green football shirt presses a small green flag and a square instant print of his face onto the map. A woman in a red jumper with a camera round her neck points at a spot, then pushes her own print and a red flag onto it. A man in a yellow t-shirt reaches up and pushes a yellow flag and a print onto Asia. The camera pans across the map showing four portraits, each held on by a coloured flag, and ends with the four of them squeezed together in front of the map, mouths open, cheering at the camera.

5101.expl: A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.

5102.expl: A woman with a large hiking backpack walks through an old North African medina, following a map on her phone. She turns down a very narrow lane between tall ochre and blue walls, close enough to touch both sides, checking the screen and pointing at it. She keeps walking, squeezes past a man standing in the lane, then passes through a covered market passage hung with clothes and lined with stalls, and out through a low brick archway. At the end she comes out into a huge open square in front of a mosque with a tall minaret, looks at her phone again and smiles.

5103.expl: A woman in a lilac blouse sits at an office desk in front of a computer monitor, tips her head to one side and rubs the back of her neck with her hand, wincing. She rolls her head and talks to the camera. The shot cuts to a close-up of her chest and shoulders as she loops a thick mustard scarf around her neck and knots it. Then the scene cuts outdoors: she stands at a green fence at a wildlife park in the same blouse and scarf, and a giraffe lowers its very long neck down over her head from above. She turns to the camera with her mouth wide open in astonishment, hand at her chin.

5104.expl: A hand-drawn cartoon of two neighbours talking over the low wooden fence between their gardens. On the left a man in a straw hat and patched overalls leans on the fence and holds up a teacup, a speech bubble full of squiggles above him. On the right a woman in a floral dress and apron listens with a hand at her cheek, laughing, while her watering can pours onto a flower bed. A black cat sits on a fence post between them, laundry hangs on a line and a smiling sun is in the sky.

On the left a man in a straw hat and patched overalls leans on the fence and holds up a teacup, a speech bubble full of squiggles above him. On the right a woman in a floral dress and apron listens with a hand at her cheek, laughing, while her watering can pours onto a flower bed. A black cat sits on a fence post between them, laundry hangs on a line and a smiling sun is in the sky.

5105.expl: A painted illustration of flat Dutch countryside. A straight water-filled ditch runs from the foreground into the distance between raised grass banks. Three big windmills with red and white sails stand along the left and centre, a church tower far behind them. Ducks swim on the water and glide down to land on it. On the bank at the right a boy in a cap and red scarf cycles along a dirt path beside a strip of red and yellow tulips, and tall clouds fill the deep blue sky.

5106.expl: A young woman with pink hair in a yellow raincoat cycles along an Amsterdam canal, laughing, with narrow gabled houses and moored boats behind her. She then walks away from the camera through a tulip field with her arms spread wide, a big windmill turning directly in front of her as the shot pushes in on the red and yellow rows. Finally she stands at a market stall holding a fresh stroopwafel, pulling it apart and biting into it while the waffle irons steam behind her.

5107.expl: A mother and father stand cheek to cheek in a bright room, cradling their swaddled newborn in their arms and smiling down at it. The shot changes to the two of them leaning over a clear hospital bassinet with their reflections in the plastic and the newborn asleep inside. The camera then pulls back across a hospital nursery filled with rows and rows of identical bassinets, each holding a sleeping newborn, the rows stretching away down the ward.

5108.expl: A young woman with long beaded braids in a yellow sunflower dress laughs in a covered fabric market, holding up a green and gold wax-print cloth between stacks of folded fabric, then wrapping it around herself. Next she sits in a narrow painted canoe that glides past a village of wooden houses built on stilts over the water, waving up at children sitting in a doorway above her. At the end she stands in the middle of a ring of men playing hand drums on a sandy village street at sunset, dancing as they drum.

5109.expl: On a rooftop terrace at sunset a young woman in a denim jacket carries a tray of a dozen frosted cupcakes, cream swirls topped with chocolate, past strings of bulb lights. She sets the tray on a wooden table beside a small card that reads Welcome, walks to the glass door and knocks, then comes back, sits down alone at the table with the city skyline glowing behind her and reaches for the tray.

5110.expl: A watercolour painting of an empty wooden park bench standing on a path in a misty park. Bare grey trees fade into the fog behind it, fallen brown and orange leaves cover the ground, long shadows stretch across the path, and a single dried leaf lies alone on the seat of the bench. There is not a single person anywhere in the scene.

5111.expl: A soft cartoon hospital room. A smiling woman in pink scrubs and a white cap, a thermometer tucked behind her ear and a clipboard under one arm, leans over a hospital bed in white gloves and adjusts the pillow of a small child who lies under a yellow blanket with a spotted rash on the arms and face. A drip bag hangs on a stand beside the bed, and a vase with a daisy and a glass of water stand on the bedside table.

5112.expl: A bold ink illustration over a wave-patterned background. Two hands in blue sleeves have just thrown food into the air above a wooden bowl that tips on a plank table: spinach leaves, halved tomatoes, walnuts and almonds, blueberries and red berries, slices of salmon, halved boiled eggs and a falling shower of small golden grains of rice or oats. A few loose grains have already landed in the empty bowl.

5113.expl: In a bright consulting room a woman in a teal polo shirt and glasses sets bowls of food down on a wooden table in front of a young man in a yellow t-shirt: a bowl of spinach, tomatoes and a yellow pepper, a bowl of brown rice, a grilled fish on a plate, a bowl of mixed nuts and a tall glass of milk. A food pyramid poster hangs on the wall behind them. She points at the food and talks him through it; he leans in, looks at each dish and nods, and she puts a hand on his shoulder as they finish.

5114.expl: Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.

5115.expl: In a meadow full of wild flowers a young woman in an olive rain jacket and a cap, her red hair in plaits, crouches down to a fallen wooden log lying in the grass. She holds a magnifying glass over a small green insect sitting on the bark and moves in close, her eye almost against the lens, studying it from a few centimetres away. Then she turns to an open notebook lying in the grass, full of pencil drawings of insects, and adds a new sketch with her pencil.

5116.expl: A hand pushes a small frosted kitchen window outwards above a steel sink, letting daylight and a potted plant on the outside sill into the dim room. Cut to a young man in a pale linen shirt striding through a bright Paris apartment towards the windows. He grabs the long white curtains and throws them apart, then swings the tall casement windows open over the rooftops. Finally he pushes both leaves of the balcony doors wide open with his arms spread and walks out onto the wrought-iron balcony into full sun.

5117.vo: Oh! Oh! Aha! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Whoa!
5117.expl: A young man in round glasses, a denim jacket and a backpack stands in a narrow aisle of a packed bookshop, tall shelves of books on both sides of him and knee-high stacks of new titles on the floor. He holds a thick hardback open in both hands and lets the pages riffle past his face, mouth open in amazement. He turns a pink-jacketed book over, flips through a second heavy volume, then hugs an enormous oversized book to his chest. At the end he holds a huge book open above his head and looks up as the pages fan out over him.

5118.expl: Low morning sun pours through an open kitchen window over a dark worktop and a sink, with two potted herbs on the sill and rooftops beyond. A young man in a loose white shirt turns and walks down a bright hallway with a strip of sunlight across the parquet floor. He reaches the tall French windows, pushes them open and stands in the doorway as the sun floods over him. He steps out onto the small balcony, arms spread, and looks over the sunlit Paris rooftops with the sun low in a clear blue sky.

5119.expl: A large crowd in summer clothes is packed in front of two huge studded wooden gates set in a grey stone archway, with pink and white bunting strung above them. Two members of staff push the gates apart from the inside and a bright strip of the park appears between them. As the gates swing fully open a painted carousel comes into view beyond the archway. The crowd streams forward through the entrance and out into the fairground, a young woman in a red dress laughing and running ahead of them towards the carousel.

5120.expl: A team in blue scrubs, caps, masks and white gloves stands around a draped patient on an operating table under a large round surgical lamp. One of them leans over the opening in the drapes and works with instruments while the others hold retractors. A woman looks up at the camera as a scalpel is passed hand to hand over a metal tray; a heart monitor beside the table shows the pulse trace and the numbers 190, 20 and 99. The team keeps working around the table, then all of them look up at the camera and give a thumbs up.

5121.expl: A woman in a white t-shirt bends down in a white kitchen and opens the oven door on a tray of golden muffins under the oven light. She reaches in and lifts the baking tray out, smiling at it. Cut to a man in a dark jumper in a wooden kitchen who opens the oven on a whole roast turkey and slides the roasting tin out towards himself. Finally a baker in a white coat and apron in a bakery draws a long wooden peel out of a deck oven and turns to the camera holding a board of six big fresh loaves.

5122.expl: A short montage of young people finishing hard things. A woman in leggings hangs high on an indoor climbing wall and reaches for the last hold at the top. A young man in a gym drives a loaded barbell up out of a deep front squat, straining. A runner in black crosses a finish line on a red track with both arms thrown up and her mouth open in a shout while spectators watch. A young man in a sports hall presses the last piece into a big floor puzzle and beams straight at the camera. A woman finishes a set of floor exercises on a turf pitch, and finally a group of athletes crowd into a selfie with their fists raised, all shouting in celebration.

A woman finishes a set of floor exercises on a turf pitch, and finally a group of athletes crowd into a selfie with their fists raised, all shouting in celebration.
