5377.expl: A hand-drawn kitchen scene: a dark-haired girl in a flowered apron leans right across a long wooden farmhouse table and stretches her arm out over the boards. In front of her the dirty plates from the meal have been gathered into one leaning stack with forks and knives laid on top; a linen cloth is still in the air above the pile and dust puffs off the wood. Behind her are painted wooden chairs, a dresser full of crockery, a jug and a bowl of apples on a sunlit windowsill.

5378.expl: Three short scenes around tables. A young man in a grey T-shirt puts a mug down on a small folding table in a hallway, then rocks the table to show how it wobbles. In a bright kitchen a woman puts glasses and colourful plates down one by one around a wooden table, laying a place in front of every chair. Finally a man in a blue suit stands at the head of an enormous banquet table in a marble hall and opens his arms over it, where candles, flowers, glasses and plates have all been put in their places down its whole length.

5379.expl: In a small tailor's shop lined with stacks of coloured cloth, an older tailor with a tape measure round his neck measures a young man who is wearing a new navy jacket. He then folds a piece of dark fabric on his table and marks a line on it with chalk, runs the piece through a sewing machine, and brings the changed jacket back to the young man, easing it onto his shoulders and talking him through what he has made different about it.

5380.expl: A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

5381.expl: Four short scenes of people speaking with each other. A man in a hoodie walks along a busy New York street with a phone at his ear, answering and gesturing with his free hand. Two women in a cafe lean towards each other over their cappuccinos, one telling something and the other reacting with wide eyes. An elderly woman and a middle-aged man stand on either side of a white picket fence in a sunny front garden and lean in to talk across it. Finally a family around a lit dinner table talk over each other, pointing and laughing.

5382.vo: No way! No way! No way! Is that so?
5382.expl: At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.

5383.expl: A young woman in a leopard-print coat stands at the edge of a very wide city street, one arm raised to hail a cab. The camera looks straight down the avenue: several lanes wide, lined with tall buildings on both sides and packed with yellow taxis stretching to the horizon. She pulls a wheeled suitcase, turns to the camera grinning, then holds her arm out over the crosswalk again as taxis roll past her.

5385.expl: A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.

5386.expl: A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.

5388.expl: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. 5389.expl: In a bright living room a young man holds an orange snack packet up over his head while a young woman in a red football kit jumps for it. Every time she lunges he twists sharply away, ducking low and darting sideways across the rug so her hands miss him. He crouches, spins past her and keeps the packet out of her reach, until she finally corners him, takes it, and they both sit down on the sofa with it, laughing.

5390.expl: Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.

5391.expl: Evening at a park with the sun low behind the trees. A boy in a black hoodie rolls across the flat concrete of a skatepark on his skateboard while four friends watch from the ramp behind him. On the basketball court another boy throws the ball up towards the hoop against the setting sun and catches it again. Then five teenagers sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench in front of the hoop, leaning in over one boy's phone with their eyes fixed on the screen and their mouths open, before they all break into laughter.

5392.expl: A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.

5393.expl: A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.

5394.expl: A two-colour woodcut print. A person in a heavy padded coat, knitted hat and thick gloves leans their whole weight onto a tall flagpole and drives it down into the frozen ground. A ragged ochre flag snaps out sideways in the wind at the top of the pole. Splinters of ice burst up where the pole strikes and cracks run out across the white surface. Behind them lie empty snow dunes and, far off, a second small flag already standing in the snow.

5395.expl: A wide dry plain under a pale sky. A young ranch hand in a canvas jacket, denim shirt and leather chaps rides a bay horse at a trot along a barbed-wire fence, one gloved hand brushing the top of a fence post as he passes. The fence runs dead straight away to the horizon, dust drifts up behind the horse, and a windmill and flat-topped mesas stand far off in the haze.

5396.expl: Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.

5398.expl: A woodcut-style print of the Earth as a globe, its continents and swirling blue oceans carved in fine lines, with tall sailing ships crossing the water. A ring of people of many ages and skin tones stands right around the rim of the globe, each holding the hands of the two beside them so the ring is unbroken all the way round. Behind them the dark sky is full of stars, crescent moons and a few birds.

Two actors in tunics, boots and capes perform on a wooden stage: one stands with his arm flung out and his cloak flying, the other strides towards him. Heavy red curtains are drawn back on either side, a painted forest backdrop hangs behind them, footlights glow along the front edge of the stage, and rows of seated people and gilded balcony boxes fill the auditorium.

5400.expl: A woman in a green velvet dress sits in the audience of a plain little hall, clapping as two men in waistcoats bow on a low wooden platform; she turns to the camera, delighted. Then she is alone in a large empty auditorium of red seats, looking up at the stage. Finally she leans on the red-and-gold rail of a box in a grand horseshoe-shaped opera house, a chandelier above her, tiers of gilded balconies around her and the orchestra playing in the pit below the closed red curtain.

At a station concourse she reads a large departure board full of times and writes in a small spiral notepad. Back on the platform she compares the posted timetable with her watch again while a red train pulls in behind her.

5404.expl: A young man in a bright kitchen leans over a stainless-steel toaster and pushes the lever down. Two slices of toast pop up and he gasps with delight, then lifts them onto a white plate. He keeps going: slice after slice comes out of the toaster and he adds each one to the plate until the toast has grown into a tower far taller than the toaster itself. He grins over the top of the stack, buttering the topmost slice and reaching for still more.

5406.expl: A close shot of hot beach sand shows a pair of bare feet with the toes spread wide, and a white shell lying in the sand right in front of them. A young woman in a tie-dye T-shirt, denim shorts and a visor steps forward, treads straight onto the shell and jerks her foot up with a pained laugh. She hops on one leg, grabs the sore foot and shakes it out, then bounds away across the sand and jumps onto a striped beach towel.

5407.expl: At a house party lit by coloured lights, a young woman in a sequin jacket stands in the narrow hallway knocking on a closed white door with her phone in her other hand. Nothing happens, so she waits and checks the phone. Behind her a queue builds up as several other guests line up along the hallway. Finally the door swings open onto a small bathroom with a white toilet bowl and a towel beside it, and the next guest squeezes past her to get in.

5408.expl: A woman in a denim shirt and a patterned headband stands in an open garage with a wooden kitchen chair in front of her; she presses on the seat and it wobbles. She turns to a red hard case on the bench and opens it: inside, held in moulded slots, are rows of screwdrivers, spanners, pliers and sockets. She lifts one screwdriver out of the case, tightens the loose joint under the chair, stands the chair back up and sits down on it to show it holds.

5409.expl: A young woman with freckles smiles into the camera and pulls her lower lip down with one finger to show her front teeth close up. The film cuts to a dental surgery where she sits in the chair in a mint jumper while a dentist holds a small round mirror up to her open mouth. Then she is outside under a tree, biting into a big red apple, and finally she holds up the bitten apple and grins straight at the camera.

A young man in blue pyjamas then stands at the bathroom mirror scrubbing his front teeth with it and working it around his mouth. He bends over the basin, rinses with water from his cupped hand and spits, then straightens up, smiles at his reflection and stands the brush in a white cup beside the tap.

5412.expl: Phone footage of a guided tour through an ancient Greek hilltop site. The camera moves up a stone ramp between rows of huge fluted marble pillars that carry the roof of a ruined gateway, following a guide who holds a red umbrella up above the group. The tour walks out into an open ruined courtyard where tourists stop and photograph the walls, then the clip cuts to a viewpoint at sunset where a large crowd on a paved terrace looks across the city at the temple standing on its rock.

5413.expl: A dark ink-and-wash comic panel of a city gridlock at dusk. Cars, vans and a box lorry stand nose to tail across every lane under an elevated flyover, tail lights glowing red and exhaust smoke drifting between them, with the jam stretching away to the horizon. In the foreground a driver has climbed halfway out of his car window and raised an open hand at the unmoving queue, a man in a cap leans out of the van beside him, and a motorcyclist edges along the narrow gap between the lanes. Blank billboards and tower blocks fill the smoky skyline behind, and nothing in the picture has any way out.

5414.expl: Phone footage from inside a car stuck in morning traffic. A schoolboy in a white shirt and dark tie sits by the open window with cars packed around him and leans out to look along the jammed lanes as scooters squeeze past. He then walks up the steps of a pedestrian footbridge and takes hold of its metal railing with both hands, standing at the horizontal bar between its upright supports and looking down at hundreds of cars filling every lane of the hazy motorway below.

5415.expl: A delivery rider on a scooter waits at a city junction, filmed head-on. The traffic light on the pole behind him shows green, then switches to red - the round red lamp and the red pedestrian figure lit up right above his helmet - and he stays sitting still on the bike. When it goes green again he looks up and rides on. The clip ends on a wide view down a six-lane avenue where rows of motorbikes and cars wait under a line of traffic lights.

5416.expl: A woman with a wheeled suitcase stands on a station platform on a bright day. A train comes in on the far track, then a bright orange electric locomotive rolls slowly past her at the head of its carriages, close enough to fill the frame, and she turns and beams at it. A blue regional train passes on the next track, and the clip cuts to a glass-roofed station hall where the long white nose of a high-speed train slides in beside the platform.

5417.expl: A young woman in a mustard coat with a canvas tote bag steps up to an old red wooden tram standing in a cobbled old-town street and boards it, her mouth open in delight. Inside the carriage she leans towards the window and watches pastel-coloured townhouses slide past. The tram then runs into a large tram yard: several trams stand on parallel rails under a web of overhead wires, and she stands on the narrow platform between the tracks looking around at them.

5418.expl: A woman in a mustard coat climbs the wooden steps up into an old red tram from the street. The camera follows her inside, where the whole carriage is visible from within: varnished wooden benches, a wooden floor, brass handrails and windows on both sides. She leans out through the open side of the carriage and grins as the cobbled street and old houses pass. At the end she steps out of the tram onto a station platform where a long modern white tram is waiting.

5419.expl: A man with a backpack jumps out of an underground metro train and runs across the station floor towards the stairs. Outside he sprints along the pavement towards a red and white tram waiting at a stop, then keeps running down a city street to catch a bus at the kerb. Finally he runs up a metal gangway onto a passenger ferry at a harbour quay, with cranes across the water behind him.

5422.expl: A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.

5423.expl: One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.

5427.vo: I'm shaking. So nervous. I can't.
5427.expl: In a dark theatre lit by warm lamps, a laughing young woman holds a cream envelope up to the camera; the flap is closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a stamp. A young man in a green hoodie then shakes his hands in front of his chest and pulls a wide-eyed, nervous face. The shot cuts to a group of young people on a lit stage who jump, scream, hug each other and celebrate.

5428.expl: A logistics yard under a clear blue sky. A bearded worker in a hi-vis jacket and work gloves stands beside a pickup stacked with shrink-wrapped pallets of cardboard boxes and pats the load. He turns and waves a large chrome-fronted American semi-truck forward; it rolls in towing a rusty steel shipping container, the driver waving from the high cab. The worker guides it past him along the gravel and grins as the container rolls by.

5429.expl: In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.

5430.expl: A selfie-stick POV of a young woman riding a road bike at speed on a mountain road. She rushes out of a dark tunnel into green forest, keeps pedalling along the open road, races through a white-tiled underpass, then through a lit road tunnel where a car passes her, and finally approaches another arched tunnel mouth. The road, walls and trees stream past her the whole time while she grins into the camera.

5431.expl: A travel montage. A red-haired woman films herself from the wicker basket of a hot air balloon at dawn over Cappadocia, with dozens of striped balloons drifting at different heights above the rock valley and its stone spires. The clip then cuts to a covered bazaar lined with blue patterned ceramics and hanging glass lamps, where her finger points at the shelves, and finally to her on a ferry deck at dusk sipping a tulip glass of Turkish tea while gulls fly past over the water.

5432.expl: An evening street stall hung with rows of brass bells. A young ice cream seller in a red fez and an embroidered red waistcoat works the stretchy ice cream with a long metal paddle, lifting a heavy rope of it into the air. He holds a cone out to a customer, and each time the customer reaches for it he flips the paddle and takes the cone away again, ringing the bells and laughing while the customer keeps grabbing at nothing. In the end he hands the cone over.

5433.expl: A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.

5434.expl: Inside a flat at dusk, a woman in an oversized mustard hoodie switches on one appliance after another. She flicks the steel kettle on its base, then the white desk fan on the kitchen counter, which starts spinning. She crouches on the floor and taps the button on a round robot vacuum until its blue light comes on and it starts moving. She picks up a white power strip from the sofa and pushes a plug into it, and the sockets light up. Coloured fairy lights come on along the walls and she throws her arms wide, laughing in the lit room.

5435.expl: Phone footage of two young red-haired women walking side by side across a sunny university campus. They are dressed exactly the same: white polo crop tops, blue jeans, white trainers and black backpacks, and they wear their hair in the same ponytails, so from behind and from the front they look like one person doubled. They stop, open a bag of crisps together and share it, then walk on laughing at each other while other students pass on the lawn behind them.

5436.expl: A run of short kitchen clips, each one showing hands turning something round on itself. A woman grips a soaked blue cloth with both fists and twists it in opposite directions over the sink until the water runs out of it; a pair of hands twists the metal lid off a jar of pickles; hands twist a rope of pale dough over on itself on a floured worktop; a young woman twists a long braid of dough while a friend watches; finally six teenagers line up along the counter, take hold of one enormous rope of dough and twist it together until flour bursts into the air.

5437.expl: A travel reel in three parts. First a young woman in a white embroidered shirt leads the camera by the hand through a field of sunflowers at sunset. Then she walks across a cobbled cathedral square as a flock of pigeons takes off around her in front of a white church with golden domes. Finally the clip ends in the paved courtyard of an old manor: the walls and arcades of the building close the space in on every side, strings of warm lights hang overhead, and a long table of guests in embroidered shirts claps and cheers as she lifts a big braided loaf of bread above her head.

5438.expl: A woman in a red embroidered apron makes dumplings on a big wooden table in a log kitchen. A white bowl of dark red fruit filling stands at her elbow next to a lump of dough and a row of flat dough circles; she takes each circle, closes it around a spoonful of the filling and presses the edge shut, laying the finished half-moons out in rows across the table. She carries a full board of them to a wide black pan of boiling water over an open fire while a small boy in an embroidered shirt watches, tastes one from a spoon over the steaming pan, and finally sets a wooden bowl of cooked dumplings on the table beside the bowl of red filling.

5439.expl: A rainy street in a Japanese city, everything in the shot somewhere between white and black. The sky is a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the wet road and the concrete buildings are grey, and the only colour is the rainbow-striped umbrella a young man in a beige coat shakes open over his head. He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.

He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.

5440.expl: A blue ballpoint-pen drawing on cream paper. A grown bearded man in a denim jacket runs across a meadow with a kite reel in his raised hand, his cap blowing off behind him, and a small laughing boy in dungarees runs along beside him holding the string of a second kite. Two patterned diamond kites with long curling ribbon tails climb into a sky of drawn swirls above a low sun; dandelions and daisies fill the grass in the foreground.

5441.expl: A family barbecue in a green backyard. A big bearded man in sunglasses and a bright Hawaiian shirt runs a small boy around the lawn in a wheelbarrow while the boy throws his arms up and shouts. At the grill another man in a blue T-shirt turns the meat; two little girls stand in front of the smoke holding handfuls of marshmallows and grin at the camera. The bearded man then sits down at the picnic table and arm-wrestles one of the girls, letting her push his hand down while she laughs, and the clip ends wide on the whole family carrying children on their shoulders around the smoking grill and the loaded picnic table.

5442.expl: A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.

5443.expl: A city street at low golden-hour sun, filled end to end with people. In the foreground two hands clasp each other tightly, and behind them the crowd stretches away in two long facing rows, every person reaching across to grip the hand of the person opposite, forming an unbroken human chain down the middle of the road. The faces are serious and calm and all turned the same way. Behind the chain, plain coloured banners in red, blue and green are held up above the heads of the crowd, with city buildings and bare trees on both sides.

5444.expl: In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.

5445.expl: A comic-style drawing of a city street in heavy rain. A man in a beige trench coat runs across the flooded road, splashing through a deep puddle. In his right hand he holds up a black umbrella that the wind has blown completely inside out, its ribs bent backwards into a bowl so that the rain falls straight past it onto him; his coat and scarf are flying and his hair is soaked. Behind him a big clock tower rises into the grey sky, a red double-decker bus and a black taxi drive through the standing water, a red phone box stands on the pavement and a flag whips on its pole. Diagonal rain streaks cover the whole picture.

5446.expl: A short travel montage of a young woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat. First she leans out of a red telephone box on a city street, one arm raised in a wave, with a huge clock tower behind her and a red double-decker bus passing. Then she is out on a green hillside where low grey cloud sits right down on the hills: the far slopes fade into white haze and the long lake in the valley below is half swallowed by it, so you cannot see where the hills end. She walks along the ridge in the drizzle, looking out over the hazy valley. Finally she stands on a wooden seaside pier under a clear blue sky, laughing and eating chips out of a paper cone with the surf rolling in behind her.

5447.expl: A single dusty old pickup truck is parked on the shoulder of a two-lane road that runs dead straight into an empty desert, with nothing else in sight in any direction: no houses, no other cars, no people, just scrub, sand and huge red rock buttes standing far off on the horizon in the low evening sun. A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans steps up onto the truck's front wheel and reaches for the roof, her hair blown sideways. A small flag on a pole is fixed behind the cab and flaps in the wind. The road's faded yellow centre line runs away to the far horizon.

5448.expl: A young man in a red jacket with a backpack turns on the spot in the middle of a busy city crossing, arms flung wide and mouth open in delight. All around and above him the building fronts are covered floor to roof in enormous lit advertising boards - bright pink, blue and white panels the size of whole walls, stacked one above the other and wrapped around the corners of the towers - while yellow taxis and crowds pass behind him. The clip then cuts to him leaning on the rail of a ferry, grinning, with a tall green statue on an island behind him, and finally to him standing on a rock at the rim of a huge red canyon at sunset with his arms raised.

5449.expl: A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock. At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.

5450.expl: A young woman walks through her flat switching everything off at the wall: she pulls a black cable out of a socket beside a cabinet, then in the kitchen she reaches behind the worktop and pulls the plug of a toaster and a coffee machine, then a tall standing fan in the hallway, and finally the wall-mounted TV with its LED light strips, which go dark as she reaches up and disconnects it.

5451.expl: In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.

5452.expl: A man wrapped in a thick checked blanket stands alone at the end of a wooden pier on a mountain lake, sipping slowly from a metal mug. Thick white mist hangs over the water at first; as it drifts away the turquoise lake, the pine forest and the snow-topped rock faces appear behind him, perfectly still and mirrored in the water. He keeps looking out, drinking, and nothing else moves.

5453.expl: An older woman stands at a wooden kitchen table with a tall dark blue ceramic vase in front of her. She pours water into it from a glass jug, then takes flowers from a pile on the table one by one and puts them into the vase: a pink peony, big yellow sunflowers, white daisies. At the end she holds the vase with both hands and turns it to show the full arrangement, then leans in and smells it.

The page already carries one black rectangular stamp mark, and fresh black drops have splattered around the one being pressed, with a dark stamp pad standing at the top left of the desk.

5455.expl: A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.

5456.expl: A young man in a grey shirt sits at an outdoor counter under palm trees with a passport, an envelope and printed forms in front of him, pressing his hands together hopefully. Inside an airport terminal he then holds the passport open to a page with his photo on it, eyes wide. He steps up to an officer beside a metal detector, who reaches out for the document, and finally he walks through the gateway grinning and holding up a small card.

5457.expl: A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.

5458.expl: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a grey sports top tips an orange jar labelled with a vitamin label and shakes a large white tablet into her palm. She drops the tablet into a tall glass of water on the counter; it fizzes hard, filling the glass with bubbles until the water turns bright orange. She stares at the glass with wide eyes, then lifts it, drinks, and pulls a satisfied face. A bowl of oranges and kiwis sits beside her.

5459.expl: A dark ink-style illustration of an erupting mountain at night. A huge boiling cloud of ash rises from the crater, lit orange from below, and glowing molten streams run down every slope of the mountain in bright branching lines. Burning lumps of rock fly through the black sky trailing smoke. In the foreground the ground is cracked into plates with orange-hot rivers glowing in every crack.

5460.expl: At a funfair a young man staggers away from a spinning teacup ride with his hand clamped over his mouth and his eyes bulging. He hurries to a grey bin and doubles over it. More riders come off the ride the same way: a young woman covers her mouth with both hands, another man clamps his hand over his and bends forward, and soon a whole row of people is bent over the bins along the walkway while the carousel and the big wheel keep turning behind them.

5461.expl: Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.

5463.expl: A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.

5464.expl: A watercolour and ink drawing of a woman's body from the neck to the knees. She wears a fitted blue-grey long-sleeved top and dark grey jeans. The background is a plain cream wash.

The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.

5466.expl: An illustration of a smart restaurant dining room in warm orange light, with brass chandeliers, wood panelling and tables under white cloths. A young waiter walks through it in the strict uniform of the trade: white shirt, black bow tie, black waistcoat, long white apron and black trousers, a folded white cloth over his forearm. He balances a tray of stacked plates and wine glasses high on one hand and sets a plate down with the other. Seated guests in jackets and dresses dine at candlelit tables.

5467.expl: A brightly painted bunk room at a summer camp with open windows onto trees. A teenage boy on a top bunk jolts out of sleep with his eyes wide and his mouth open, then sits up and rubs his face with both hands while another child still lies asleep on the bunk below. The camera moves across the room and the whole dormitory comes out of sleep: children push back their duvets, sit up on the edges of their bunks and rub their eyes, with sandals and flip-flops on the floor beside the beds.

5468.expl: A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.

5469.expl: An older woman with short white hair, a cap and a bright pink jacket makes her way on foot along a gravel path in a lakeside park, planting a Nordic walking pole with each hand as she goes. She passes another person on foot near a bench, then follows the path beside grey water with ducks on it, stops to look at the smartwatch on her wrist, and carries on past a stone fountain with hills and a town on the far shore.

5470.expl: A montage of people walking. First a low shot follows a woman in a navy business suit and nude high heels striding along a city sidewalk past taxis and office workers; then she is seen from behind crossing a street between glass skyscrapers in the financial district. The scene cuts to a bald hiker with a big backpack and trekking poles climbing a forest trail towards a mountain; then to a man in a blue t-shirt walking a golden retriever on a leash across a sunny park lawn; and finally to a high aerial view of a huge crowd streaming across the Shibuya-style crossing between illuminated billboards downtown.

5471.expl: A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

5472.expl: A black-and-white ink drawing seen from close up: two hands hold an open leather wallet upside down over a shop counter, and several banknotes slide out of it, one of them tumbling away through the air. Below the wallet a small clasp coin purse hangs open and a coin drops out of it towards the floor, with another coin already lying on the wooden counter. Behind the hands the blurred checkout of a shop is drawn, with a cash register, a customer display screen and a long printed receipt curling out of the till.

5473.expl: A man with a moustache in a brown corduroy jacket and a striped shoulder bag stands at a shop checkout, pulling a blue bank card out of a brown leather wallet next to the card terminal. He then walks through an open-air fruit market and opens the same wallet in front of the fruit crates, searching through it. He lifts the wallet up to the camera with both hands and turns it around so the empty pockets show, grinning in disbelief. Finally he leans over a wooden table where a small pile of loose coins has been tipped out, and pushes the coins around with both hands while another person's hand reaches in from the other side.

5474.expl: A close shot shows a man's hands sliding a blue-green card out of a brown leather wallet beside a payment terminal with a glowing green ring in a shop. He looks up and smiles, holding the open wallet. At an open-air market he hands the card across crates of oranges, apples and plums to the stallholder while holding a paper bag. Then, over a wooden table, he holds a small brown coin purse upside down and a stream of coins pours out of it into a spreading heap. In the last shot he pushes the coins apart with one finger, sorting the copper and silver pieces on the table while the empty purse hangs in his other hand.

5475.expl: A pencil sketch on yellowed paper shows a battlefield. A line of soldiers in round steel helmets, with packs on their backs and rifles in their hands, runs forward through churned mud, the leading man leaping over a shell crater as earth sprays up around his boots. Behind them a heavy armoured vehicle with a long gun barrel, a turret and caterpillar tracks pushes through the smoke. Thick black smoke rises from a burning ruined town on the horizon, shattered tree stumps and torn barbed wire stand on the left, and a great coil of barbed wire fills the foreground.

5476.expl: A photograph of a destroyed street in daylight. A woman in a dusty beige utility vest and dark trousers walks towards the camera over a slope of broken concrete, carrying a bundle of grey blankets pressed against her chest; her face and clothes are grey with dust. On both sides stand bombed concrete buildings with their fronts torn open and their floors collapsing, a burnt-out car sits on the left, and pale smoke drifts down the street. The whole foreground is a field of smashed concrete blocks, twisted steel reinforcing rods, broken cables and dust.

5477.expl: In a snowy park two structures built out of stacked snow blocks face each other across an open field, each with thick walls, corner towers and a coloured flag planted on top — one blue, one red. Children and teenagers in red and blue winter jackets, bobble hats and scarves crouch behind the snow walls, then jump up and hurl snowballs, and clouds of white snow burst over the walls. The camera runs with them as both sides charge across the open snow towards the other side's snow walls; one child in blue is knocked over and rolls in the snow, another carries the red flag on a stick along the wall. At the end the whole group lies together in a laughing heap on the snow.

5478.expl: A colour comic-style illustration of a bedroom. A young woman with brown hair has pulled both mirrored doors of a tall wooden wardrobe wide open and stands in the opening with her arms stretched out, eyes wide, as a mass of assorted things bursts out over her: shirts, jumpers, trousers and skirts in red, green, blue, yellow and pink, folded stacks toppling off the shelves, and a brown leather shoe flying out of the frame towards the viewer. Empty wooden hangers swing on the rail above her, a battered suitcase sits on top of the wardrobe, and a patterned rug, a potted plant and a pair of jeans lie on the floor.

5479.expl: A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.

5480.expl: A young man in a backwards cap stands at a kitchen sink washing a soapy plate by hand. The camera pulls back to show towers of dirty plates stacked far above his head on both sides of the sink, plus dirty cups and glasses on the counter. He keeps scrubbing plate after plate, then looks at the remaining towers, opens his mouth and groans, and the stacks are still just as high at the end.

5481.expl: A smiling young woman with long bright pink hair kneels in a tiled laundry room beside an open front-loading washing machine. Her pink hair fills most of the frame as she lifts coloured clothes out of a laundry basket and pushes them into the drum. The camera then shows the closed machine with the wash turning behind the round glass door, and finally, filmed from inside the drum, she pulls out a clean white t-shirt and holds it up to her face.

5482.expl: A short montage of things being washed. First two hands scrub a white plate with a sponge under a running kitchen tap. Then a jet of water sprays the front of a dark car on a driveway. Then a hand lifts a pale shirt out of a big metal tub filled with white suds. Then a woman kneels on a lawn laughing while she washes a golden retriever sitting in a large grey plastic tub of water. Finally a group of people soap up cars at a car wash in a car park.

5483.expl: A young woman with curly hair and a yellow top stands at a seafront railing at sunset holding binoculars. She points at something far off on the beach, then raises the binoculars to her eyes and searches along the shore. The scene changes to a packed stadium at dusk where she lowers the binoculars with her mouth open in surprise, and fireworks then rise and burst above the crowd while she stares up at them.

He then waters a garden bed full of pink, yellow and red zinnias and pansies from the same can, moves on to a raised bed of leafy vegetables and waters those too, and finally stands back with a hand on his hip looking over the watered garden.

5487.expl: A high-contrast black-and-white illustration of a giant ocean wave curling over into a hollow barrel; inside the glowing turquoise tube a tiny silhouetted surfer crouches on a surfboard, riding along the face of the wave. Spray flies off the crest above and dark rocks and choppy water fill the foreground.

5488.expl: On a sunny quay a small group of people stand at the railing waving both arms at a white passenger ferry. An older woman in a flowered headscarf and a young man grin at the camera with their hands raised; others beside them swing pink scarves overhead. The ferry pulls away from the ramp, passengers crowded on its decks waving back, and it shrinks into the blue water towards the city skyline as the group on the quay keeps waving.

5489.expl: In a bright clothing boutique lined with rails of coats, a woman poses for the camera in one outfit after another. She is first dressed in an oversized denim jacket and a colourful scarf, then in a long red coat, then in a silver sequinned mini dress, then in a thick knitted coat, and finally in an enormous feathered coat with a matching feather hat. Between each look the shot cuts and she is dressed in the next piece.

5490.expl: A young man in a straw hat and a football shirt kneels in a vegetable bed between rows of leafy green plants, a tall corn field behind him. He digs his gloved hands into the dark soil around the base of a big unwanted plant, works it loose, grips it low down and pulls hard. He rocks back, drags the plant out of the ground and stands up holding it above the bed, its long soil-covered roots and leafy top hanging down.

5491.expl: A young traveller with a rucksack and a suitcase arrives at the carved wooden gate of a tropical guesthouse. A smiling woman in a batik dress lifts a chain of white flowers over his head and settles it on his shoulders while the hosts laugh around him. A man carries out a tray of green coconuts with straws and hands him one, which he takes gladly and drinks. The whole household lines the path clapping and cheering, arms in the air, as he walks through the gate holding the coconut and grinning at the camera.

5492.expl: A rough charcoal drawing of a big tyred wheel standing upright on a workshop floor. The thin metal spokes run out from the central hub in a criss-cross pattern to the rim, and the axle stub sticks out of the middle. A gloved hand reaches in from the right and holds the wheel steady; behind it a car body is dimly sketched and spanners and other tools lie scattered on the ground.

5493.expl: In a bike workshop a young man in an apron holds a tiny white scooter wheel right up to the camera so its dark metal centre and bearing fill the frame. He then swings a blue bicycle upside down and spins its front wheel, and the camera drops low to follow the tyre and the silver centre with its spokes fanning out. Next he walks up to a huge black tractor tyre on a yellow rim taller than he is and stares at its bolted centre. Finally the camera tilts up at a giant ferris wheel against a blue sky, its spokes running out from the white centre, with the tractor tyre still in the bottom of the shot.

5494.expl: A soft watercolour illustration: a young man in a green jacket and patched brown corduroy trousers sits in a wheelchair and drives it forward himself, gripping the hand rim of the big spoked wheel, which is blurred with motion. A girl in a knitted scarf runs laughing beside him with her arms out. Autumn leaves fall around them onto a leaf-covered path; behind them are yellow trees and an old stone arch bridge.

5495.expl: In a grand old library reading room with green banker's lamps and tall bookshelves, a student in a shirt and striped tie leans across the long table, cups his hand around his mouth and passes something on to the next person. One after another the students at the table turn sideways, listen, react with wide eyes and a smirk, and pass it along the row. The last shot shows the whole row of students leaning in and giggling over their open books.

5496.expl: A young couple's morning at home. She stands at the stove in his oversized blue shirt, flipping a pancake in a frying pan while he dances up behind her in a white shirt and tie. She then turns to him, holding a big mug of coffee, and carefully straightens the knot of his tie against his collar until it sits right. Later they kneel at a low table in the living room holding hands over two slices of cake, and finally they flop onto the sofa laughing, she raising the TV remote in the air.

5497.expl: An election night campaign room. A woman in a cream blazer with a big ribbon rosette on her chest stands clasping her hands in front of a screen showing a rising bar chart of results, surrounded by supporters in blue campaign T-shirts with her name on them. Their faces are tense, hands over mouths; a close-up shows her staring at the screen. Then the result lands: she throws her head back and screams with joy, the room erupts with raised fists, balloons and confetti, and her team lifts her up on their shoulders.

5498.expl: A young woman with a blonde plait pushes open a different window in every shot and leans out into the view behind it. First a white casement window over an old-town courtyard of pastel houses with shutters and potted plants; then a wooden chalet window opening onto a green alpine meadow under a blue sky; then a window straight onto a sandy beach and turquoise sea; then a big wooden chalet window framing a snowy mountain peak, which she pushes wide open and leans through, smiling.

5499.expl: A sunny open-air street market lined with fruit and vegetable stalls and tall old apartment blocks. A young woman in a red summer dress spins round on the pavement, hair flying, laughing. A second woman in a neon-yellow sports top and black leggings jogs towards the camera down the same street. An elderly white-haired woman leans out of a first-floor window onto a balcony packed with red geraniums, watering can in hand, smiling down. Back at street level the woman in red meets a woman in a navy business suit carrying a briefcase; they talk face to face beside a stall of tomatoes, then stand together with shopping bags while the woman in red waves at the camera.

5500.expl: A muted woodcut-style illustration of an open-sided timber shed at the edge of a misty forest. A young man in a flat cap and patched work clothes swings an axe down into a log standing on a chopping block; splinters fly and a split log falls away to the left. Behind him a sawhorse and a stack of round logs sit under the shed roof. In the foreground lies a neat pile of freshly sawn planks with visible grain, plus more cut logs and curls of wood shaving on the ground.

5501.expl: A charcoal drawing of a large dim factory hall with a steel roof truss, hanging lamps and heavy machinery lining both walls. In the middle a man in a hard hat, dirty overalls and thick gloves leans into a hand truck loaded with wooden crates and a metal drum, pushing it forward across the concrete floor. Dust hangs in the light. More crates and a second hand truck stand in the foreground.

5502.expl: A large warehouse aisle with tall steel racking on both sides, full of shrink-wrapped pallets. A woman in a hi-vis vest and work gloves lifts cardboard boxes onto a wooden pallet beside a conveyor, building the load up layer by layer until it is chest high and wrapped in clear plastic film. She then takes the handle of an orange pallet truck, pumps it, and pulls the finished pallet away down the aisle past the racking, a forklift moving in the background.

5503.expl: A bright living room with white curtains and a pale floor. A young woman in a purple sports bra and leggings squats with her arms held straight out in front of her, then drops onto a teal exercise mat and pushes up into a high plank with a phone timer and a water bottle on the floor beside her. She lowers onto her forearms into an elbow plank and holds it, face tight with effort as the timer counts up. At the end she drops flat onto her back on the mat, arms spread, breathing hard.

5504.expl: A young woman with a black bob sits at a wooden desk by a bright window, a green cardigan on, tapping a black fountain pen against her lips while she thinks over a sheet of writing paper. She then writes a handwritten letter across the page, folds the finished sheet, slides it into a cream envelope and presses the flap down flat with both hands. In the last shot she stands in the street at a red pillar postbox, smiling as she pushes the envelope through the slot.

A young medic in a glowing jacket holds a chest X-ray film up against a bright lightbox and studies it; a second X-ray film showing a hand floats in front of her, and the monitors around her display ECG traces and readouts.

5506.expl: Outdoors at sunset on a street basketball court beside a graffiti wall. A girl in a tie-dye set dances and dribbles a basketball while the friends around her clap and dance with her; the camera pulls back and the gathering keeps growing until a huge crowd fills the whole street, everyone dancing with their arms in the air, while a skateboarder rolls through the middle.

5507.expl: A young man in a bright palm-print shirt tours a zoo holding a spotting sheet of animal pictures. He crouches on the grass and lets a goat eat a handful of hay out of his hands, then stands at a glass pool where penguins stand on the rocks and swim past him, and finally holds a leafy branch up to a giraffe that leans over the wooden fence and takes the leaves with its tongue.

4204.expl: An aerial timelapse of a tall curved tower block standing on a roundabout in a suburb of brick houses. The building starts grey and weathered; cranes arrive and scaffolding climbs it storey by storey; then colour is applied from the bottom up until the whole tower is bright yellow with a brown tip, so that the block reads as a giant banana. The scaffolding comes down and the finished yellow tower stands over the roundabout in the sun.

4255.vo: Today we are cooking an African ostrich. Onions, tomatoes, and the whole leg goes in. Ready. Time to feed the boys.
4255.expl: Outdoor cooking on the stony bank of a river in wide green hills. A man in a beige bucket hat holds up a large raw leg of meat wrapped in plastic. Close up, a knife chops a white onion into small pieces on a round wooden cutting board, the chopped onion heaped across the board. Chunks of red meat and the whole leg lie in a big aluminium pot and a hand sprinkles salt over them. The man lowers a heavy metal lid onto the pot by the river. Finally he carries a huge platter piled with cooked brown meat to a carved wooden table on the grass, with motocross riders in gear and their dirt bikes standing around it.

4278.vo: Oh, my head. Ugh, so sore. Ugh, better.
4278.expl: In a bright living room a woman on the sofa presses both hands to her temples with her eyes screwed shut, another woman holds her jaw and grimaces with toothache, and a man clutches his head and shouts. Hot water bottles and wheat bags are filled from a kettle on the coffee table and pressed to a forehead, a jaw and a stomach. In the last shot all four sit together on the sofa, smiling and relaxed, each hugging a hot water bottle.

4372.expl: A dark ink illustration of a smoky drinking place. A long polished wooden counter runs diagonally across the picture; the barman stands behind it tipping a bottle so a ribbon of liquid pours into a glass on the counter top. A metal shaker lies spilled at the near end with ice cubes scattered over the wood. A couple sit at the far end on high stools, glasses raised, laughing; rows of bottles line the shelves behind.

4422.expl: A stark black and white comic illustration. A thick red line is painted across cracked grey asphalt and runs away from the viewer into the distance. A man in a dark jacket with a duffel bag over his shoulder is caught mid-stride stepping over that line, one boot on each side of it. On the left a heavy uniformed figure looms in silhouette with a raised fist, a striped boom gate lifted behind him, and further back stand a watchtower on stilts and two plain flags on poles.

4428.expl: In a bright kitchen a teenager in a black hoodie tips a box of coloured breakfast rings into a turquoise bowl on the worktop, the rings falling in a stream. He picks up a big plastic jug of milk and pours it into the full bowl, grinning at the camera. Close up, he lifts a spoon heaped with the coloured rings out of the milk and opens his mouth. The video cuts to a noodle restaurant where a huge red and cream bowl of ramen soup is set down in front of a woman, who stares at it wide eyed and then lifts a tangle of noodles out of the broth with chopsticks.

4437.expl: A late afternoon photograph on a seafront promenade. The whole foreground is paved in small black and white stones laid in a repeating wave design that curls away across the walkway, with drifts of pale sand blown over it and long shadows falling across. A barefoot woman in a black swimsuit and an orange printed sarong springs off the paving with her right arm stretched up to strike a white, blue and yellow volleyball at the top right of the frame. Behind her lie a calm bay full of moored boats, a row of palm trees, and a tall rounded mountain against the pale sky; a blank wooden sign on a post and a crate of green coconuts stand at the left edge.

4444.expl: A Japanese-style woodblock print. Along both banks of a wide river stands a small settlement of low wooden houses with grey tiled roofs, packed close together with wooden jetties reaching out over the water and dark pine woods rising behind them. A high arched wooden bridge crosses the river from one side of the settlement to the other, with a figure in a blue coat and a straw hat walking over it, gulls flying above and a boatman rowing a narrow wooden boat below.

4449.expl: A cartoon of a boy's bedroom. A grinning older boy in blue dungarees and a flat cap has taken hold of a smaller boy in a striped shirt and hoisted him clean off the floor, holding him upside down across his shoulders with both hands. The smaller boy hangs head down with his arms out and his legs kicking in the air, and one of his shoes has come off and is flying across the room. A cushion sails through the air behind them, and toy blocks and a wooden train are scattered over the floor beside a bed and a chest of drawers.

4453.expl: The clip opens with a boy washing a car with a sponge and a red bucket of soapy water, then cuts to an orchard. Rows of low, broad trees stand on the grass with their branches heavy with round red fruit, so many that the leaves are half hidden and windfalls lie in the grass underneath. In front of them a pair of hands tips a metal bucket over a weathered picnic table and the red fruit rolls out across the boards. The last scene shows a man on a beach lifting a plastic bucket off a finished sandcastle.

4486.expl: A woman in a red and black checked jacket, woolly hat and black gloves skates across an outdoor ice rink in bright winter sun, leaning into her stride with a hockey stick out in front of her and a puck on the blade. It is so cold that a white cloud of her breath hangs in the air beside her face, and her skates throw up a spray of ice crystals. A red barn and a log cabin under snowy spruces stand behind her.

4494.expl: An illustration of a battered little orange and cream hatchback tearing along a dirt track through green countryside at sunset. A young man with spiky hair grips the steering wheel and stares ahead through a dusty windscreen. The car is thrown into a slight slide, its wheels blurred, gravel and stones spraying out from under the tyres and a cloud of dust boiling up behind it, with telegraph poles and hedges flashing past.

4518.expl: A photograph of a man working on a house roof on a bright sunny day. He stands astride the ridge tiles beside an aluminium ladder, in a sand-coloured T-shirt and work trousers, and reaches up with both hands to push a long black rod down into the top of a red clay chimney pot. Grey sooty smoke puffs out of that pot and out of two more pots on the next stack. Terraced roofs, trees and a clear blue sky lie behind him.

4523.expl: A loose watercolour of a street celebration. A young man in a grey jacket leaps into the air holding up a long wooden pole, and on the end of it a huge red-and-green dragon puppet curls right across the sky above the crowd. Red paper lanterns hang on strings over the street, red confetti falls through the air, a red flag with gold stars flies at the side, and down in the street a band of drummers in caps beat side drums while a packed crowd watches from both sides.

4552.expl: A bright cartoon of an open-plan office. A woman in a blue jacket and a man in a colourful polo shirt leap off the ground either side of a desk and slap a high five above two open laptops, both laughing with their heads back. Their office chairs have been kicked over backwards, sheets of paper and a mug of coffee hang in mid-air around them, and a spotlight from the ceiling picks them out. Rows of empty desks with monitors, a potted plant and glass partitions fill the background.

4574.expl: A glass-walled boardroom high above a city, with skyscrapers filling the windows. A bald bearded man in a plaid shirt sits at the end of a row of colleagues and coughs hard into his fist, twice, his head down. The people next to him keep typing on their laptops, then heads start to turn towards him along the row. Wider shots show the whole long table lined with people on both sides, each with an open laptop, water bottles, notebooks and pens in front of them, several of them holding a hand to their face.

4604.expl: A soft cartoon of a vaulted beer hall. A man in a mint shirt and a woman in a lilac shirt stand at either end of a long wooden table, lean in over it and knock their two glass tankards of beer together in the middle, hard enough that foam leaps up between them. Both are laughing with their eyes closed. Behind them other drinkers sit at long benches under warm hanging lamps.

4609.expl: A stark black-and-white drawing. Almost the whole frame is solid black. In the bottom left corner a small arched doorway is cut out in white, and a man in a jacket steps through it holding up a single candle with one orange flame. His other hand is raised in front of him. The light reaches only a metre or so, throwing his long shadow back across the lit floor, and beyond the arch there is nothing but the black wall of unlit space.

4626.expl: A claymation-style scene in a dental surgery. A patient lies back in a blue dental chair with a paper bib over his chest, gripping the armrests, eyes wide and mouth stretched open. A dentist in blue scrubs and a light blue face mask leans over him, holding a small round mirror in one hand and a thin metal probe in the other, and moves them into the open mouth to look at each tooth in turn. Blue droplets of water spray out. A big round lamp glares down from above and a tray of steel instruments sits at the patient's elbow, with x-rays on the wall behind.
